title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
title_zh: RealCompanion：从纵向真实世界对话推理中基准测试人类理解

paragraphs.en: A companion that talks with a person for months should come to understand them. It should remember what they said, infer who they are, and know when the past bears on the message in front of it. Testing this requires a real person’s record, and such records are private, so benchmarks generate the person and the questions and settle in advance what matters. We release RealCompanion, ten real relationships with an AI companion: 27,218 messages over up to 120 days, released as the conversation and four files derived from it, a profile, a persona, a chat ground truth and a question set, each citing the messages it rests on. Every chat label carries the reasoning trace that produced it, checked stage by stage against the conversation. Three findings follow. First, the past is rarely needed and far away. Pooled measures mislead: a recency window finds the required message for 95.9% of probes and 2.2% of those that need memory, and at the natural rate 96% of the gain from supplying recorded evidence comes from messages that need none. Second, no detector we tried can tell when memory is needed on real messages, authored questions over the same histories leak the cue, and labeling the same messages as memories raises their use by ten to fourteen points. Third, three agent systems reconstruct the persona with the same F1 at a 31-fold difference in cost.
paragraphs.zh: 一个与一个人交谈数月的智能体，应该能够理解这个人。 它应该记住对方说过的话，推断出对方的身份，并知道过去何时会影响当前收到的信息。 要测试这一点，需要真实人物的记录，而这类记录属于隐私，因此基准测试会生成人物和问题，并提前确定哪些内容具有意义。 我们发布了 RealCompanion，它包含与 AI 智能体的十段真实关系：在长达 120 天的时间里共记录了 27,218 条消息，并以对话形式以及由此衍生出的四个文件发布，包括个人档案、人格设定、聊天基准事实和一套问题，每个文件都引用了其所依据的消息。 每条聊天标签都附带了生成它的推理过程，并分阶段与对话内容进行了核对。由此得出以下三个发现。 首先，过去的信息很少被需要，而且往往距离当前很远。 汇总指标具有误导性：在最近性窗口中，95.9% 的查询都能找到所需消息，而在需要记忆的情况下，这一比例为 2.2%；在自然发生的情况下，提供记录证据所带来的增益中，有 96% 来自根本不需要记忆的消息。 其次，我们尝试过的任何检测器都无法判断真实消息中何时需要记忆；基于相同历史记录的自撰问题会泄露相关线索，而将同一批消息标记为记忆，则会使它们被使用的比例上升十到十四个百分点。 第三，三种智能体系统在成本相差 31 倍的情况下，仍能以相同的 F1 值重建人格设定。

paragraphs.en: People now spend a long time talking to AI companions. Understanding such a person means answering two questions. The first is who they are, and that answer holds from one message to the next. The second is which of the things they have said matters now, and that answer changes with every message. A companion has to get both right. Both answers are claims about a real person, and a claim about a person can only be checked against what that person actually said. Those conversations are private, held by the companies whose products produced them, so the conversations used to test this have been generated instead. paragraphs.en: Generated conversations support one kind of measurement. They place a fact in a dialog and score whether a system returns it, which is memorization. Three properties of how they are built set that limit. A generated dialog is written around the memory it tests, so nearly every message in it needs the past ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . A prompted persona declares its traits in advance, so a question about the person is answered by reading the declaration ( Zhang et al., 2018 ; Xu et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2025a ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . A scripted history never revises itself, so nothing said in month nine changes what was established in month four ( Jiang et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026b ) . These benchmarks answer both questions before a system sees them. The dialog is built so that the past always matters. The persona states in advance what the person is like.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的对话支持一种类型的测量。 它们将某个事实置于对话中，并评分判断系统是否返回该事实，这属于记忆复述。 其构建方式的三个特性设定了这一限制。 生成的对话是围绕其所测试的记忆编写的，因此其中几乎每条信息都需要依赖过往内容（Maharana 等，2024；Wu 等，2024；Hu 等，2026）。 通过提示设定的人物角色会提前声明其特质，因此关于该人物的问题可以通过阅读声明来回答（Zhang 等，2018；Xu 等，2022；Jiang 等，2025a；Kim 等，2025）。 脚本化的历史内容绝不会自我修订，因此第九个月所说的任何内容都不会改变第四个月已确立的内容（Jiang 等，2025b；Li 等，2026b）。 这些基准测试在系统看到问题之前就已经回答了这两个问题。 对话的构建方式确保了过往内容始终具有意义。 人物角色会提前说明其自身的特征。

paragraphs.en: Answering those two questions means meeting four challenges. Challenge 1 is knowing when the past matters , since most messages need nothing from earlier. Challenge 2 is knowing what the messages add up to , since who a person is emerges across all of them together. Challenge 3 is drawing on everything at once . A reply built on the last few messages misses what the person has carried for months. A reply built on the facts they stated hands those facts back to them. A reply built on a trait inferred wrongly is confident and wrong. Challenge 4 is telling whether any of this was done right , and that takes the person’s own record.
paragraphs.zh: 回答这两个问题意味着要应对四个挑战。 挑战一在于判断过去何时重要，因为大多数信息并不需要任何早期的内容。 挑战二在于理解这些信息共同构成了什么，因为一个人的身份是在所有信息综合呈现时才显现出来的。 挑战三在于同时调用所有这些信息。 仅基于最近几条信息作出的回应，会忽略这个人几个月来一直携带的信息。 基于他们陈述的事实作出的回应，只是将这些事实原封不动地还给他们。 基于错误推断出的特质作出的回应，既充满自信又错误百出。 挑战四在于判断这些做法中是否有哪一项做得正确，而这需要参考这个人自己的记录。

paragraphs.en: RealCompanion is built from ten people in long-term relationships with AI companions, released with their consent. These conversations were never written to test a system, so most messages ask nothing of the past (challenge 1). No one described these people before they spoke, so who they are has to be worked out from what they said (challenge 2). We release five files for each participant. The conversation is the source, and the other four come from it. A profile records what the person stated, and a persona records how they think, feel and decide. The chat ground truth records what a reply had to know and what it should have said, and the question set poses the same decisions as written questions. Together these give a system the recent messages, the distant ones, the facts the person stated and the state they are in (challenge 3). Every claim points back at the messages behind it, so a reader can check any of it (challenge 4). Three tracks run on these files. The reconstruction track asks a system for the profile and persona. The chat track scores its replies to the person’s own messages. The question track scores its answers to the written questions. The derivation is done by models and audited by people, and we report how often the two agree (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: RealCompanion 由十位与 AI 伴侣建立长期关系的人所提供，并在他们同意的情况下发布。 这些对话从未被用于测试系统，因此大多数信息并未涉及过去的内容（挑战 1）。 在这些人开口之前，没有人对他们的描述，因此必须根据他们的发言来推断他们是谁（挑战 2）。 我们为每位参与者发布了五个文件。 对话是原始来源，其余四个文件均由此衍生而来。 一份个人档案记录了该人陈述的内容，而一个人设则记录了他们的思维方式、情感与决策过程。 聊天基准记录了一条回复必须了解的内容以及它应当表达的信息，而问题集则以书面问题的形式提出相同的决策要求。 这些内容共同为一个系统提供了近期的消息、远期的信息、该人陈述的事实以及他们当前的状态（挑战 3）。 每一项主张都可追溯至其背后的对话内容，因此读者可以验证其中的任何部分（挑战 4）。 这三个文件上运行着三条不同的流程。 重建流程要求系统生成个人档案和人物设定。 聊天流程则评估系统对该人自身消息的回复。 问题流程则评估系统对书面问题的回答。 这一推导过程由模型完成并由人工审核，我们会报告两者结果一致的情况频率（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: The four derived files divide the work of knowing a person. The profile holds every claim the conversation establishes, one record at a time, each pointing at the messages behind it. The persona records who they are, how they think and feel, and how they decide. Each entry is filled only where the conversation supports it. Between them, the profile and the persona hold what it takes to understand the person. The question set is written from the profile, so its 3,312 questions across 16 categories reach every claim, fact and trait the conversation established. Every item in the chat ground truth carries a reasoning trace , and the trace names what the person was pointing at, where it lives, which messages the reply was built from, and whether those messages support it. A label can therefore be contested at the step that produced it. RealCompanion makes all four challenges measurable on relationships that people actually had. We also define the task over any record of a person and state seven conditions a corpus must meet to measure it (Appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: Work on conversational memory has converged on one shape. A long history is constructed, a question is posed at the end, and a system is scored on recovering the fact the question needs. LoCoMo builds very long generated conversations and queries them ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) , and LongMemEval scales the context past a million tokens ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . CloneMem moves to diaries and messages generated from Big Five profiles into multi-year arcs, links each question to evidence units, and reports that flat retrieval beats consolidation-based memory systems ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . The shape has produced real machinery, and the memory layers now shipping inside products were tuned against it. It also decides one thing in advance. A question states what should be retrieved, so a benchmark built from questions never has to judge whether retrieval was warranted. Two benchmarks that test selection directly report how hard it is. CUPID curates histories in which a preference holds only in one context, and finds that no model it evaluates exceeds 50% precision at identifying which prior context a request depends on ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . HorizonBench evolves preferences through a mental state graph and reports that all 25 models it evaluates disproportionately select the value from before the change, positioning itself as preparation in advance of longitudinal human data ( Li et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 对话记忆的研究已趋同于一种模式。 系统会构建一段较长的历史，在末尾提出一个问题，并根据其能否恢复问题所需的事实进行评分。 LoCoMo 会生成非常长的对话并对其进行查询（Maharana 等，2024），而 LongMemEval 则将上下文扩展至超过一百万个词元（Wu 等，2024）。 CloneMem 将基于“大五人格”特征生成的日记和消息转化为跨越多年的叙事弧线，将每个问题与证据单元关联，并报告称直接检索优于基于巩固的记忆系统（Hu 等，2026）。 这种模式已催生出真正的机制，而目前产品中部署的记忆层正是针对该机制进行调优的。 它还会预先决定一件事。 问题本身会明确说明应检索什么内容，因此由问题构建的基准测试无需判断检索是否合理。 两种直接测试选择能力的基准测试报告了这项任务的难度。 CUPID 构建了一组历史数据，其中偏好仅在特定上下文中成立，并发现其评估的所有模型在识别请求所依赖的先前上下文时，精确度均未超过 50%（Kim 等，2025）。 HorizonBench 通过心智状态图演化偏好，并报告称其评估的全部 25 个模型都倾向于过度选择变化前的值，以此作为对长期人类数据的预先准备（Li 等，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Companion applications are a setting of their own. A person returns to the same agent daily for months, and the relationship is what they are there for. ANCHOR evaluates whether the companion stays itself across 2,008 conversations, 27 personas and three memory configurations, and reports trajectory accuracy of 44.4% with recall of the user’s state near chance under every configuration ( Venkit et al., 2026b ) . CompanionBench works from de-identified real companion conversations and anchors its rubric in psychological theory, and states directly that a 20-turn session cannot reach the depth of disclosure that develops over a longer relationship ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Outside machine learning the same relationship is studied through interviews and surveys, which describe how the bond develops over months and document the distress people report when a system’s behavior changes ( Skjuve et al., 2021 ; Brandtzaeg et al., 2022 ; Ta et al., 2020 ; Laestadius et al., 2024 ) . Every one of those studies works from what people say about the interaction afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 陪伴类应用程序本身就是一个独特的领域。 一个人会连续数月每天回到同一个智能体那里，而维系这种关系正是他们使用它的原因。 ANCHOR 评估了该陪伴智能体在 2,008 次对话、27 种角色设定和三种记忆配置中是否保持其自身特性，并报告其轨迹准确率为 44.4%，而在每种配置下，对用户状态的回忆能力几乎与随机水平相当（Venkit et al., 2026b）。 CompanionBench 基于经过去标识化的真实陪伴对话进行研究，并以心理学理论作为其评估标准的基础，明确指出 20 轮对话无法达到长期关系中所形成的深度自我披露（Liu et al., 2026）。 在机器学习领域之外，同样的关系也通过访谈和调查得到研究，这些研究描述了这种情感纽带如何在数月间逐渐发展，并记录了当系统行为发生变化时人们所报告的痛苦感受（Skjuve et al., 2021；Brandtzaeg et al., 2022；Ta et al., 2020；Laestadius et al., 2024）。 所有这些研究都基于人们事后对互动过程的描述。

sents.zh: 陪伴类应用程序本身就是一个独特的领域。

paragraphs.en: Three efforts remove the substitution at the data. AlpsBench curates 2,500 long-term sequences from WildChat and evaluates seven memory systems on them ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , which makes it the closest prior work to ours on data. PRISM collects feedback from 1,500 people, the largest body of real human preference data in this area ( Kirk et al., 2024 ) . OmniBehavior and LUNAR build from real behavioral traces outside conversation ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and OmniBehavior reports that models evaluated on real traces converge toward an average agreeable person and lose the long tail. A parallel line supplies a written description of the person and scores agreement with it, from PersonaChat through PersonaMem ( Zhang et al., 2018 ; Xu et al., 2022 ; Salemi et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025a ; Jiang et al., 2025b ) . A separate measurement shows that demographics explain 1.5% of the variance in how two people respond ( Venkit et al., 2026a ) . Table 1 places each benchmark on five properties.
paragraphs.zh: 三项努力消除了数据中的替换。 AlpsBench 从 WildChat 中整理了 2,500 条长期序列，并基于这些序列评估了七种记忆系统（Xiao 等，2026），这使其成为在数据方面最接近我们工作的先前研究。 PRISM 收集了 1,500 人的反馈，这是该领域最大规模的真实人类偏好数据集（Kirk 等，2024）。 OmniBehavior 和 LUNAR 基于对话之外的真实行为轨迹构建模型（Chen 等，2026b；Zhang 等，2026a），OmniBehavior 报告称，在真实轨迹上评估的模型会趋近于一个平均可接受的人设，并失去长尾分布。 一条并行路线通过 PersonaChat 到 PersonaMem（Zhang 等，2018；Xu 等，2022；Salemi 等，2024；Jiang 等，2025a；Jiang 等，2025b）提供对该人物的书面描述并评分其与该描述的匹配度。 一项独立的测量显示，人口统计学特征可以解释两个人回应方式差异的 1.5%（Venkit 等，2026a）。 表 1 将每个基准测试置于五个属性之下进行比较。

paragraphs.en: RealCompanion releases ten people’s conversations to an AI companion for months, and the corpus is every message they sent. Their traits were never declared in advance, so a system’s account of who each person is can be wrong, and the conversation is there to show where. Which messages mattered was never marked, so a system has to judge for itself when the past is worth reaching for, and that judgment is what we score. Every item names the messages it rests on, so a reader who doubts a label can go find the evidence and argue with it.
paragraphs.zh: RealCompanion 将十个人的数月对话提供给一个 AI 伴侣，而语料库则包含他们发送的每一条消息。 这些人的性格特征从未提前声明，因此系统对每个人身份的描述可能出错，而对话内容正是用来揭示这些偏差所在。 哪些消息具有重要意义也从未被标注，因此系统必须自行判断何时值得回顾过往，而这一判断正是我们评分的依据。 每一项都明确标明了其所依据的消息，因此任何对标签存疑的读者都可以去寻找证据并对此提出质疑。

paragraphs.en: The rest of this paper uses the following terms. A message is one utterance by one party, with a speaker and a timestamp. A participant’s span is the number of calendar days from their first message to their last, and their active days are the days on which they sent at least one. An item is one unit of evaluation, and every item names the messages it rests on, which we call its evidence . Chat items ask for the reply that should follow a given message, and question items ask for a fact about the participant. Each chat item carries a tier , the shape of the context its reply may draw on, and each question item carries a category , the kind of fact it asks for. An item is scoreable when its evidence survived release processing intact. Appendix B traces each line of work to the substitution it makes and what that substitution costs, and states the criteria behind every cell of Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 本文其余部分将使用以下术语。 一条消息是某一方发出的单次发言，包含发话人和时间戳。 参与者的跨度是指从其第一条消息到最后一条消息之间的日历天数，而活跃日则是指其至少发送了一条消息的日期。 一个项目是一个评估单元，每个项目都会明确说明其所依据的消息，这些消息我们称之为其证据。 聊天项目要求给出某条给定消息之后应有的回复，而问题项目则要求提供关于参与者的某个事实。 每个聊天项目都包含一个层级，即其回复可能参考的上下文结构；每个问题项目则包含一个类别，即其所询问的事实类型。 当某个项目的证据在发布处理过程中保持完整时，该项目即为可评分项。 附录 B 追溯了每一项工作的具体替换操作及其带来的成本，并阐明了表 1 中每个单元格所依据的标准。

sents.zh: 当某个项目的证据在发布处理过程中保持完整时，该项目即为可评分项。

sents.en: Appendix B traces each line of work to the substitution it makes and what that substitution costs, and states the criteria behind every cell of Table 1 .
sents.zh: 附录 B 追溯了每一项工作的具体替换操作及其带来的成本，并阐明了表 1 中每个单元格所依据的标准。

paragraphs.en: The corpus records relationships with an AI companion from the first message to the last. The conversations come from the application’s operational store, so every released message stands where the participant sent it. The release is fully anonymized. Every message was rewritten, with direct identifiers replaced by consistent surrogates: the words change, while what the participant said, why they said it and the context it answers are kept. Nobody was recruited to a protocol, so the corpus holds what daily use of a product produced. Table 2 gives the per-participant composition. RealCompanion is designed per relationship. Each participant is a self-contained instance with its own five files, every task is posed within one history, and every result can be reported for one person (Appendix F.6 ). The two heaviest relationships hold 73% of all messages, nearly three times as many as the other eight combined, and supply the depth a longitudinal benchmark exists to test. Depth does not add across people. The eight shorter relationships reflect the lighter use most people make of a companion, and it must understand them from far less of what the person has shared.
paragraphs.zh: 该语料库记录了从第一条消息到最后一条消息与人工智能伴侣之间的关系。 这些对话来自应用程序的运行存储，因此每条已发布消息都保留在参与者发送它的位置。 此次发布完全匿名化。 每条消息都经过改写，直接标识符被一致的替代符取代：词语发生了变化，但参与者所说的内容、他们这么说以及其所处的语境均得以保留。 没有人被招募到任何方案中，因此该语料库记录了产品日常使用所产生的内容。 表2给出了每位参与者的构成情况。 RealCompanion 是围绕每段关系进行设计的。 每位参与者都是一个独立的实例，拥有自己的五个文件；每项任务都在单一对话历史中提出，且每项结果都可以针对一个人进行报告（附录 F.6）。 最重的两段关系包含了所有消息的 73%，几乎是其余八段关系总和的近三倍，并为纵向基准测试提供了深度。 深度不会在不同参与者之间累加。 其余八段较短的关系反映了大多数人使用伴侣时的较轻程度，而系统必须基于用户分享得少得多的信息来理解他们。

paragraphs.en: Understanding is not only remembering what they told you, but also reasoning, organizing the memories, and tracing what that says about them. The profile records what someone stated, and every claim in it carries the messages that establish it, a confidence, and the window over which it held. Extraction is adversarial toward its own output and throws away more than a third of what it proposes, and the claims that later failed audit are kept, so the audit can itself be audited. The persona has no counterpart in prior work, because it holds each reading of a person with the messages behind it and a stated strength, down to named working hypotheses that carry their grounds and how firmly they are held. Every reference either file makes into the conversation resolves, so a reading of a person traces back to what was said and can be contested. That is what makes reply A in Figure 1 a scoreable error. The persona holds only what these ten people revealed. People tell a companion about their family, their health, what is worrying them, and almost never state their census category.
paragraphs.zh: 理解不仅意味着记住他们告诉你的内容，还包括进行推理、整理记忆，并追溯这些信息所揭示的关于他们的情况。 个人档案记录了某人陈述的内容，其中每一项主张都承载着确立该主张的信息、一种自信，以及其有效的时间范围。 提取过程对其自身输出具有对抗性，会丢弃其所提出内容中的三分之一以上，而后来审计失败的主张则被保留下来，以便审计本身也能接受审计。 这种人格模型在以往的研究中并无对应物，因为它将每个人的解读与其背后的信息以及所声明的强度一并保留，甚至包括带有依据和坚定程度的命名工作假设。 每个参考文件对对话的每一次引用都会被解析，因此对一个人的解读可以追溯到具体的发言内容，并且可以被质疑。 正是这一点使得图1中的回复A成为一个可评分的错误。 这种人格模型仅包含这十个人所揭示的内容。 人们会向伴侣讲述自己的家庭、健康状况以及令他们担忧的事情，但几乎从不提及自己的人口普查类别。

paragraphs.en: Knowing someone shows up in what you can say about them and in what you say to them. The corpus scores both. The question track asks the first, across sixteen kinds of fact authored from the profile, and every item names the messages its answer rests on except the 63 marked unanswerable, which name none by design. The chat track asks the second, and it had to be derived. Its probes are user messages taken verbatim, and its reference reply is written under the recorded context, so no item can depend on anything it does not name. Every label carries the reasoning trace that produced it, written in the same call as the decision it explains, and each stage checks against the conversation, so no claim serves as its own warrant. Appendix C specifies the rest: the settings, the schema of each released file, the artifacts of the medium, what the shifted timestamps preserve, the per-subject census behind every macro-average, and how the profiles were built and audited.
paragraphs.zh: 了解某人，既体现在你能关于他们所说的话中，也体现在你对他们所说的话中。语料库对这两方面都进行了评分。 问题轨道关注的是前者，涉及从个人档案中生成的十六种事实类型；每个条目都会说明其答案所依据的信息，但标记为“无法回答”的 63 个条目除外，这些条目按设计不提及任何信息。 聊天轨道关注的是后者，而这一部分必须经过推导得出。 它的探询是逐字引用的用户消息，其参考回复则是在记录好的上下文中撰写的，因此没有任何条目可以依赖其未明确提及的内容。 每个标签都附带了生成该标签的推理过程，这一过程与它所解释的决定在同一调用中一并记录；每个阶段都会与对话内容进行核对，因此没有任何主张能作为自身成立的依据。 附录 C 详细说明了其余内容：相关设置、每个已发布文件的结构、媒介中的具体产物、时间戳偏移所保留的信息、每个宏观平均值背后按主题分类的统计情况，以及个人档案的构建与审核方式。

paragraphs.en: Every label here had to be derived, and a derived label deserves trust only if a reader can check each step. The probes are observed, every label comes from a stated procedure that records each decision it makes, and the finished corpus was graded by an audit that procedure does not control.
paragraphs.zh: 此处的每个标签都必须经过推导，而一个经过推导的标签只有在读者能够验证每一步骤时，才值得信任。 这些探针是受到观察的，每个标签都来自一个明确规定的程序，该程序会记录其做出的每一个决定，而最终的语料库则由该程序无法控制的审计流程进行了评级。

paragraphs.en: An item pairs a probe with the context a correct reply may draw on, a reference reply written from that context alone, and the reasoning trace that produced both. The context lists the messages just before the probe, any claims from the profile, and any specific earlier exchanges. Its shape sets the item’s tier . Preceding messages alone make an item basic , a profile claim makes it intermediate , an earlier exchange makes it hard , and an empty context makes it edge , so the tier can be recomputed from the lists without trusting the label. The locus names where the thing the participant is pointing at lives. Of the 1,533 scoreable items, 1,009 point into the current thread and 120 at nothing prior. The other 404 point outside the thread, to a profile claim (223), an earlier exchange (116) or the companion’s own past behavior (65), and on 167 of them the reference reply uses what it cites, which makes them dependent . Appendix D.3 gives the locus distribution by stratum.
paragraphs.zh: 一个项目将一个问题与正确回答可能依据的背景信息、仅基于该背景信息写成的参考回答，以及生成这两者的推理过程配对。 背景信息列出了问题之前的消息、个人资料中的任何主张，以及任何特定的早期交流。 其形状决定了该项目的层级。 仅凭前面的消息会使一个项目成为基础型，个人资料中的主张会使其成为中间型，早期的交流会使其成为困难型，而空白的背景信息会使其成为边缘型，因此无需依赖标签，仅根据列表即可重新计算层级。 定位点指明了参与者所指代的事物所处的位置。 在 1,533 个可评分的项目中，有 1,009 项指向当前对话线程，120 项则不指向任何先前内容。 其余 404 项指向线程之外的内容，包括个人资料中的主张（223 项）、早期的交流（116 项）或同伴自身的过往行为（65 项），其中 167 项的参考回答使用了其所引用的内容，这使它们成为依赖型项目。 附录 D.3 按层级给出了定位点的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Every probe is a message a participant sent, taken verbatim from source , and nothing is rewritten, paraphrased or authored. Choosing which messages to use poses a problem, because messages that need the past are rare. In a random sample only 3.4% of items need anything outside the current thread, which leaves 40 items to study. The probes come in three strata, and each answers one question. The proportional stratum is that random sample, 1,169 scoreable items drawn from every participant, and it alone answers how often the past is needed (condition V3 of Appendix A.4 ). The enriched stratum answers what a system does when the past is needed. The abstention control answers whether a system holds back when nothing is needed. Its 434 session openers need nothing prior, and a benchmark on which retrieval helps cannot detect a system that retrieves too much.
paragraphs.zh: 每个探针都是参与者发送的一条消息，均逐字摘自原始资料，没有任何内容被改写、转述或重新创作。 选择使用哪些消息会构成一个问题，因为需要参考过往消息的情况十分罕见。 在一个随机样本中，仅有 3.4% 的项目需要当前对话线程之外的信息，因此剩下可供研究的项目为 40 个。 探针分为三个层级，每个层级都用于回答一个问题。 比例层即该随机样本，包含从每位参与者中抽取的 1,169 个可评分项目，仅通过它就能回答“需要参考过往信息的频率”这一问题（附录 A.4 中的条件 V3）。 增强层用于回答系统在需要参考过往信息时会采取何种行动。 弃权对照组用于回答系统在无需任何信息时是否会选择保留不操作。 该组包含的 434 个会话开端消息无需任何前置信息，而一个以信息检索为衡量标准的基准也无法检测出过度检索的系统。

sents.zh: 该组包含的 434 个会话开端消息无需任何前置信息，而一个以信息检索为衡量标准的基准也无法检测出过度检索的系统。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the five stages. Stage A resolves what the probe points at and names the store it would live in. Stage B retrieves candidate records for that referent and checks each against source , dropping what fails. Stage C assigns the tier and category by one of nineteen fixed rules and records the rule that fired. Stage D writes the reference reply and names the messages it rests on. Stage E checks that the reply is supported by its evidence and that the category fits, and demotes the item when either check fails. Each stage reads only what the stages before it wrote, and writes its decision and its reason in the same call, so no rationale is reconstructed after the decision it explains. That record is the item’s reasoning trace. Appendix D.1 states what each stage may and may not revise.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了五个阶段。 阶段 A 确定探针所指的内容，并命名其将存储的仓库。 阶段 B 检索该指代对象的相关候选记录，并将每条记录与源数据比对，淘汰不符合的记录。 阶段 C 根据十九项固定规则中的某一条分配层级和类别，并记录触发该规则的具体规则。 阶段 D 编写参考回复，并注明其依赖的消息。 阶段 E 检查回复是否由证据充分支持且类别是否匹配；若任一检查失败，则降级该项目。 每个阶段仅读取前一个阶段所写入的内容，并在同一调用中记录其决策及理由，因此无需在决策产生后重新构建其解释依据。 该记录即为项目的推理轨迹。 附录 D.1 说明了每个阶段可以或不可以修改的内容。

paragraphs.en: A label can go wrong in three ways, and the order of the stages closes each one. The first is invented evidence. By Stage B, an invented profile claim cannot confirm a probe and enter the gold as a memory a system is expected to retrieve (V5). The second is a reply that depends on something the item does not name. By Stage D, the context is sufficient by construction, and the gap between the oracle condition and any retriever measures retrieval alone (V1). The recorded grounding confirms it. Because this reply is constructed, the reply the participant actually received is kept as well, as the message after each probe in source , so every result can be re-run against it. The third is an error that makes memory look more needed than it is. Verification can remove a reference and never add one, so a verification error can only lower the demand rate (V6, Proposition 1 ). Three invariants confirm that the ordering held on every item: every identifier the four derived files cite resolves to a message in source , no item cites a message after its own probe, and the tier recomputes from the lists.
paragraphs.zh: 标签可能以三种方式出错，而这些阶段的顺序会逐一排除每种情况。 第一种是捏造的证据。 到了阶段 B，一个捏造的配置文件声明无法确认一次探测，也无法作为系统预期检索的记忆进入黄金数据（V5）。 第二种是依赖于某个项目未提及内容的回复。 到了阶段 D，根据构造方式，上下文已经足够，而预言机条件与任何检索器之间的差距仅衡量检索本身（V1）。 已记录的根基确认了这一点。 由于这个回复是构造出来的，参与者实际收到的回复也会被保留，作为源数据中每次探测后的消息，因此每个结果都可以与之重新运行对比。 第三种是一种错误，它使记忆看起来比实际更需要。 验证只能移除引用，而绝不会添加引用，因此验证错误只会降低需求率（V6，命题 1）。 三个不变量证实了这一顺序适用于每个项目：四个派生文件引用的每个标识符都对应源数据中的消息，没有任何项目引用自己探测之后的消息，并且层级会根据列表重新计算。

paragraphs.en: The derivation discarded much of what it first proposed. Stage A proposed a distant referent for 806 of the unused messages, and stage B verified 422. In its final pass stage B matched 1,544 profile claims to referents and kept 752, dropping those whose evidence did not support the referent. The final tier differs from the pre-verification signal on 685 of the 1,533 items. That signal is a surface guess a cheap retrieval gate would make, and it is wrong on nearly half the items (Appendix A.3 ). Appendix D gives the full derivation: what each stage may revise, how the probes were sampled, the on-screen judgment, every withdrawal and repair, the release gates, and the audit of both tracks.
paragraphs.zh: 该推导过程舍弃了最初提出的大部分内容。 A 阶段为 806 条未使用的消息指定了一个遥远的指代对象，B 阶段则验证了其中 422 条。 在最终处理中，B 阶段将 1,544 个个人资料声明与指代对象进行匹配，保留了 752 个，并排除了那些证据无法支持该指代对象的情况。 最终层级在 1,533 个项目中与验证前的信号存在 685 处差异。 该信号只是一个表层猜测，是廉价检索机制会做出的判断，且在近一半的项目中都是错误的（附录 A.3）。 附录 D 提供了完整的推导过程：每个阶段可能如何修订、探针是如何采样的、屏幕上的判断、每一次撤回与修正、释放门控机制，以及对两条路径的审计结果。

paragraphs.en: RealCompanion benchmarks the two questions about a person that Section 1 separates. The first is who the participant is. The reconstruction track tests it: a system reads the participant’s full history and writes the profile and persona files. The second is which of the things they have said bears on the message in front of a system. The chat and question tracks test it by scoring whether a system reaches for the past at all, which earlier messages it finds, and what its reply makes of them. The reasoning trace of Section 4 records how each chat label was decided, and the chat track reads its outputs: the reference set, whether memory is needed, the tier and the reference reply. Table 3 summarizes the three tracks.
paragraphs.zh: RealCompanion 对第 1 节中区分开的两个关于个人的问题进行了基准测试。 第一个问题是参与者是谁。 重建流程对此进行了测试：一个系统读取参与者的完整历史记录，并生成个人资料和角色设定文件。 第二个问题是，他们所说的哪些内容会影响系统面前的信息。 聊天和提问流程通过评分来测试这一点，即判断系统是否会参考过往信息、找到哪些较早的信息，以及其回复如何解读这些信息。 第 4 节的推理轨迹记录了每个聊天标签是如何决定的，而聊天流程则读取其输出：参考集、是否需要记忆、层级以及参考回复。 表 3 总结了这三种流程。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark covers ten relationships with one companion application, each 36 to 120 days long, and every chat probe is a message the participant actually sent. On the second question it scores three decisions: restraint, retrieval, and application. Empathy, the prediction of future behavior, and a person’s values are out of scope. Chat and question rates are reported pooled over items with the macro-average over participants beside them, and comparisons carry a bootstrap over participants. Rates of occurrence come from the proportional stratum alone, and comparisons are reported on it.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试涵盖与一个辅助应用程序的十种关系，每种关系的持续时间为 36 至 120 天，且每次聊天探测都是参与者实际发送的消息。 在第二个问题中，它评估三项决策：克制、检索和应用。 同理心、对未来行为的预测以及个人价值观不在测试范围内。 聊天和问题的发生率是结合各项数据与参与者的宏观平均值共同报告的，而比较则基于参与者进行自助抽样分析。 发生率的统计仅来自比例分层数据，相关比较也基于该分层数据进行报告。

paragraphs.en: Five methods run over both tracks: Random ; Recency , which returns the k k messages preceding the probe and performs no retrieval; Recency-user , which returns the user’s own preceding messages and so separates adjacency from speaker; BM25 ; and Oracle , which returns the labeled gold set. Each method sees one participant’s history at a time. Three controls substitute a different gold set and rescore every method against it: offset permuted preserves the distances from probe to gold and destroys the content relation, position randomized destroys both, and broken oracle supplies messages known to lie outside the gold set and must score zero.
paragraphs.zh: 五种方法在两条轨道上运行：Random；Recency，它返回查询前的 k 条消息且不做检索；Recency-user，它返回用户自己的先前消息，从而将邻近性与说话者区分开来；BM25；以及 Oracle，它返回带标签的黄金数据集。 每种方法每次只查看一位参与者的历史记录。 三种对照方法使用不同的黄金数据集并据此重新评分所有方法：offset permuted 保留了查询到黄金数据点的距离但破坏了内容关联，position randomized 破坏了两者，而 broken oracle 提供了已知位于黄金数据集之外的消息，其得分必须为零。

paragraphs.en: One generator answers every probe under five conditions that differ only in what precedes the probe in its input. Every message is shown truncated to 220 characters. C0 supplies the probe alone, C1 the three preceding messages, C2, the oracle condition, the messages the item records as required, C3 the ten highest-scoring BM25 messages preceding the probe, and C4 the ten preceding messages. C2 against C1 asks what the recorded memory adds to the recent thread, and Section 6 splits that difference by whether the probe needed memory (Proposition 2 ). C3 against C4 prices an imperfect retriever against recency at an equal budget of ten messages. As shipped these two also differ in how the block is labeled and in whether it is ordered by score or by time, so a matched pair, C3m and C4m, repeats both under one neutral label in chronological order, and Section 6 reports the matched difference.
paragraphs.zh: 每个生成器在五种条件下回答每一个查询，这些条件仅在于输入中查询之前的内容不同。 每条消息都显示为截断至 220 个字符。 C0 仅提供查询本身，C1 提供三条前导消息，C2 是“神谕”条件，即该条目按需求记录的消息，C3 是查询之前得分最高的十条 BM25 消息，而 C4 则是十条前导消息。 C2 与 C1 的对比旨在探究记录的记忆为近期对话线程增添了什么，而第 6 节则根据查询是否需要记忆来区分这种差异（命题 2）。 C3 与 C4 的对比，是在十个消息的相同预算下，对不完美的检索器与时效性进行权衡。 在默认设置下，这两者还因分块的标签方式以及是否按得分或时间排序而不同；因此，一个匹配的对 C3m 和 C4m 会在单一的中性标签下以时间顺序重复呈现这两种情况，第 6 节报告了这种匹配后的差异。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval is scored by whether a required message appears in the top k k , and by MRR. Recall over the whole gold set is reported in the appendix, where an item citing more than k k messages cannot reach one. Responses are scored by content match against the reference, by restraint, and by evidence coverage, which uses no judge and cross-checks the other two. One minus restraint, on the 1,129 items with an empty reference set, is the misfire rate of Yoon et al. (2026) ; the fraction of memory-bearing items whose response draws on the past is that work’s appropriate application rate. We report both, because neither constrains the other. Whether memory is needed at all is scored twice, by abstention on the unanswerable questions and the cold opens and by the area under the ROC curve of a lexical score and of a detector model shown the probe and its three preceding messages, the latter on the proportional stratum alone since every enriched item carries a reference by construction. One judge scores the five conditions in a single call, and the matched pair the same way so that they are ranked against one another. Appendix E specifies the protocol: the context ablation ( E.1 ), the retrieval controls ( E.2 ) and baselines ( E.3 ), the response judge and its agreement with human adjudication ( E.4 ), how each quantity is computed ( E.5 ), and the models behind each role ( E.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 检索的评分依据是所需信息是否出现在前 k 个结果中，以及 MRR。整个黄金数据集的召回率见附录；其中，引用超过 k 条信息的条目无法达到 1。响应的评分依据包括与参考回答的内容匹配度、克制程度以及证据覆盖度——后者无需裁判，而是通过交叉验证前两种评分标准得出。在 1,129 个参考集为空的条目中，“1 减去克制程度”即为 Yoon 等人（2026）提出的“失误率”；而记忆承载条目中，其响应依赖过往信息的比例则是该研究中的“适当应用率”。我们同时报告这两个指标，因为二者互不约束。是否需要使用记忆本身也被两次评分：一次是通过无法回答的问题和冷启动任务中的弃权情况；另一次则是通过词汇分数与检测模型在 ROC 曲线下面积的计算——后者仅针对比例分层，因为每个增强条目根据构造必然包含参考信息。一名裁判在一次评估中同时对五种条件进行评分，匹配对也以相同方式处理，以便相互排序。附录 E 详细说明了相关流程：上下文消融（E.1）、检索控制（E.2）与基线模型（E.3）、响应裁判及其与人类裁决的一致性（E.4）、各项指标的计算方法（E.5），以及各角色所依赖的模型（E.6）。

paragraphs.en: Three agent systems, Claude Opus 5.5, Codex GPT-5.6-sol and Antigravity running Gemini 3.8 Flash, each run three times on each of the ten participants. Each field is scored by exact match, presence or recall according to its type (Appendix G ). F1 is computed per run over the fields that either the run or the released file fills, pooled over the ten participants, and averaged over the three runs. Run agreement is the same overlap between two runs of one system, so a difference that the runs share is systematic rather than noise.
paragraphs.zh: 三种智能体系统——Claude Opus 5.5、Codex GPT-5.6-sol 和运行 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 Antigravity——每种系统对十名参与者中的每一位都运行三次。 每个字段根据类型（附录 G）按精确匹配、存在性或召回率进行评分。 F1 值按每次运行计算，涵盖该次运行或已发布文件所填写的字段，在十名参与者中汇总，并在三次运行中取平均值。 运行一致性是指同一系统两次运行之间的重叠部分，因此运行间的差异属于系统性因素，而非噪声。

Two readings run throughout: the recorded reading keeps all 404 memory-bearing probes, 40 proportional and 364 enriched. The strict reading removes the 154 whose referent is visible on screen (Appendix C.7 ). Each result is reported by population, because a pooled number reports the corpus composition of as much as the capability (Proposition 2 ).

paragraphs.en: Memory is required far less often than benchmark construction implies. On the natural-rate stratum, 3.4% [2.5, 4.6] of the messages participants sent carry a verified memory demand under the recorded reading and 1.3% [0.8, 2.1] under the strict one. Verification is monotone, so each of these bounds the true rate from below (Proposition 1 ), and two procedures over the 11,369 participant messages outside that sample agree. The census of Section 4 gives 3.2% [2.9, 3.5] and a re-reading of it under the Stage B instruction gives 1.73% [1.45, 2.06] (Appendix F.1 ). The requirement is also uneven. Three of the ten participants contribute no memory-bearing item under the recorded reading, and five under the strict one. Memory demand is a property of relationship depth.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆需求出现的频率远低于基准构建所暗示的情况。 在自然速率层级中，参与者发送的消息里，3.4% [2.5, 4.6] 包含经验证的记忆需求（在记录式解读下），而严格解读下则为 1.3% [0.8, 2.1]。 验证具有单调性，因此这些界限均从下方界定了真实速率（命题 1），并且针对该样本之外 11,369 条参与者消息的两种程序结果一致。 第 4 节的普查结果显示为 3.2% [2.9, 3.5]，而根据 B 阶段指令重新解读的结果则为 1.73% [1.45, 2.06]（附录 F.1）。 这种需求分布也不均匀。 在十名参与者中，有三人在记录式解读下未提供任何承载记忆的项目，而在严格解读下则有五人未提供。 记忆需求是关系深度的一个属性。

paragraphs.en: When a message draws on the past, the material it needs usually sits far back. The furthest message a memory-bearing probe requires sits a median of 2,157 messages back, with an upper quartile of 5,114 and a maximum of 12,542. Even the nearest required message sits a median of 450 messages back. The length of the relationship fixes the horizon a system must cover.
paragraphs.zh: 当一条信息需要依赖过往内容时，它所需的信息通常位于很远的地方。 一个携带记忆的智能体所需的最远信息，其位置中位数为 2,157 条信息之前，上四分位为 5,114，最大值为 12,542。 即使是最近的一条所需信息，其位置中位数也在 450 条信息之前。 关系的长度决定了系统必须覆盖的范围。

paragraphs.en: Locating that material defeats the scorers a memory system usually reaches for. Table 4 reports how often a required message appears in the top five for the distant items. Recency, the order a sliding context window imposes, finds one for 0.022 of them against 0.005 for a random ranking, and for none once on-screen referents are removed (Appendix E.2 ). Lexical matching finds one eleven times as often, at 0.248, and still misses three in four. The broken oracle scores 0.000 throughout, as a control must. Pooling reverses this order. Over the 1,477 chat probes with a reference set, of which 72.6% are answerable from the recent thread, recency finds a required message for 0.959 of them and lexical matching for 0.236. Lexical matching barely moves between the two populations, while recency falls by a factor of forty. A pooled retrieval score reports the composition of the corpus. Coverage of the required message rises with the context budget, from 0.109 at 8k tokens to 0.453 at 128k and 1.000 at one million, where every history fits (Figure 4 , Appendix F.3 ). What a model does with the context it is given is a separate question, and the next three results answer it.
paragraphs.zh: 找到该材料会挫败评分系统通常依赖的记忆机制。 表 4 报告了所需消息在远距离项目中出现在前五名的频率。 近期性（滑动上下文窗口所施加的顺序）在 0.022 的案例中找到了所需消息，而随机排序仅为 0.005；一旦屏幕上的参照物被移除，则完全找不到（附录 E.2）。 词汇匹配找到所需消息的频率是前者的十一倍，达到 0.248，但仍会在四分之一的情况下失败。 故障神谕在整个过程中得分均为 0.000，正如对照组应有的结果。 合并处理会逆转这一顺序。 在包含参照集的 1,477 次聊天查询中（其中 72.6% 可通过近期对话线程回答），近期性在 0.959 的案例中找到了所需消息，而词汇匹配仅为 0.236。 词汇匹配在这两个群体之间的表现几乎没有变化，而近期性的效果则下降了四十倍。 合并检索得分反映了语料库的构成。 所需消息的覆盖范围随上下文预算的增加而提升：从 8k 词元时的 0.109，到 128k 词元时的 0.453，再到每百万词元时（此时所有历史内容均可容纳）的 1.000（图 4，附录 F.3）。 模型如何处理所提供的上下文是一个独立的问题，接下来的三个结果将对此作出解答。

paragraphs.en: Supplying context helps, and most of the help reaches probes that need no memory. Table 5 reports mean content match, on a 0 to 2 scale, over the 1,533 scoreable probes of both strata. Every contrast below is a mean of per-probe differences. Replacing the last three messages (C1) with the recorded messages (C2) raises content match by + 0.140 +0.140 [0.126, 0.167] over both strata and by + 0.108 +0.108 [0.077, 0.159] on the proportional stratum. Write π \pi for the share of proportional probes that need memory, and γ 1 \gamma_{1} and γ 0 \gamma_{0} for the gain on probes that do and do not. The proportional gain splits into π ​ γ 1 = + 0.004 \pi\gamma_{1}=+0.004 and ( 1 − π ) ​ γ 0 = + 0.104 (1-\pi)\gamma_{0}=+0.104 , so 96% of it lands on probes that need no memory. On the 167 items whose reference reply depends on the recorded messages, the same replacement is worth + 0.455 +0.455 [0.319, 0.588]. Proposition 2 predicts this. Where demand is rare, a pooled ablation difference measures the composition of the corpus as much as the use of memory, and only the split recovers the second. Which messages are supplied matters as much as how many. With budget, heading and order held fixed (C3m and C4m, Appendix E.1 ), ten messages chosen by BM25 score 0.189 [0.156, 0.247] below the ten preceding ones, and in Table 5 they match no context at all (1.426 against 1.431). The strict reading strengthens this, raising the gain on intermediate items from 0.039 [ − 0.040 -0.040 , 0.108] to 0.106 [0.017, 0.196], an interval that excludes zero only under the stricter reading.
paragraphs.zh: 提供上下文会有所帮助，而大部分帮助都作用于无需记忆的智能体探测。 表5报告了两个分层中1,533个可评分探测的平均内容匹配度（0至2分制）。 以下所有对比均为每个探测差异的平均值。 将最后三条消息（C1）替换为已记录的消息（C2），在两个分层中使内容匹配度提升+0.140 +0.140 [0.126, 0.167]，在比例分层中提升+0.108 +0.108 [0.077, 0.159]。 用 π \pi 表示需要记忆的比例性探测所占份额，用 γ 1 \gamma_{1} 和 γ 0 \gamma_{0} 分别表示需要记忆和无需记忆的探测所获得的增益。 比例性增益分解为 π ​ γ 1 = + 0.004 \pi\gamma_{1}=+0.004 和 ( 1 − π ) ​ γ 0 = + 0.104 (1-\pi)\gamma_{0}=+0.104，因此其中96%的增益都落在了无需记忆的智能体探测上。 在167个参考回复依赖于已记录消息的项目中，同样的替换可使增益提升+0.455 +0.455 [0.319, 0.588]。 命题2对此做出了预测。 当需求稀少时，合并式消融差异所衡量的内容既反映了语料库的构成，也反映了记忆的使用情况，而只有通过拆分才能单独恢复后者的影响。 提供哪些消息与提供多少消息同样重要。 在预算、标题和顺序保持不变的情况下（C3m和C4m，附录E.1），由BM25选出的十条消息得分比前十条低0.189 [0.156, 0.247]，而在表5中，它们与上下文完全不匹配（1.426对比1.431）。 严格解读进一步强化了这一结论，它将中间项目的增益从0.039 [ − 0.040 -0.040 , 0.108] 提高到了0.106 [0.017, 0.196]，这一区间仅在严格解读下排除了零值。

sents.en: Supplying context helps, and most of the help reaches probes that need no memory.
sents.zh: 提供上下文会有所帮助，而大部分帮助都作用于无需记忆的智能体探测。

sents.en: Table 5 reports mean content match, on a 0 to 2 scale, over the 1,533 scoreable probes of both strata.
sents.zh: 表5报告了两个分层中1,533个可评分探测的平均内容匹配度（0至2分制）。

paragraphs.en: The decision to look is where systems fail. On the proportional stratum, where memory is needed at its natural rate, a detector that reads the probe and its three preceding messages separates the cases at chance. Its AUROC is 0.530 [0.488, 0.572] against probes whose referent is absent and 0.548 [0.488, 0.609] against cold opens. Scored against its own target it reaches 0.601 [0.527, 0.676], and its threshold then catches 6 of the 40 probes that need memory while raising 40 false alarms. Authored questions are easier to sort. A detector shown three retrieved messages reaches 0.802 [0.742, 0.857] on the question track against 0.546 [0.490, 0.605] on chat probes, and a keyword scorer’s own confidence reaches 0.696 [0.629, 0.758]. An authored question shares more words with its evidence than a message sent in conversation does.
paragraphs.zh: 做出查看的决定正是系统失效之处。 在需要以其自然速率使用记忆的比例层中，一个能够读取探测信号及其前三个消息的探测器，只能以随机概率区分不同情况。 对于参考对象缺失的探测信号，其 AUROC 为 0.530 [0.488, 0.572]；对于冷启动探测信号，则为 0.548 [0.488, 0.609]。 在与自身目标对比时，其得分达到 0.601 [0.527, 0.676]，此时其阈值能够识别出 40 个需要记忆的探测信号中的 6 个，但同时也产生了 40 次误报。 人工撰写的提问更容易分类。 一个展示了三个检索消息的探测器，在提问轨道上的得分达到 0.802 [0.742, 0.857]，而在聊天探测信号上仅为 0.546 [0.490, 0.605]；关键词评分器的自身置信度则达到 0.696 [0.629, 0.758]。 人工撰写的提问与其证据共享的词语比对话中发送的消息更多。

paragraphs.en: Given no context, models never reach for a past that is absent. Across the 434 cold opens and the 120 probes whose verified locus is none , the misfire rate without context is zero. With context supplied, it rises to 29.2% when the messages were selected for the probe and to 60.8% when ten were supplied without regard to it (Appendix F.5 ). Framing drives the decision. Labeling the same ten messages retrieved memories instead of earlier turns from this chat raises memory use by ten to fourteen points on every population we test, including probes that need no memory. Relabeling a recency window the same way changes nothing the intervals separate. C2 and C1 in Table 5 also carry different headings, so their contrasts include whatever the heading adds, which we do not separate.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有上下文的情况下，模型绝不会去调用一个并不存在的过往。 在 434 次冷启动和 120 个经证实无定位点的探针中，缺乏上下文时的失误率为零。 当提供上下文时，该比率会升至 29.2%（若消息是为探针而选），以及 60.8%（若随意提供十条消息，不考虑其相关性）（附录 F.5）。 框架决定了决策。 将检索到的相同十条消息标记为记忆，而非将其视为本次对话中更早的回合，会使每个测试群体中的记忆使用量增加十到十四点，包括那些无需记忆的探针。 以同样的方式重新标记最近窗口并不会改变任何由时间间隔所分隔的内容。 表 5 中的 C2 和 C1 也使用了不同的标题，因此它们的对比包含了标题所带来的任何附加影响，而这一点我们并未单独区分。

paragraphs.en: Three agent systems read each participant’s full history and wrote the persona file, three runs each over the ten participants (Table 6 ). All three reach an F1 of 0.69 to 0.70 while the tokens they process differ about thirtyfold, and each agrees with its own repeated runs at 0.93 to 0.95. They also agree with one another at 0.86 to 0.88, well above their agreement with the file, although they span a frontier and a flash-tier model: scale does not close the gap. Precision of 0.56 to 0.59 against recall of 0.86 to 0.89 means a system recovers what the file holds.
paragraphs.zh: 三个智能体系统读取了每位参与者的完整历史记录并编写了人物档案文件，每个系统对十位参与者各运行三次（表 6）。 三者均达到了 0.69 至 0.70 的 F1 值，但它们处理的标记数量相差约三十倍，且每个系统与自身重复运行的结果一致度为 0.93 至 0.95。 它们彼此之间的一致度也为 0.86 至 0.88，远高于与档案文件的一致度，尽管其中一个模型处于前沿水平，另一个则属于闪电级模型：规模差异并未缩小这一差距。 精确率为 0.56 至 0.59，召回率为 0.86 至 0.89，这意味着该系统能够恢复档案文件中包含的内容。

paragraphs.en: RealCompanion releases ten real relationships between people and an AI companion, and every chat item carries the reasoning trace that produced it, checked against the conversation it came from. The past is rarely needed and, when it is, far away: 3.4% of sampled messages reach outside the current thread, a median of 2,157 messages back, and the demand concentrates in the longest relationships. Where it is needed, supplying the recorded evidence raises content match by 0.455, yet no system we evaluate decides when to reach back, and no detector we tried tells the two situations apart on real messages. On who the person is, three agent systems reconstruct the persona with the same F1 at a 31-fold difference in cost, and all three add about seventy to eighty further fields for every hundred they recover. Unlike an authored corpus, RealCompanion knows how often memory is actually required.
paragraphs.zh: RealCompanion 揭示了人与 AI 伴侣之间的十种真实关系，且每个聊天条目都附带了生成该条目的推理过程，并可与原始对话进行核对。 过去很少被需要，即使需要，也往往遥不可及：在采样的消息中，有 3.4% 的消息追溯到了当前对话线程之外，其中位数是 2,157 条消息之前，且这种需求主要集中在关系最长的对话中。 在确实需要追溯时，提供记录下来的证据能将内容匹配度提升 0.455，但我们评估的系统中没有哪一个能决定何时需要追溯过去，我们尝试的也没有任何检测器能在真实消息中区分这两种情况。 在还原人物身份方面，三种智能体系统以成本相差 31 倍的结果实现了相同的 F1 值，并且这三种系统在每恢复一百个特征字段时，都会额外添加大约七十个到八十個字段。 与人工编写的语料库不同，RealCompanion 知道记忆实际上被需要的是多么频繁。

paragraphs.en: Language models are research instruments in this work, and each use is disclosed with its check. They run stages A, D and E of the derivation (Section 4 ), generate and judge the replies of Section 5 , audit both tracks, and are the systems the reconstruction track evaluates; every per-stage decision ships in the released items. They also produced parts of the released data: the anonymization rewrote every message with a model, the question track was built with one, and the persona and profile layers were generated by a model pipeline and then reviewed by hand (Appendices D.8 and H ). We did not take their output on trust. Twenty-six release gates and five families of mechanical check run over the corpus without a model, an independent model graded what the derivation produced, and where an instrument overstated itself we report it. We also used AI assistants to write and debug code, give feedback on experimental design, help interpret results, search for related work, check references, and draft and edit prose. Every number was recomputed by script, every sentence was read and revised by an author, and the authors take full responsibility for the content.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型是这项工作中的研究工具，每次使用都附有相应的核查说明。 它们执行推导过程的 A、D 和 E 阶段（第 4 节），生成并评判第 5 节的回复，审计两条路径，并且是重建路径所评估的系统；每个阶段的决策都会包含在已发布的内容中。 它们还生成了部分已发布的数据：匿名化过程使用模型重写了每条消息，问题路径是用一个模型构建的，而角色和资料层则由模型流程生成，随后由人工审核（附录 D.8 和 H）。 我们没有盲目信任它们的输出结果。 26 个发布关卡和 5 类机械核查流程无需模型即可对整个语料库运行；一个独立模型对推导过程产生的内容进行了评级；如果某个工具夸大了自身能力，我们也会如实报告。 我们还使用人工智能助手来编写和调试代码、提供实验设计反馈、协助解读结果、搜索相关研究、核查参考文献，以及起草和编辑文本。 每个数字都通过脚本重新计算，每句话都由作者阅读并修订，作者对全部内容承担全部责任。

paragraphs.en: The conversations are by ten people using a companion application for their own purposes; all consented to research use and release. Every released file is anonymized: account identifiers, contact details, names and named entities are replaced with consistent surrogates across all five files, and what remains is what each participant said and the context it answers, in rewritten words, with the interaction structure, session rhythm and communicative style on which this research depends. The corpus contains material falling within the special categories of Article 9 of the GDPR ( European Parliament and Council of the European Union, 2016 ) , and necessarily so: a reply that ignores what someone has said about their health is not the correct reply, and a benchmark that stripped such material would measure a different task while claiming to measure this one. Processing rests on each participant’s explicit consent to research use and release, the basis Article 9(2)(a) provides for special-category data. The study and the release were approved by the data operator’s internal ethics committee under its privacy policy and terms of service; that committee is not independent of the operator, and no institutional review board was involved. Given a sample of a participant’s writing and the ten released histories, a stylometric classifier using no content words matches them at 83.0% and a language model at 98.0%, against a chance rate of 10%; the statistical adversary needs volume, and the language model does not. Removing identifiers does not remove authorship, and that is a property of conversational text. We report the measurement because a corpus described as anonymized without one is describing an assumption. The release terms prohibit profiling, identifying or targeting any individual, and any commercial use (Appendix H.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些对话由十人使用一款配套应用程序为各自目的进行；所有参与者均同意用于研究并公开。 每份已公开的文件都经过匿名化处理：账户标识符、联系方式、姓名和命名实体在所有五份文件中均被替换为一致的替代符号，而保留的内容则是每位参与者的发言及其回答的上下文，以改写后的文字呈现，同时保留了本研究所依赖的互动结构、会话节奏和交流风格。 该语料库包含属于《通用数据保护条例》（欧洲议会和欧盟理事会，2016年）第9条特殊类别的数据，且必然如此：若回复忽略他人关于自身健康的陈述，则并非正确回应；而若基准测试剥离此类内容，则实际上衡量的是另一项任务，却声称衡量的是当前任务。 数据处理基于每位参与者对研究使用和公开所给予的明确同意，这也是第9条第2款（a）项为特殊类别数据提供的依据。 该研究及数据公开行为已获数据运营方内部伦理委员会根据隐私政策和服务条款批准；该委员会并非独立于运营方，且未涉及任何机构审查委员会。 给定某位参与者的写作样本及十份已公开的对话记录，一个不使用内容词的文体计量分类器能将其匹配正确率提升至83.0%，语言模型则可达98.0%，而随机匹配率为10%；统计对抗方法需要大量数据，而语言模型则不需要。 移除标识符并不会消除作者身份，而这是对话文本的一项固有属性。 我们报告这一测量结果，是因为一个声称已匿名化却未提供证据的语料库，实际上只是在陈述一种假设。 公开条款禁止对任何个人进行画像、识别或定向操作，也禁止任何商业用途（附录H.5）。

sents.en: The conversations are by ten people using a companion application for their own purposes; all consented to research use and release.
sents.zh: 这些对话由十人使用一款配套应用程序为各自目的进行；所有参与者均同意用于研究并公开。

sents.en: Every released file is anonymized: account identifiers, contact details, names and named entities are replaced with consistent surrogates across all five files, and what remains is what each participant said and the context it answers, in rewritten words, with the interaction structure, session rhythm and communicative style on which this research depends.
sents.zh: 每份已公开的文件都经过匿名化处理：账户标识符、联系方式、姓名和命名实体在所有五份文件中均被替换为一致的替代符号，而保留的内容则是每位参与者的发言及其回答的上下文，以改写后的文字呈现，同时保留了本研究所依赖的互动结构、会话节奏和交流风格。

sents.en: Processing rests on each participant’s explicit consent to research use and release, the basis Article 9(2)(a) provides for special-category data.
sents.zh: 数据处理基于每位参与者对研究使用和公开所给予的明确同意，这也是第9条第2款（a）项为特殊类别数据提供的依据。

sents.en: The study and the release were approved by the data operator’s internal ethics committee under its privacy policy and terms of service; that committee is not independent of the operator, and no institutional review board was involved.

sents.en: Given a sample of a participant’s writing and the ten released histories, a stylometric classifier using no content words matches them at 83.0% and a language model at 98.0%, against a chance rate of 10%; the statistical adversary needs volume, and the language model does not.

sents.en: Removing identifiers does not remove authorship, and that is a property of conversational text.
sents.zh: 移除标识符并不会消除作者身份，而这是对话文本的一项固有属性。

sents.en: We report the measurement because a corpus described as anonymized without one is describing an assumption.

paragraphs.en: The task is defined over a record of one person, independently of how that record was obtained. A subject record is a pair ( M , 𝒮 ) (M,\mathcal{S}) . The stream M = ( m 1 , … , m N ) M=(m_{1},\ldots,m_{N}) is a sequence of messages ordered in time, each carrying a sender, a timestamp, and its text, with senders partitioned into those attributable to the person and those attributable to anything else. The family 𝒮 = { S 1 , … , S L } \mathcal{S}=\{S_{1},\ldots,S_{L}\} is a finite set of stores , each a set of records derived from M M and each standing for one place a system might look for something the person said before; for RealCompanion, L = 2 L=2 , the profile claims and, as the episode store, the messages of M M themselves. An instance of the task is a finite collection of subject records together with the annotation defined below. RealCompanion is one instance; Appendix C describes it, and Appendix A.4 states the conditions any instance must satisfy.

The reference set names the records the gold response used and nothing else. It is disjoint from the recorded window by construction, and whether a referent was on screen in a wider sense is a separate judgment, recorded per probe in Appendix D.4 .

paragraphs.en: The annotation is required to satisfy one axiom, which is what makes a failure attributable to a system:
paragraphs.zh: 该标注必须满足一条公理，而正是这一点使得失败可以归因于系统：

paragraphs.en: The conditioning is on the triple and not on R ⁡ ( p ) R(p) alone, because a gold response is always entitled to use the probe itself and the messages of the recorded window. An instance that violates ( 1 ) is asking for a response that cannot be produced from what it supplies, and no score computed on it is interpretable. Derivable means that a procedure shown only the triple can produce g ⁡ ( p ) g(p) , which is how stage D writes it. On RealCompanion the check is mechanical: the stage D grounding citations name a message outside the recorded context on 419 of the 1,533 scoreable items, and on every one of them that message is the probe itself.
paragraphs.zh: 条件约束基于三元组，而不仅仅是 R⁡(p) R(p)，因为黄金响应始终有权使用探针本身以及记录窗口中的消息。 违反 (1) 的一个实例是要求一个无法根据所提供信息生成的响应，此时基于该响应的任何分数计算都不可解释。 “可推导”意味着仅向某个过程展示三元组就能生成 g⁡(p) g(p)，而阶段 D 正是通过这种方式写入该结果的。 在 RealCompanion 中，这一检查是机械性的：阶段 D 的 grounding 引用在 1,533 个可评分项中的第 419 项提到了记录上下文之外的消息，而在所有这些项中，该消息都是探针本身。

paragraphs.en: Three decisions are evaluated, in this order because each is defined on the output of the last. Restraint is the prediction ρ ^ ​ ( p ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } \hat{\rho}(p)\in\{0,1\} of whether the probe requires anything beyond the recent window, against the ground truth ρ ⋆ ( p ) = 𝟏 [ R ( p ) ≠ ∅ ] \rho^{\star}(p)=\mathbf{1}[R(p)\neq\emptyset] . Locus is, for probes with ρ ⋆ ​ ( p ) = 1 \rho^{\star}(p)=1 , the prediction of which store or stores the references lie in, against λ ⋆ ​ ( p ) = { l : R ⁡ ( p ) ∩ S l ≠ ∅ } \lambda^{\star}(p)=\{l:R(p)\cap S_{l}\neq\emptyset\} . Response is the reply y ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{y}(p) , scored against g ⁡ ( p ) g(p) . A system that never retrieves makes no restraint error on probes with ρ ⋆ = 0 \rho^{\star}=0 and scores zero on locus. A system that always retrieves errs on every such probe and can still score on locus. Neither degenerate strategy is excluded by construction, which is the point of reporting all three.
paragraphs.zh: 三个决策按此顺序进行评估，因为每个决策的定义都基于前一个决策的输出。 限制（Restraint）是对探针是否需要超出最近窗口范围的信息的预测 ρ ^ ​ ( p ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } \hat{\rho}(p)\in\{0,1\}，并与基准真实值 ρ ⋆ ( p ) = 𝟏 [ R ( p ) ≠ ∅ ] \rho^{\star}(p)=\mathbf{1}[R(p)\neq\emptyset] 进行比较。 位置（Locus）是指，对于 ρ ⋆ ​ ( p ) = 1 \rho^{\star}(p)=1 的探针，预测其参考信息位于哪一个或哪些存储单元中，并与基准真实值 λ ⋆ ​ ( p ) = { l : R ⁡ ( p ) ∩ S l ≠ ∅ } \lambda^{\star}(p)=\{l:R(p)\cap S_{l}\neq\emptyset\} 进行比较。 响应（Response）是回复 y ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{y}(p) ，并与 g ⁡ ( p ) g(p) 进行评分比较。 一个从不检索的系统，对于 ρ ⋆ = 0 \rho^{\star}=0 的探针不会产生任何限制错误，且位置得分也为零。 一个总是进行检索的系统，会对所有此类探针产生错误，但仍可能在位置上获得分数。 这两种退化策略在系统构建时均未被排除，这正是报告全部三个指标的原因。

sents.en: Three decisions are evaluated, in this order because each is defined on the output of the last.
sents.zh: 三个决策按此顺序进行评估，因为每个决策的定义都基于前一个决策的输出。

sents.en: Restraint is the prediction ρ ^ ​ ( p ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } \hat{\rho}(p)\in\{0,1\} of whether the probe requires anything beyond the recent window, against the ground truth ρ ⋆ ( p ) = 𝟏 [ R ( p ) ≠ ∅ ] \rho^{\star}(p)=\mathbf{1}[R(p)\neq\emptyset] .
sents.zh: 限制（Restraint）是对探针是否需要超出最近窗口范围的信息的预测 ρ ^ ​ ( p ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } \hat{\rho}(p)\in\{0,1\}，并与基准真实值 ρ ⋆ ( p ) = 𝟏 [ R ( p ) ≠ ∅ ] \rho^{\star}(p)=\mathbf{1}[R(p)\neq\emptyset] 进行比较。

sents.en: Locus is, for probes with ρ ⋆ ​ ( p ) = 1 \rho^{\star}(p)=1 , the prediction of which store or stores the references lie in, against λ ⋆ ​ ( p ) = { l : R ⁡ ( p ) ∩ S l ≠ ∅ } \lambda^{\star}(p)=\{l:R(p)\cap S_{l}\neq\emptyset\} .
sents.zh: 位置（Locus）是指，对于 ρ ⋆ ​ ( p ) = 1 \rho^{\star}(p)=1 的探针，预测其参考信息位于哪一个或哪些存储单元中，并与基准真实值 λ ⋆ ​ ( p ) = { l : R ⁡ ( p ) ∩ S l ≠ ∅ } \lambda^{\star}(p)=\{l:R(p)\cap S_{l}\neq\emptyset\} 进行比较。

sents.en: Response is the reply y ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{y}(p) , scored against g ⁡ ( p ) g(p) .
sents.zh: 响应（Response）是回复 y ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{y}(p) ，并与 g ⁡ ( p ) g(p) 进行评分比较。

sents.en: A system that never retrieves makes no restraint error on probes with ρ ⋆ = 0 \rho^{\star}=0 and scores zero on locus.
sents.zh: 一个从不检索的系统，对于 ρ ⋆ = 0 \rho^{\star}=0 的探针不会产生任何限制错误，且位置得分也为零。

sents.en: A system that always retrieves errs on every such probe and can still score on locus.
sents.zh: 一个总是进行检索的系统，会对所有此类探针产生错误，但仍可能在位置上获得分数。

sents.en: Neither degenerate strategy is excluded by construction, which is the point of reporting all three.
sents.zh: 这两种退化策略在系统构建时均未被排除，这正是报告全部三个指标的原因。

paragraphs.en: The difficulty of restraint is governed by a single quantity, the demand rate
paragraphs.zh: 抑制的难度由一个单一的量决定，即需求率。

paragraphs.en: taken over probes drawn as the instance specifies. This is a property of the instance, not of the task, and it is where corpora written for evaluation and corpora drawn from use separate. In a corpus whose probes were composed so that a planted fact would be needed, π = 1 \pi=1 by construction, the restraint decision is vacuous, and only locus and response carry information. In a corpus whose probes are the person’s own turns taken without selection, π \pi is whatever it is, and estimating it is itself a measurement. Because π \pi is small in a record of ordinary use, restraint dominates the error budget, and authored probes cannot pose it at the natural rate. A system that is correct on every probe with ρ ⋆ = 1 \rho^{\star}=1 and retrieves on every other probe makes a restraint error on a ( 1 − π ) (1-\pi) fraction of its inputs. The response score does not register that cost, since supplied context can raise it even where nothing was needed (Table 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 按照实例的规定，采用抽取的探针。 这是实例的属性，而非任务的属性；正因如此，用于评估的语料库与从中抽取的语料库才会相互分离。 在一个其探针被设计为需要植入事实的语料库中，根据构造有 π = 1 \pi=1，此时限制决策是空泛的，只有位置与响应携带信息。 在一个其探针为个人未经选择的自身轮次所构成的语料库中，π \pi 的值就是它本身，而对其估计本身就是一项测量。 由于在常规使用记录中 π \pi 很小，限制项主导了误差预算，因此人工编写的探针无法以自然频率引发该问题。 一个在所有 ρ ⋆ = 1 \rho^{\star}=1 的探针上均正确的系统，并在所有其他探针上都能检索出结果，其输入中仍有 ( 1 − π ) (1-\pi) 的比例会犯下限制错误。 响应分数并未记录这一成本，因为所提供的上下文即便在无需任何操作的情况下也可能提高该分数（表8）。

paragraphs.en: The formalism is indifferent to where probes come from, and RealCompanion uses two sources over the same subject records. In the chat track a probe is a message of the stream itself, so H ⁡ ( p ) H(p) is the true history of that message, and the gold response is a reference reply written under ( 1 ). The reply the participant actually received sits in M M as the next message. In the question track a probe is a question posed over the record, so H ⁡ ( p ) H(p) is the whole stream and ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star} , λ ⋆ \lambda^{\star} and g g are annotated the same way. Only the proportional stratum of the chat track supports claims about π \pi , because only there are probes sampled from what the person said without reference to demand.
paragraphs.zh: 这种形式化方法不关心探针的来源，而 RealCompanion 针对同一主题记录使用了两个来源。 在对话轨道中，探针是流本身的一条消息，因此 H⁡(p) H(p) 是该消息的真实历史，而黄金响应是在 (1) 下编写的参考回复。 参与者实际收到的回复作为下一条消息存在于 M M 中。 在问题轨道中，探针是针对该记录提出的一个问题，因此 H⁡(p) H(p) 是整个流，而 ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star}、λ ⋆ \lambda^{\star} 和 g g 的标注方式相同。 只有对话轨道中的比例层能够支持关于 π \pi 的主张，因为只有在其中，探针是从个人所说的内容中采样得出的，而不涉及对需求的参考。

paragraphs.en: Four quantities are reported: one for restraint, one for locus, and two for the response, which ask whether it draws on the past where it should (attribution) and whether it agrees with the gold (consistency). Retrieval itself is scored separately in Appendix E.3 . Each is defined on a population fixed by the annotation and never by the system under test, so that a system cannot enlarge or shrink the set of probes it is graded on by changing its behavior. Table 7 collects the definitions. Throughout, ρ ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{\rho}(p) , λ ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{\lambda}(p) , R ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{R}(p) and y ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{y}(p) denote a system’s restraint decision, locus prediction, retrieved record set and response, and ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star} , λ ⋆ \lambda^{\star} , R R and g g the corresponding ground truth of Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 报告了四个量：一个用于约束，一个用于定位，两个用于响应；其中，响应部分会询问系统是否在该依赖过往信息时确实依赖了过往信息（归因），以及其结果是否与黄金标准一致（一致性）。 检索本身在附录 E.3 中单独评分。 每个量都是基于标注所固定的总体定义的，而非基于待测系统；因此，系统无法通过改变自身行为来扩大或缩小用于评估的探针集合。 表 7 汇总了这些定义。 在全文中，ρ ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{\rho}(p) 、λ ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{\lambda}(p) 、R ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{R}(p) 和 y ^ ​ ( p ) \hat{y}(p) 分别表示系统的约束决策、定位预测、检索到的记录集和响应；而 ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star} 、λ ⋆ \lambda^{\star} 、R R 和 g g 则表示附录 A.1 中对应的基准真值。

paragraphs.en: Restraint is scored as a false-alarm rate, following the misfire convention of Yoon et al. (2026) :
paragraphs.zh: 约束性得分以误报率表示，遵循 Yoon 等人（2026）的误发惯例：

paragraphs.en: the rate at which a system reaches beyond the recent window when nothing beyond it is required. The population is every probe with R ⁡ ( p ) = ∅ R(p)=\emptyset , which is 1,129 of the 1,533 scoreable probes. We take this population, because the decision a deployed system actually faces is whether to retrieve beyond what is already on screen, and that is exactly ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star} . The narrower figure, computed on the 120 probes whose locus is none , is reported alongside it in Appendix D.4 for comparability with prior work, and the two differ substantially; a reader comparing across papers should check which population a reported misfire rate was taken on.
paragraphs.zh: 系统在无需获取近期窗口之外信息时，仍会超出该窗口的速度。 该群体包含所有满足 R⁡(p)=∅ 的探针，即 1,129 个可评分探针中的 1,129 个。 我们采用这个群体，因为部署系统实际面临的决策是：是否要检索屏幕已有内容之外的信息，而这正是 ρ⋆。 在 120 个定位点为空的探针上计算出的更窄范围数据，为便于与先前的研究进行比较，已一并列于附录 D.4 中；两者存在显著差异，跨论文比较的读者应核实所报告的失误率是基于哪个群体计算的。

paragraphs.en: Proportions reported alone carry Wilson intervals over items. Comparisons carry percentile intervals from a paired bootstrap that resamples participants with replacement, because participants are the unit over which the estimate is averaged and probes within a participant are not independent. For a comparison between two systems the same resample is applied to both and the interval is taken on the difference, so the paired structure is preserved. With ten subjects these intervals are wide, and we report them as they come out.
paragraphs.zh: 单独报告的比率会针对各项显示威尔逊置信区间。 比较分析则会显示来自配对自助法的百分位置信区间，该方法通过有放回地重采样参与者来生成数据，因为参与者是估计值所依据的平均单位，而同一参与者内部的探测结果并非相互独立的。 对于两个系统之间的比较，会对两者应用相同的重采样过程，并基于差异计算置信区间，从而保留配对结构。 在仅有十名受试者的情况下，这些置信区间范围较宽，因此我们直接报告原始结果。

paragraphs.en: The strata of Appendix D.2 carry different work and are never pooled for a rate. The proportional stratum is a random sample of user turns, so it alone supports statements about how often something occurs in the traffic, including every estimate of π \pi . The enriched stratum is an exhaustive sweep for probes of a given shape, so it supplies statistical power for comparisons conditioned on that shape but has no denominator of its own. A rate quoted without a stratum is not defined, and every rate in this paper names one. The abstention control of 434 cold opens is scored apart and enters no rate.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 D.2 中的各分层承载不同的工作，且绝不会合并计算一个比率。 比例分层是用户轮次的随机样本，因此只有它能支持关于某事物在流量中出现频率的陈述，包括对 π \pi 的所有估计。 增强分层是对特定形状探测的全面扫描，因此能为基于该形状的比较提供统计效力，但它本身没有分母。 未指明分层而引用的比率是没有定义的，而本文中的每个比率都明确标注了所属分层。 434 次冷启动中的弃权控制被单独计分，且不计入任何比率。

paragraphs.en: Three consequences follow from the demand rate π \pi of ( 2 ) being small, and they bear on what a corpus can establish. The first says which claims the derivation licenses and which it does not. The second says the decision restraint asks for cannot be made from the probe. paragraphs.en: For any feature map ϕ \phi of the probe text alone, write D ⁡ ( ϕ ) = I ⁡ ( ϕ ⁡ ( p ) , ρ ⋆ ​ ( p ) ) D(\phi)=I\bigl(\phi(p);\rho^{\star}(p)\bigr) for its surface detectability. In a corpus whose probes are drawn, D D is an empirical quantity, and this corpus estimates it twice. A lexical scorer’s own confidence reaches an area under the ROC curve of 0.546 against 0.500 for chance. A model shown the probe and its three preceding turns and asked directly reaches 0.530 [0.488, 0.572] on the same split at the natural rate, and 0.601 [0.527, 0.676] against its own target, where its threshold catches 6 of 40 and raises 40 false alarms. Independently, the sampler routed every turn into a bucket before any verification ran, and its buckets disagree with the verified tier on 44.7% of rows, and the bucket it was most confident carried a distant memory demand yielded 10 hard-tier rows in 97. Both measure only the detectors that were tried, so neither shows that D = 0 D=0 for every ϕ \phi . The practical reading is that a cheap surface gate does not exist here, which is the assumption every deployed memory system is built on.
paragraphs.zh: 对于仅基于探针文本的任意特征图 ϕ，其表面可检测性定义为 D(ϕ) = I(ϕ(p); ρ⋆(p))。 在一个探针被抽取语料库中，D 是一个经验量，该语料库对其进行了两次估计。 一个词汇评分器自身的置信度在 ROC 曲线下面积为 0.546，而随机猜测的面积为 0.500。 一个同时展示探针及其前三个轮次的模型，在自然速率下于相同分割数据集上直接提问时达到 0.530 [0.488, 0.572]；在与自身目标对比时则达到 0.601 [0.527, 0.676]，其中其阈值捕捉到了 40 个样本中的 6 个，并引发了 40 次误报。 独立地，采样器在运行任何验证之前将每个轮次归入一个桶中；这些桶与已验证层级在 44.7% 的行上存在分歧，而它最自信的桶包含了一个遥远的记忆需求，在 97 个样本中产生了 10 个硬层级样本。 这两种测量方法都仅针对实际尝试的检测器进行统计，因此都无法证明对于每个 ϕ，D = 0。 实际上的结论是，这里并不存在一个廉价的表面门控机制，而这正是所有已部署的记忆系统所依赖的假设。

paragraphs.en: (V2) The reference set is disjoint from the recent window. A record that is already on screen is not something a system must retrieve, and counting it as one inflates the demand rate π \pi and credits a system for retrieval it never needed to perform. The condition is easy to state and hard to satisfy, because whether a referent is on screen is a judgment about the text. An instance that cannot guarantee V2 by construction must do the next best thing: record the judgment per probe as released evidence, and report every rate under both the reading that assumes V2 and the reading that enforces it. RealCompanion takes this route. The field and its criterion are in Appendix D.4 , and the principal rates are given under both readings. Against the recorded window the condition holds exactly. Across the 1,533 scoreable probes, none of the 1,989 profile evidence messages and none of the 381 episode reference messages falls inside it, and a release gate enforces this. Against a fixed window of the ten preceding messages, 11 rows carry a reference inside it. All 11 are among the 154 rows the strict reading removes, which also removes rows whose referent is named on screen while its evidence lies further back.
paragraphs.zh: (V2) 参考集与近期窗口不相交。 屏幕上已有的记录并非系统必须检索的内容，将其计入会虚增需求率 π \pi，并让系统获得其从未需要执行的检索操作的信用。 该条件易于陈述却难以满足，因为判断某个参照物是否出现在屏幕上属于对文本的判定。 因构造本身无法保证 V2 的实例必须采取次优方案：将每次探测的判定作为已释放的证据记录，并在两种解读下报告所有比率——一种假设 V2 成立，另一种则强制执行 V2。 RealCompanion 采用了这一方法。 该领域及其标准见附录 D.4，主要比率在两种解读下均有给出。 对于已记录的窗口，该条件完全成立。 在 1,533 个可评分的探测中，1,989 条个人资料证据消息和 381 条事件参考消息均不在该窗口内，且释放门机制强制执行了这一限制。 对于由前十条消息构成的固定窗口，有 11 行包含其中的参考信息。 这 11 行全部属于严格解读所移除的 154 行；这种解读也移除了那些参照物在屏幕上被提及但其证据位于更前面的行。

paragraphs.en: (V3) At least one stratum is sampled without reference to memory demand. Any estimate of π \pi , and any claim of the form “this happens at rate r r in real traffic,” requires a set of probes selected without knowing the answer. A stratum assembled by searching for probes of an interesting shape has no denominator: it can establish that something occurs and can supply power for comparisons conditioned on that shape, but it cannot say how often the shape occurs. Instances may and should contain both kinds of stratum, and must label which is which. Pooling them yields a rate that estimates no quantity at all.
paragraphs.zh: (V3) 至少有一个分层是无需参考内存需求的抽样得到的。 任何对 π \pi 的估计，以及任何形如“这种情况在实际流量中以速率 r r 发生”的说法，都需要一组在未知答案的情况下选择的探针。 通过搜索具有特定形状的探针而构建的分层没有分母：它可以确定某种情况的发生，并能为基于该形状的比较提供依据，但无法说明这种形状出现的频率。 实例可以并且应当同时包含这两种分层，且必须明确标注它们各自的类型。 将它们合并后得到的速率实际上并未估计任何具体数值。

paragraphs.en: (V4) The store family is fixed before annotation. The locus decision is falsifiable only if the set of places a record may live is declared in advance. An instance that introduces a store whenever the annotation finds something that fits nowhere else makes locus unfalsifiable, since every prediction can be accommodated after the fact. RealCompanion fixes two reference stores beside the recent window: profile claims and episode turns. The locus takes five values, of which three are distant, and the companion locus is an episode reference restricted to messages the companion sent. The formal locus λ ⋆ \lambda^{\star} therefore takes a value in the two stores, and the released field refines it: thread and none carry ρ ⋆ = 0 \rho^{\star}=0 , and companion refines episode . No item populates both reference lists, so | λ ⋆ ​ ( p ) | = 1 |\lambda^{\star}(p)|=1 on every memory-bearing probe.

paragraphs.en: (V5) One released file is underived, and every derived claim cites it. Reasoning traces are worth nothing if a reader cannot check them. The instance must therefore release at least one layer that is not derived from any other, every claim in every derived layer must cite records in that layer, and every citation must resolve by stored identifier to a released record. An instance that ships only derived layers, or that ships citations which resolve nowhere, offers annotation that can be read but not contradicted. This is the condition that separates a trace from an explanation.
paragraphs.zh: (V5) 必须发布一个非派生文件，且所有派生主张都必须引用它。 如果读者无法验证推理轨迹，那么这些轨迹就毫无价值。 因此，实例必须至少发布一个未从任何其他内容派生出的层级；每个派生层级中的每一个主张都必须引用该层级的记录，且每一次引用都必须通过已存储的标识符指向一个已发布的记录。 如果实例仅发布派生层级，或发布的引用无法指向任何地方，那么其提供的注释虽然可读，却无法被证伪。 正是这一条件将推理轨迹与解释区分开来。

paragraphs.en: (V6) Refutation only demotes, and demotion resets everything derived from the refuted evidence. A derivation pipeline that both proposes and verifies must be arranged so that verification can lower a probe’s demand label but never raise it. The first half of this gives the error a direction: a pipeline that misses a genuine referent makes memory demand look rarer than it is, so a finding of rarity cannot be an artifact of over-labeling. The second half is where implementations fail. When verification refutes the proposed evidence, every label computed from that evidence must be reset along with it, not only the reference set. A pipeline that empties the reference set but leaves the locus of the refuted evidence in place emits probes whose labels contradict each other, and any locus figure computed from them is wrong. The audit of Appendix D.5 found and repaired exactly this failure in our own derivation.
paragraphs.zh: (V6) 反驳只会导致降级，而降级会重置所有源自被反驳证据的推导结果。 一个既提出又验证的推导流程必须这样安排：验证可以降低探测器的需求标签，但绝不能提高它。 这一点的前半部分为错误指明了方向：一个未能识别真实参照物的流程会使内存需求显得比实际更罕见，因此“罕见性”的发现不可能是过度标注造成的伪结果。 而问题的后半部分则体现在具体实现中。 当验证过程反驳了所提出的证据时，所有基于该证据计算出的标签都必须随之重置，而不仅仅是参照集。 一个清空参照集但保留被反驳证据位置的流程，会产生标签相互矛盾的探测器，任何基于这些探测器计算出的位置指标都是错误的。 D.5 附录的审计发现并修复了我们自身推导流程中正是这一错误。

paragraphs.en: (V7) Evidence the subject did not produce is bounded and reported. An instance drawn from an interaction with a system that itself has memory faces a confound the annotation cannot remove: a referent may have been supplied to the subject. No such corpus can guarantee that this never happens, so the condition is that its rate is measured and published. An instance that does not report it leaves a reader unable to tell recall from repetition.
paragraphs.zh: (V7) 主体未提供的证据是有界限的且已被报告。 从一个本身具有记忆的系统互动中抽取的一个实例面临一个标注无法消除的混淆因素：可能已向主体提供了指代对象。 没有任何这样的语料库能保证这种情况绝不会发生，因此其条件在于测量并公布其发生率。 一个未报告该情况的实例会使读者无法区分回忆与重复。

paragraphs.en: The companion that produced these histories had its own memory. A gold that rests on a turn the companion sent may therefore record something the participant was told. This is measurable. On the chat track, 22.0% [18.3, 26.3] of the 404 memory-bearing rows rest on memory evidence sent entirely by the companion. Sixty-five of those are rows whose verified locus is the companion, where recalling what the companion said is the task. That leaves 7.1%, 24 of 339: episode 17.2% [11.4, 25.1] of 116, profile 1.8% [0.7, 4.5] of 223. On the question track the rate is 7.5% [6.6, 8.5] of the 3,165 items with a needed turn, or 5.5% [4.8, 6.4] read on the cited turns.

paragraphs.en: Section 2 states the position, and Table 1 gives the comparison. Personalization has no observable ground truth, so the field makes three substitutions. A description stands in for the person, an authored question stands in for the moment that needs memory, and a model’s judgment stands in for the target. Each substitution has a cost that can be measured. This appendix sets out the three ( B.1 ), what they cost ( B.2 ), the attempts to remove them ( B.3 ), adjacent work on memory systems and rationales ( B.4 ), what releasing the alternative requires ( B.5 ), and the criteria behind the table ( B.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节陈述了立场，表 1 提供了比较。 个性化没有可观察的基准事实，因此该领域进行了三项替换。 一种描述替代了人物，一个由作者提出的问题替代了需要记忆的时刻，而模型的判断则替代了目标。 每次替换都伴随着可以衡量的成本。 本附录阐明了这三项内容（B.1）、它们的成本（B.2）、移除这些内容的尝试（B.3）、关于记忆系统和推理的相关研究（B.4）、释放替代方案所需的条件（B.5），以及表格背后的标准（B.6）。

paragraphs.en: The word persona entered dialogue research through PersonaChat ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , where crowd-workers were given short sets of persona sentences and asked to converse while conditioned on them. It solved a real problem, since a model with no representation of its user produces generic replies. A persona in this tradition is an input the experimenter controls, and no reply can contradict it, because nothing outside the description exists to check it against. Multi-session chat ( Xu et al., 2022 ) extended the format past a single conversation, collecting dialogues that resume across three to five sessions and carrying summaries forward, which made long-range consistency measurable. The personas are still supplied in advance, and the time between sessions is simulated, with workers told to write as if one to seven hours or one to seven days had passed. What accumulates is a record of a task performed on a schedule.

paragraphs.en: The tradition now operates at industrial scale. Nemotron-Personas-USA ( Meyer and Corneil, 2025 ) releases a million synthetic personas aligned to real-world demographic distributions, each a set of prose facets covering profession, sports, arts, travel and cuisine, alongside demographic fields. Two works measure what the assumption behind such personas costs. Venkit et al. (2026a) administer a 141-item sociopsychological protocol to 124 people and report that demographics explain roughly 1.5% of the variance in how similarly two people respond, so a persona assembled from demographic attributes is very nearly unrelated to the person it describes. Neplenbroek et al. (2026) append high-stakes advice questions to 8,011 PRISM conversations ( Kirk et al., 2024 ) and 26,521 from the Community Alignment Dataset ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and find that conversation topic predicts a model’s advice better than inferred sociodemographics, which models infer poorly in any case. What a system adapts to, when it adapts to a conversation, is what the conversation is about.
paragraphs.zh: 这一传统如今已达到了工业规模。 Nemotron-Personas-USA（Meyer 和 Corneil，2025）发布了一百万个与真实世界人口统计分布相一致的合成人格，每个合成人格都包含一系列描述职业、体育、艺术、旅行和美食的散文式特征，以及人口统计字段。 有两项研究评估了此类合成人格背后假设所付出的代价。Venkit 等人 （2026a）对 124 人实施了一项包含 141 个项目的社会心理学测试，并报告称人口统计数据仅能解释两人回答相似性差异的约 1.5%，因此由人口统计属性构成的合成人格与其所描述的人几乎无关。Neplenbroek 等人 （2026）在 8,011 次 PRISM 对话（Kirk 等人，2024）以及来自社区对齐数据集（Zhang 等人，2025a）的 26,521 次对话中加入了高风险的建议类问题，并发现对话主题比推断出的社会人口统计数据更能预测模型给出的建议，而后者本身模型的推断效果就很差。 当一个系统适应一段对话时，它实际上是在适应这段对话所讨论的内容。

paragraphs.en: Work on conversational memory has converged on a common shape. A long interaction history is constructed, a question is posed at the end, and the system is scored on whether it recovers the fact needed to answer. LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) builds very long machine-generated conversations and queries them in the third person. LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2024 ) scales the context past a million tokens and targets factual recall across sessions. CloneMem ( Hu et al., 2026 ) argues that conversation captures only fragments of a life and moves to diaries and messages generated top-down from Big Five profiles into multi-year arcs. It links each question to evidence units, defines eight reasoning categories including unanswerable items, and reports that flat retrieval beats consolidation-based memory because summarization severs the link to the original traces. Transplanted into conversation, the shape brings an assumption with it. A question states what should be retrieved, so the benchmark decides for the system whether retrieval was warranted, and it scores finding the right material and using it well as a single outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 对话记忆领域的研究已逐渐形成一种共同的形态。 系统会构建一段较长的互动历史，在末尾提出一个问题，并根据其能否恢复回答所需的事实来评分。 LoCoMo（Maharana 等人，2024）生成非常长的机器对话，并以第三人称进行提问。 LongMemEval（Wu 等人，2024）将上下文长度扩展到超过一百万个词元，并针对跨会话的事实回忆能力进行评估。 CloneMem（Hu 等人，2026）认为，对话仅能捕捉生活的片段，因此转向基于“大五人格”特征自上而下生成的日记和消息，以构建跨越多年的发展轨迹。 该方法将每个问题与证据单元关联起来，定义了包括无法回答项在内的八种推理类别，并指出直接检索优于基于整合的记忆方法，因为摘要会切断与原始痕迹的关联。 当这种形态被移植到对话中时，它也带来了一种假设。 问题本身指明了应检索的内容，因此基准测试会替系统判断检索是否合理，并将找到正确材料并有效使用它视为单一结果进行评分。

paragraphs.en: The personalization line adopts the same shape while varying what the question is about. LaMP ( Salemi et al., 2024 ) formulates personalization as seven classification and generation tasks over public user histories, within a single message. PersonaMem ( Jiang et al., 2025a ) builds 180 simulated interaction histories from PersonaHub seeds ( Ge et al., 2024 ) and asks a model to identify the most suitable response given the current state of a user profile. PersonaMem-v2 ( Jiang et al., 2025b ) scales to 1,000 personas and shifts to implicit preferences that surface as side effects of ordinary requests, where the models it evaluates reach 37% to 55%. CUPID ( Kim et al., 2025 ) curates 756 interaction histories in which a preference holds only in a specific context, and reports that no model it evaluates exceeds 50% precision and 65% recall at identifying which prior context a new request depends on.
paragraphs.zh: 个性化线路采用相同的结构，但会改变问题的具体内容。 LaMP（Salemi 等人，2024）将个性化问题表述为在单条消息中基于公开用户历史记录的七项分类和生成任务。 PersonaMem（Jiang 等人，2025a）利用 PersonaHub 的种子数据（Ge 等人，2024）构建出 180 条模拟交互历史记录，并要求模型根据用户个人资料当前状态识别最合适的回应。 PersonaMem-v2（Jiang 等人，2025b）扩展至 1,000 个角色设定，并转向关注普通请求中作为副作用显现的隐含偏好，其评估的模型准确率达到了 37% 到 55%。 CUPID（Kim 等人，2025）整理了 756 条交互历史记录，在这些记录中，某种偏好仅在特定情境下成立；报告指出，其评估的模型在识别新请求所依赖的先前情境时，精确率未超过 50%，召回率未超过 65%。

sents.zh: 个性化线路采用相同的结构，但会改变问题的具体内容。

paragraphs.en: A recurring finding across this line is that models fail to update. HorizonBench ( Li et al., 2026b ) constructs 4,245 items from 360 simulated users whose preferences evolve through a mental state graph, and reports that all 25 models it evaluates disproportionately select the pre-evolution value. Its authors state that whether the failure holds at the same severity in naturalistic interaction is unresolved, and position the benchmark as preparation “in advance of longitudinal human data.” In the companion setting, ANCHOR ( Venkit et al., 2026b ) evaluates persona collapse and behavioral drift over 2,008 conversations spanning 27 personas, nine interaction schedules and three memory configurations. Trajectory accuracy averages 44.4%, recall of the user’s state sits near four-option chance, and no memory configuration resolves either. ANCHOR asks whether the companion stays itself. The 65 probes in this corpus whose locus is the companion ask the same question of an interaction that happened.
paragraphs.zh: 这一系列研究中反复发现的一个问题是，模型无法进行更新。 HorizonBench（Li et al., 2026b）从360个模拟用户中构建了4,245个条目，这些用户的偏好通过心智状态图不断演变；研究指出，其评估的全部25个模型都倾向于不成比例地选择演变前的数值。 该研究的作者表示，这种失败在自然互动中是否仍以同等严重程度存在尚不明确，并将该基准测试定位为“为长期人类数据收集做准备”的先行工作。在配套设置中，ANCHOR（Venkit et al., 2026b）通过涵盖27个人设、9种互动安排和3种记忆配置的2,008次对话，评估了角色身份崩溃与行为漂移问题。 轨迹准确率的平均值为44.4%，对用户状态的召回率接近四选一的随机水平，且没有任何一种记忆配置能够解决这两个问题。 ANCHOR试图探究：互动中的“同伴”是否仍保持其自身特性。 该语料库中65个以“同伴”为焦点的探针，都在对一次已经发生的互动提出同样的问题。
