paragraphs.en: Scoring open-ended responses with a language model was introduced at scale by MT-Bench and Chat-bot Arena ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , which also documented the failure modes: position bias, verbosity bias, and a preference for the judge’s own outputs. Those biases are tolerable when the quantity being judged is otherwise observable. In personalization the target is unobserved, so the judge substitutes for it. A recent survey of personalized agents names this among the open problems, alongside the reliance on synthetic users ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Our design keeps this substitution and bounds it three ways. The generator is held constant across all five conditions, so any preference for its style applies uniformly and cannot order them. The five candidates for a probe are shuffled and scored in one call, which removes position effects and drift in the judge’s use of the scale. Evidence coverage, which uses no judge, is reported alongside content match as a check that shares none of its failure modes.
paragraphs.zh: MT-Bench 和 Chat-bot Arena（Zheng 等人，2023）首次大规模引入使用语言模型对开放式回答进行评分的方法，同时也记录了其失效模式：位置偏差、冗长性偏差以及对裁判自身输出的偏好。 当被评估的量本身是可观测的时，这些偏差尚可接受。 在个性化场景中，目标是不可观测的，因此裁判会用它来替代目标。 最近一项关于个性化智能体的研究将这一问题列为待解决难题之一，同时指出其还依赖于合成用户（Xu 等人，2026）。 我们的设计保留了这种替代机制，并从三个方面对其进行了限制。 生成器在所有五种条件下均保持不变，因此对其风格的任何偏好都会一致地适用，而无法用于排序。 五个探测候选项会被打乱顺序并在一次调用中完成评分，从而消除了位置效应以及裁判在使用评分尺度时可能产生的偏移。 无需依赖裁判的证据覆盖度会与内容匹配度一同报告，作为验证手段，且它与此方法没有任何失效模式的共通之处。

sents.en: The five candidates for a probe are shuffled and scored in one call, which removes position effects and drift in the judge’s use of the scale.
sents.zh: 五个探测候选项会被打乱顺序并在一次调用中完成评分，从而消除了位置效应以及裁判在使用评分尺度时可能产生的偏移。

sents.en: Evidence coverage, which uses no judge, is reported alongside content match as a check that shares none of its failure modes.
sents.zh: 无需依赖裁判的证据覆盖度会与内容匹配度一同报告，作为验证手段，且它与此方法没有任何失效模式的共通之处。

paragraphs.en: A question announces that something must be looked up, so a benchmark built from questions cannot score a system for deciding whether to look. The methods that learn this decision learn it from the question. Self-RAG ( Asai et al., 2024 ) trains reflection tokens that let a model call for passages on demand, Adaptive-RAG ( Jeong et al., 2024 ) trains a classifier over query complexity and routes between no retrieval, single-step retrieval and multi-step retrieval, and Mallen et al. (2023) retrieve only for questions about less popular entities. All three read a signal the question supplies. SQuAD 2.0 ( Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ) made not answering a first-class label by adding over 50,000 questions with no answer in the passage, and the idea carried into conversational memory as the unanswerable categories of CloneMem and of our question track. The conversational analogue is a message that calls for no memory at all, which describes most messages. That case cannot be constructed by authoring, because an author writing a probe that requires nothing has written nothing worth scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 一个问题表明必须查找某些信息，因此由问题构成的基准无法对系统是否决定进行查找做出评分。 学习这种决策的方法是从问题本身中学习的。 Self-RAG（Asai 等人，2024）训练了反思标记，使模型能够按需调用段落；Adaptive-RAG（Jeong 等人，2024）则针对查询复杂度训练了一个分类器，并在不检索、单步检索和多步检索之间进行路由；而 Mallen 等人 （2023）仅对涉及较少流行实体的问题进行检索。 这三种方法都读取问题所提供的信号。 SQuAD 2.0（Rajpurkar 等人，2018）通过添加超过 50,000 个在段落中无答案的问题，使“不回答”成为了一级标签；这一理念也延续到了对话记忆中，形成了 CloneMem 和我们问题轨道中的“无法回答”类别。 在对话场景中的类似情况是一条完全不要求记忆的消息，而大多数消息都属于这种情况。 这种情况无法通过创作来构建，因为一个作者如果写出一条无需任何信息的探询，就等于没有写出任何值得评分的内容。

paragraphs.en: Before a conversational query can be retrieved against, its references have to be resolved, and conversational search has long studied that operation. QReCC ( Anantha et al., 2021 ) pairs 14,000 conversations with rewrites that message a context-dependent question into a standalone one, and Mo et al. (2025) survey the line. That work presupposes a question to rewrite. Stage A (Section 4 ) performs the same operation on an ordinary message and records the outcome as locus , which states where the referent lives. The label exists here because the probes are ordinary messages.
paragraphs.zh: 在对对话查询进行检索之前，必须先解析其引用，而对话搜索领域早已对这一操作进行了研究。 QReCC（Anantha 等人，2021）将 14,000 段对话与改写版本配对，这些改写版本将依赖上下文的提问转化为独立的问题，而 Mo 等人（2025）则对该领域进行了综述。 这项工作预设了需要被改写的问题。 A 阶段（第 4 节）对普通消息执行相同的操作，并将结果记录为“定位”，用于说明引用所指的内容位于何处。 此处之所以存在该标签，是因为这些探测信息是普通消息。

paragraphs.en: An author who knows the answer places its evidence wherever the question needs it, so the distance between probe and evidence is a design choice, and Liu et al. (2024) show that where evidence sits in a context changes whether a model uses it. Real conversation produces a bimodal distribution instead. Probes that point into the current thread reach back a median of 2 messages and at most 15. Probes that point outside it reach a median of 450 messages to the nearest cited message and 2,157 to the furthest, and as far as 12,542.
paragraphs.zh: 知道答案的作者会将证据放置在问题需要的位置，因此探针对证据的距离是一种设计选择，Liu 等人（2024）表明，证据在上下文中的位置会影响模型是否使用它。 （2024）表明，证据在上下文中的位置会影响模型是否使用它。 真实的对话则会产生一种双峰分布。 指向当前对话线程的探针平均会回溯 2 条消息，最多回溯 15 条。 指向线程外部的探针平均会回溯到距离最近被引用消息 450 条消息的位置，最远可达 2,157 条，甚至最远可达 12,542 条。

paragraphs.en: Recent work removes one substitution at a time. Each effort keeps the others, and which one it keeps is the informative part. AlpsBench ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) curates 2,500 long-term interaction sequences from WildChat, a corpus of real exchanges between people and assistants, and evaluates seven memory systems on extraction, update, retrieval, and utilization. It is the closest prior work to ours on data, and it removes the first substitution. It keeps the second, since its evaluation queries are synthesized by a language model from the dialogues. Its data also records a different activity. WildChat users bring tasks to a general assistant, so even its longest sequences are a series of requests.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究每次仅移除一个替换。 每次操作都会保留其他替换，而具体保留哪一个正是其信息价值所在。 AlpsBench（Xiao 等人，2026）从 WildChat 中整理出 2,500 条长期交互序列——WildChat 是一个记录人与助手之间真实对话的语料库——并评估了七种记忆系统在提取、更新、检索和利用方面的表现。 在数据方面，这是最接近我们工作的先前研究，且它移除了第一个替换。 它保留了第二个替换，因为其评估查询是由语言模型根据对话内容合成的。 其数据还记录了一种不同的活动类型。 WildChat 的用户会向通用助手提出任务，因此即使是最长的交互序列也是一系列请求。

paragraphs.en: CompanionBench ( Liu et al., 2026 ) draws on de-identified real companion conversations and anchors its rubric in psychological theory. It removes the first substitution at collection and restores it at release, since it releases rewritten persona pairs and evaluates single 20-message sessions against a simulator. Its authors state that such sessions cannot reach the depth of disclosure that develops over a longer relationship. PRISM ( Kirk et al., 2024 ) collects feedback from 1,500 people across 75 countries and is the largest body of real human preference data in this area. It is the one effort that removes the third substitution as well as the first, since its judgments come from people. Its unit is a rated single-session conversation, so it establishes what people prefer and leaves open what a system should remember.
paragraphs.zh: CompanionBench（Liu 等人，2026）基于去标识化的真实陪伴对话，并以心理学理论作为其评分标准的基础。 它在收集阶段移除了第一次替换，并在发布时将其恢复，因为它会发布经过改写的人格配对，并通过模拟器评估包含 20 条消息的单个会话。 其作者指出，此类会话无法达到长期关系中所形成的深度自我披露。 PRISM（Kirk 等人，2024）收集了来自 75 个国家/地区的 1,500 人的反馈，是该领域规模最大的真实人类偏好数据集。 这是唯一一个既移除了第三次替换也移除了第一次替换的研究，因为其判断来自人类本身。 其评估单位是单次会话的对话评分，因此它确立了人类的偏好，但并未明确系统应当记住哪些内容。

paragraphs.en: Two efforts outside conversation turn to real behavior. OmniBehavior ( Chen et al., 2026a ) assembles a user-simulation benchmark from real behavioral traces and describes itself as the first built wholly from real-world data, and LUNAR ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) builds personalization tasks from app behavior logs through a synthesis pipeline grounded in real behavioral patterns. Neither is conversational, so neither poses the decision this paper is about: a trace records what a person did, and a simulator is scored against the next action. What OmniBehavior reports is nonetheless the strongest external statement of why records of this kind are needed. Evaluated on real traces, models converge toward an average and agreeable person, showing hyperactivity and homogenized personas, and losing individual differences and long-tail behavior. That is a failure a written corpus cannot exhibit, because a written corpus has no long tail: its users were composed, and nothing is in them that an author did not put there.
paragraphs.zh: 对话之外的两种努力最终转化为真实行为。 OmniBehavior（Chen 等人，2026a）从真实的行为轨迹中构建了一个用户模拟基准，并自称为首个完全基于真实世界数据构建的系统；而 LUNAR（Zhang 等人，2026b）则通过一种基于真实行为模式的合成流程，从应用行为日志中构建个性化任务。 两者都不是对话相关的，因此都没有提出本文所讨论的决策问题：轨迹记录了一个人的行为，而模拟器则根据下一个行动进行评分。 尽管如此，OmniBehavior 的报告仍然是目前最有力的外部论据，说明为何需要这类记录。 在真实轨迹上进行评估时，模型会趋近于一个平均且符合常规的人物形象，表现出过度活跃和人格特征的同质化，并失去个体差异与长尾行为。 这是书面语料无法呈现的失败，因为书面语料没有长尾：其用户内容都是经过精心创作的，其中不存在作者未曾加入的任何东西。

sents.en: Two efforts outside conversation turn to real behavior.
sents.zh: 对话之外的两种努力最终转化为真实行为。

paragraphs.en: A parallel line of engineering builds the systems these benchmarks measure, and its design choices constrain evaluation from the other direction. MemGPT ( Packer et al., 2023 ) treats the context window as a level in a memory hierarchy and pages material in and out of external storage under model control. Generative Agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) maintains a memory stream retrieved by recency, importance, and relevance, and reflects over it periodically to produce higher-level statements. mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) and A-Mem ( Xu et al., 2025 ) extract and consolidate, writing distilled memory statements. AI Persona ( Wang et al., 2024 ) carries this furthest for user modeling, maintaining a lifelong profile that an optimizer updates every few sessions without retraining; it is the closest prior work to the profile file we release, and differs in that its claims are not bound to the messages that established them. The last property decides what a benchmark can measure. A system that stores messages can be scored by identifier match against a gold set. A system that stores distilled statements cannot, because there is no identifier to match, which is why Section 5 defines a judged recall alongside the exact one and reports the two separately. We evaluate three of these systems as deployed products, since the write policy is part of what is being measured and a re-implementation would replace it with ours.
paragraphs.zh: 一条平行的工程路线构建了这些基准所测量的系统，其设计选择则从另一个方向对评估施加了限制。 MemGPT（Packer 等人，2023）将上下文窗口视为记忆层次结构中的一个层级，并在模型控制下将内容分页调入和调出外部存储。 Generative Agents（Park 等人，2023）维护一条按最近性、重要性和相关性检索的记忆流，并定期对其进行反思以生成更高级别的陈述。mem0（Chhikara 等人，2025）和 A-Mem（Xu 等人，2025）则提取并整合信息，写入提炼后的记忆陈述。 AI Persona（Wang 等人，2024）在用户建模方面将这一特性发挥到了极致：它维护一个贯穿整个生命周期的用户画像，由优化器每隔几次会话更新一次而无需重新训练；这是与我们发布的用户画像文件最接近的前期工作，不同之处在于其主张并不绑定于生成这些主张的消息本身。 最后一个特性决定了基准能够测量什么。 一个存储消息的系统可以通过与黄金数据集的标识符匹配进行评分。 一个存储提炼后陈述的系统则无法这样做，因为没有可供匹配的标识符，因此第 5 节在精确召回率之外定义了一种经过判断的召回率，并对两者分别报告。 我们将这三个系统中已部署的产品作为评估对象，因为写入策略是所测量内容的一部分，而重新实现将用我们的策略取而代之。

sents.zh: 一条平行的工程路线构建了这些基准所测量的系统，其设计选择则从另一个方向对评估施加了限制。

sents.en: MemGPT ( Packer et al., 2023 ) treats the context window as a level in a memory hierarchy and pages material in and out of external storage under model control.
sents.zh: MemGPT（Packer 等人，2023）将上下文窗口视为记忆层次结构中的一个层级，并在模型控制下将内容分页调入和调出外部存储。

sents.en: Generative Agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) maintains a memory stream retrieved by recency, importance, and relevance, and reflects over it periodically to produce higher-level statements. mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) and A-Mem ( Xu et al., 2025 ) extract and consolidate, writing distilled memory statements.
sents.zh: Generative Agents（Park 等人，2023）维护一条按最近性、重要性和相关性检索的记忆流，并定期对其进行反思以生成更高级别的陈述。mem0（Chhikara 等人，2025）和 A-Mem（Xu 等人，2025）则提取并整合信息，写入提炼后的记忆陈述。

sents.en: AI Persona ( Wang et al., 2024 ) carries this furthest for user modeling, maintaining a lifelong profile that an optimizer updates every few sessions without retraining; it is the closest prior work to the profile file we release, and differs in that its claims are not bound to the messages that established them.

sents.zh: 最后一个特性决定了基准能够测量什么。

sents.en: A system that stores messages can be scored by identifier match against a gold set.
sents.zh: 一个存储消息的系统可以通过与黄金数据集的标识符匹配进行评分。

sents.en: A system that stores distilled statements cannot, because there is no identifier to match, which is why Section 5 defines a judged recall alongside the exact one and reports the two separately.

sents.en: We evaluate three of these systems as deployed products, since the write policy is part of what is being measured and a re-implementation would replace it with ours.

paragraphs.en: Attaching rationales to labels has a long history, with e-SNLI ( Camburu et al., 2018 ) as the canonical example: annotators assign a label and then write why. Those rationales are written after the label by the annotator who assigned it, so a rationale cannot disagree with its label. CloneMem’s evidence units and CUPID’s preference checklists are partial instances of the same idea, since both expose what a gold answer rests on. Neither records how the gold answer was reached. Each item here carries a reasoning trace instead, recording the procedure that produced the label, the intermediate results that were checked, and the points where a check failed and the label was revised. A stage can contradict the stage before it, and on 685 of the 1,533 scoreable items, 44.7%, the final tier differs from the pre-verification signal. The practical difference is what a reader can do with a disagreement. A rationale can be judged unconvincing, which leaves the label standing. A reasoning trace can be rejected at a named stage, which identifies every other item that stage decided the same way.
paragraphs.zh: 为标签附加推理依据的做法历史悠久，e-SNLI（Camburu 等人，2018）是这一做法的经典范例：标注者先分配一个标签，然后说明其理由。 这些推理依据由分配标签的标注者在指定标签之后撰写，因此推理依据不可能与其对应的标签相矛盾。 CloneMem 的证据单元和 CUPID 的偏好检查清单都是这一理念的部分体现，因为两者都揭示了黄金答案所依赖的内容。 但两者均未记录黄金答案是如何得出的。 与此相反，此处的每个项目都附带一条推理轨迹，记录了生成该标签的流程、经过验证的中间结果，以及验证失败并导致标签被修订的环节。 某一阶段可能与其前一阶段相矛盾，在 1,533 个可评分项目中，有 685 项（占 44.7%）的最终层级与预验证信号不同。 实际差异在于读者如何利用这种分歧。 推理依据可能被判定为缺乏说服力，但标签本身仍然成立。 推理轨迹可以在某个明确标注的阶段被拒绝，从而识别出该阶段以相同方式决定的所有其他项目。

paragraphs.en: The three substitutions were forced by access, so removing them means releasing material that was withheld for a reason. Two works of literature state what that costs and what it is worth.
paragraphs.zh: 这三次替换是由于获取渠道的限制而被迫实施的，因此移除它们意味着释放了原本因某种原因被保留的内容。 两部文学作品说明了这样做需要付出什么代价，以及它本身的价值所在。

paragraphs.en: Because memory accumulates personal information, a parallel line asks what a system should decline to use. ConfAIde ( Mireshghallah et al., 2024 ) and CIMemories ( Mireshghallah et al., 2026 ) apply contextual integrity to model outputs, showing that appropriateness depends on the recipient and the purpose. CIMemories shapes our design for a methodological reason. It argues that leakage and utility must be scored on the same items. The same logic governs retrieval. A memory system that surfaces nothing never intrudes and never helps, which is why restraint and recall are scored on the same probes and why the abstention controls in Section 4 exist. The release itself is held to the same standard: Appendix H reports what an adversary recovers from the files alongside what the files still support.
paragraphs.zh: 由于记忆会积累个人信息，因此一个并行问题需要探讨系统应当拒绝使用哪些信息。 ConfAIde（Mireshghallah 等人，2024）和 CIMemories（Mireshghallah 等人，2026）将情境完整性应用于模型输出，表明信息的适当性取决于接收者和用途。 CIMemories 基于方法论上的原因塑造了我们的设计。 它主张，信息泄露和效用必须基于相同的指标进行评分。 同样的逻辑也适用于信息检索。 一个完全不输出任何信息的记忆系统既不会干扰用户，也无法提供帮助，因此抑制与召回需要基于相同的查询进行评分，这也是第 4 节中设置克制控制的原因。 信息的释放本身也必须遵循相同的标准：附录 H 报告了攻击者从文件中恢复的内容，以及文件仍支持的内容。

paragraphs.en: Outside machine learning, researchers study these relationships directly. Interview studies of companion application users describe how the relationship develops over months and what people come to expect from it ( Skjuve et al., 2021 ) , and follow-on work examines how users construe the bond, including where they treat it as a friendship and where they do not ( Brandtzaeg et al., 2022 ) . Thematic analyses document the social support people report receiving ( Ta et al., 2020 ) , and grounded-theory work on emotional dependence documents the harms, including distress when the system’s behavior changes ( Laestadius et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在机器学习领域之外，研究人员会直接研究这些关系。 对陪伴类应用用户的访谈研究表明，这种关系如何在数月间逐步发展，以及人们逐渐对其产生哪些期待（Skjuve 等，2021）；后续研究则探讨了用户如何诠释这种联结，包括他们何时将其视为友谊，何时又不这样认为（Brandtzaeg 等，2022）。 主题分析记录了人们报告所获得的社会支持（Ta 等，2020）；而基于扎根理论对情感依赖的研究则记录了由此带来的危害，包括当系统行为发生变化时用户所感受到的困扰（Laestadius 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Every one of these studies works from what people say about the interaction, through interviews, surveys, app reviews and forum posts. That is the constraint that produced the three substitutions, met by a different field and answered a different way. Where machine learning generated a substitute for the interaction, this literature asked people to recall it. This release supplies the interaction itself, which is why every profile claim cites the messages behind it and every chat item carries its reasoning trace. What the corpus cannot supply is what these studies supply. It contains no participant’s account, and ten people who chose one product are not a sample of any population.
paragraphs.zh: 所有这些研究都基于人们通过访谈、调查、应用评论和论坛帖子对互动所做的描述。 正是这一限制促成了三种替代方案的出现，它们来自不同的领域，并以不同的方式得到回应。 当机器学习为互动生成替代方案时，这些文献则要求人们回忆互动本身。 此次发布提供了互动本身，因此每个用户资料声明都会引用其背后的消息，而每个聊天项都包含其推理痕迹。 语料库无法提供的东西，正是这些研究所提供的内容。 它不包含任何参与者的叙述，而且选择某一款产品的十个人并不能构成任何群体的样本。

sents.zh: 所有这些研究都基于人们通过访谈、调查、应用评论和论坛帖子对互动所做的描述。

paragraphs.en: A conversation between a particular person and an agent over months exists once, belongs to that person, and cannot be regenerated if the release is wrong. That asymmetry is why Appendix H measures what an adversary recovers, and why the Ethics Statement states the basis on which the material may be used. Removing the substitutions is a question of consent before it is a question of scale.
paragraphs.zh: 某个人与智能体之间持续数月的对话仅存在一次，属于该个人所有，如果发布内容有误，也无法重新生成。 正是这种不对称性，使得附录 H 需要衡量攻击者能够恢复的信息，也使得《伦理声明》必须说明使用这些材料所依据的原则。 移除替换内容首先是一个同意问题，而不是一个规模问题。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 marks five properties and groups its rows by a sixth, stated here as criteria a reader can apply to a benchmark the table does not list.
paragraphs.zh: 表1列出了五个属性，并根据第六个属性对行进行了分组，此处将其表述为读者可用于评估该表中未列出的基准测试的标准。

paragraphs.en: A cell is half-filled when the benchmark poses no task for which the column is defined, and no when it poses the task and lacks the property. CIMemories, PRISM, and CompanionBench score appropriateness or preference, so the evidence column does not apply to them, while PersonaChat is scored against a record and names no evidence, so it is open. The table lists a benchmark when it scores a response conditioned on a record of a particular person. That criterion excludes work discussed above for other reasons: conversational query rewriting and reading comprehension pose no person; persona corpora supply a record but no evaluation; and memory architectures are systems. Every cell was read from the benchmark’s own description of itself, and each is recorded with a page reference in the reproduction map released with the corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 当基准测试未提出该列所定义的任务时，单元格为半填充；而当它提出了任务但缺少相应属性时，则完全不填充。 CIMemories、PRISM 和 CompanionBench 评分依据的是适当性或偏好，因此证据列不适用于它们；而 PersonaChat 则是根据记录进行评分且未提及任何证据，因此该列保持开放状态。 当基准测试对基于特定人物记录的回应进行评分时，表格中会列出该基准测试。 这一标准排除了上述因其他原因被讨论的工作：对话查询重写和阅读理解并未涉及特定人物；人物语料库提供了记录但缺乏评估；而记忆架构则属于系统范畴。 每个单元格的内容均摘自基准测试对自身所作的描述，并且每个单元格在随语料库一同发布的复现映射中均有页面引用记录。

sents.en: A cell is half-filled when the benchmark poses no task for which the column is defined, and no when it poses the task and lacks the property.
sents.zh: 当基准测试未提出该列所定义的任务时，单元格为半填充；而当它提出了任务但缺少相应属性时，则完全不填充。

sents.en: That criterion excludes work discussed above for other reasons: conversational query rewriting and reading comprehension pose no person; persona corpora supply a record but no evaluation; and memory architectures are systems.
sents.zh: 这一标准排除了上述因其他原因被讨论的工作：对话查询重写和阅读理解并未涉及特定人物；人物语料库提供了记录但缺乏评估；而记忆架构则属于系统范畴。

sents.en: Every cell was read from the benchmark’s own description of itself, and each is recorded with a page reference in the reproduction map released with the corpus.

paragraphs.en: The corpus comes from an internal AI-companion application in which a user keeps a persistent friendship-style companion. The companion has a name, a mood, an outfit, and the application layers a daily streak, a habit tracker, a snack economy and several mini-games over an open-ended chat. Two properties of this setting matter for the benchmark. The traffic is ordinary contact, made of greetings, accounts of a day, running jokes and long stretches in which nothing is asked. The companion also opens the exchange as often as the participant does, speaking first on 217 of the 430 active days against 207 for a participant and 6 for the application, so a probe often sits inside a conversation the participant did not start. Both properties are costly to script, and a corpus written for evaluation rarely has either.
paragraphs.zh: 该语料库来自一款内部的人工智能陪伴应用，用户在该应用中与一个持久的、类似朋友的角色保持互动。 这个陪伴角色有名字、情绪和穿着，而应用则在其开放式聊天之上叠加了每日连续使用记录、习惯追踪器、零食经济以及多个迷你游戏。 这一设置的两个特性对基准测试至关重要。 其中的交互内容属于日常接触，包括问候、一天经历的叙述、持续的笑话，以及长时间没有任何提问的对话。 该陪伴角色也会像用户一样主动开启对话：在 430 个活跃日中，有 217 天由它率先发言，而用户主动发起对话的天数为 207 天，应用本身仅发起 6 次；因此，探测到的交互常常存在于用户并未主动开始的对话之中。 这两个特性都难以通过脚本实现，而为评估专门编写的语料库通常很少具备其中任何一种。

How that divides between the subjects, and what the derived layers add to it, is in Appendix C.5 ; Table 2 gives the per-subject totals. paragraphs.en: A profile file has eleven top-level fields. Seven of them, identity (13 fixed slots), user_facts (16 kinds), entities (named people, pets and objects, each with its own claims), psychology (stressors, coping, behaviors), speaking_style (6 slots), personality_dimensions (21 slots) and background (4 slots), are built from one repeated object, the claim record, whose fields are in Table 12 . Every claim carries the messages that establish it, so a reader can retrieve them from source and decide that the claim is wrong. behavior differs in kind. It holds statistics measured from the messages and needs no evidence list to be recomputed. The remaining three, name , narrative and big_five , are plain values and are the only unevidenced content in the file. The big_five of persona is a different object and does carry evidence. Keys prefixed l5_ record repairs made after the final pseudonymization pass.
paragraphs.zh: 一个配置文件包含十一个顶层字段。 其中七个字段——身份（13个固定槽位）、用户事实（16种类型）、实体（命名的人物、宠物和对象，每个都有各自的声明）、心理状态（压力源、应对机制和行为）、说话风格（6个槽位）、性格维度（21个槽位）以及背景（4个槽位）——均构建于一个重复对象“声明记录”之上，其字段详见表12。 每条声明都承载了构成该声明的信息，因此读者可以从源头检索这些信息，并据此判断该声明是否错误。行为则属于不同类别。 它存储了从信息中测量出的统计数据，无需重新计算证据列表。 其余三个字段——姓名、叙述和“大五”——均为普通值，也是文件中唯一没有证据支持的内容。 persona的“大五”是一个不同的对象，并且确实包含证据。 以l5_为前缀的键记录了最终假名化步骤之后进行的修复操作。

paragraphs.en: A persona file is flat: thirty-nine content slots beside three identifier fields. Sixteen are demographic slots, eleven are prose portraits of a life domain, two are lists derived from those portraits, and ten are other descriptive fields. Among the ten, psychotherapy_note holds named working hypotheses, each with its grounds and how firmly it is held, inferred_traits gives each trait its reasoning and a strength, and big_five and quirks carry evidence lists of their own. An _evidence object maps the prose fields to the messages behind them. Unlike profile , persona holds interpretations. Its traits and hypotheses carry a stated strength, its prose fields a confidence through _evidence , and its demographic values, narrative and derived lists carry no marker of either kind. Of the 390 content slots across the ten subjects, 207 are empty, and the emptiness is concentrated: Appendix C.6 gives the breakdown.
paragraphs.zh: 人格档案是扁平的：除了三个标识字段外，还有三十九个内容槽位。 其中十六个是人口统计学槽位，十一个是对某个生活领域的文字描述，两个是从这些描述中推导出的列表，另外十个是其他描述性字段。 在这十个字段中，psychotherapy_note 保存了带有名称的工作假设，每个假设都包含其依据以及被接受的程度；inferred_traits 为每个特质提供了推理依据和强度值；而 big_five 和 quirks 则各自携带证据列表。 一个 _evidence 对象将文字字段与其背后的信息关联起来。 与 profile 不同，persona 包含了解释性内容。 其特质和假设带有明确的强度值，文字字段通过 _evidence 体现置信度，而人口统计学数值、叙述性内容和推导出的列表则没有任何此类标记。 在十个主题共 390 个内容槽位中，有 207 个是空的，且空槽位高度集中：附录 C.6 给出了具体分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Table 13 gives the chat row. The file holds 2,034 rows in three strata. The proportional and enriched strata form the 1,600 sampled rows, 1,533 of them scoreable, and the remaining 434 are cold opens held as an abstention control and excluded from every headline count. Three fields carry what a system is scored against, probe , required_context and gold_response , and the rest exist so that those can be contested. trace records how each label was produced stage by stage, signals records what the pre-verification heuristic proposed before any check ran, and l5_category_recomputed records the 72 scoreable rows whose category changed when stage C was re-run. A row with withdrawn set is excluded from every count in this paper, and 13 of the 67 withdrawn rows ship without probe text.
paragraphs.zh: 表13给出了聊天行。 该文件包含三个分层中的2034行数据。 比例分层和增强分层共同构成了1600个抽样行，其中1533行为可评分行，其余434行为冷启动样本，用作弃权对照，并排除在所有标题计数之外。 三个字段记录了系统评分所依据的内容：probe、required_context 和 gold_response；其余字段的存在是为了便于对这些内容进行质疑。trace 记录了每个标签分阶段生成的过程，signals 记录了在运行任何检查之前预验证启发式方法提出的内容，而 l5_category_recomputed 则记录了在重新运行阶段C时类别发生变化的72个可评分行。 在本论文中，所有设置了 withdrawn 的行都被排除在各类计数之外，而在67个被撤回的行中，有13行未附带 probe 文本。

paragraphs.en: A qa row carries question , answer , category , answerable , evidence , qtype and stratum , with optional markers recording repairs. Evidence is present on 3,249 of the 3,312 rows and absent on exactly the 63 marked unanswerable. The file also carries a difficulty field, normalized at assembly to the four tiers with the delivered value preserved as difficulty_delivered .
paragraphs.zh: 每一行都包含问题、答案、类别、可回答性、证据、问题类型和层级，并带有记录修复操作的可选标记。 在 3,312 行中，有 3,249 行存在证据，而恰好 63 行被标记为无法回答且没有证据。 该文件还包含一个难度字段，在整合时已归入四个等级，同时保留了原始值作为 difficulty_delivered。

paragraphs.en: Two properties of the release will otherwise be discovered the hard way. First, a profile_refs entry in a chat row resolves to the transcript through its evidence_dayids , not through its claim_text , which is a readable copy and matches a profile claim verbatim on 631 of 749 entries; a join on text will silently lose the rest. Second, the profile ships 455 claims whose audit verdict is unsupported , retained so that the audit can itself be checked. The chat track cites none of them. Of the 631 references that resolve to a claim, 486 resolve to a claim the audit supported, 107 to one it judged repairable, 16 to one needing review, 22 to one it did not judge, and none to one it marked unsupported.
paragraphs.zh: 否则，该发布版本的两个特性将只能通过痛苦的方式被发现。 首先，聊天行中的 profile_refs 条目会通过其 evidence_dayids 解析到对话记录，而非通过其 claim_text；claim_text 是可供阅读的版本，在 749 个条目中仅有 631 个与 profile claim 完全一致；若按文本进行关联，其余条目将悄无声息地丢失。 其次，该 profile 包含 455 条 claim，其审核结论为“未获支持”，但这些内容仍被保留，以便对审核过程本身进行核查。 聊天记录中并未引用其中任何一条。 在解析到 claim 的 631 个参考中，有 486 个解析到审核支持的 claim，107 个解析到审核判定可修复的 claim，16 个解析到需要审查的 claim，22 个解析到审核未作判定的 claim，而没有任何一个解析到审核标记为“未获支持”的 claim。

paragraphs.en: Every message carries a stored identifier of the form day n n - j j , where n n is the rank of the message’s date among the dates on which that subject was active, so n n runs from 1 to the subject’s active-day count, and j j is the position of the message within its day in the stream as it stood before the removals described below. The stream is ordered by timestamp with ties broken by identifier; exactly one tie occurs corpus-wide. Identifiers are stored, not computed. Every reference in the release resolves by lookup on the identifier, and reconstructing j j by counting released messages is incorrect on 355 of the 1,600 sampled chat rows.
paragraphs.zh: 每条消息都携带一个存储的标识符，格式为 day n n - j j，其中 n n 是该消息日期在其对应主题活跃日期中的排名，因此 n n 的取值范围从 1 到该主题的活跃天数，而 j j 则是消息在删除前所在日期的消息流中的位置。 消息流按时间戳排序，若时间戳相同则通过标识符决定顺序；整个语料库中仅存在一处时间戳相同的记录。 标识符是存储的，而非计算得出。 发布版本中的每个引用都通过查找标识符来确定，而在 1,600 个抽样聊天行中，有 355 行的 j j 若通过统计已发布的消息数量来重建则是错误的。

paragraphs.en: Four features of the transcript are properties of the application, and reading them as speech would be an error. A companion turn is delivered as a sequence of chat bubbles separated by /// , and 3,009 turns carry such a separator and no other marker. A companion turn may also offer tappable suggested replies, appended after //// ; 8,121 of the 14,329 companion turns do so, and the text after that marker was never uttered by anyone. Thirty-three of the 12,795 user turns reproduce a suggested reply character for character, 54 after case and punctuation are normalized, against 32,688 chips offered in 8,121 companion messages. The affordance the product invests in is almost entirely unused. Turns with sender app are instructions the client posted into the feed to steer the companion’s next reply, typically on receipt of a gift in the snack economy; they are visible in the feed, but they are not the subject’s words. Media markers appear on 902 companion turns and 426 user turns.
paragraphs.zh: 转录文本的四个特征是应用程序的属性，若将其作为语音读取则属于错误。 伴随回合以一系列由 /// 分隔的聊天气泡形式呈现，其中 3,009 个回合包含此类分隔符且无其他标记。 伴随回合也可能提供可点击的建议回复，这些回复附加在 //// 之后；14,329 个伴随回合中有 8,121 个如此操作，而该标记之后的文本从未被任何人说出。 在 12,795 个用户回合中，有 33 个逐字符复制了建议回复，在忽略大小写和标点符号后则有 54 个；相比之下，8,121 条伴随消息提供了 32,688 个“芯片”。 该产品投入的交互设计几乎完全未被使用。 发送方为应用程序的回合是客户端发布到信息流中的指令，用于引导伴随者的下一个回复，通常是在零食经济中收到礼物时触发；这些指令在信息流中可见，但它们并非对话主体的发言。 媒体标记出现在 902 个伴随回合和 426 个用户回合中。

paragraphs.en: Timestamps were shifted by a per-subject offset, uniform across every date and timestamp belonging to that subject, deterministic in the subject identifier, with magnitude between 60 and 359 days and a sign that varies by subject. Time of day is carried through unchanged. Every interval is therefore exact, so active spans, gaps between sessions, session rhythm and the hour at which a subject writes are all preserved and can be measured from the release. Day of the week survives only for a participant whose offset happens to be a multiple of seven, and a reader cannot tell which participants those are, so the release supports no claim about weekday or weekend behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 时间戳根据每位受试者的偏移量进行了调整，同一受试者在所有日期和时间戳上的偏移量保持一致，且该偏移量由受试者标识符唯一确定，其幅度在 60 至 359 天之间，符号则因受试者而异。 一天中的时间部分保持不变。 因此，每个时间间隔都是精确的，所以活跃时段、会话之间的间隙、会话节奏以及受试者写作的小时数均得以保留，并可以从发布的数据中测量出来。 只有当某位参与者的偏移量恰好是 7 的倍数时，其星期几信息才会保留下来，而读者无法判断哪些参与者属于这种情况，因此该发布数据不支持对工作日或周末行为的任何推断。

paragraphs.en: An observation window runs from a subject’s first message to their last authored turn. It closes on a turn the subject wrote, because the companion may send further messages after someone has stopped replying, and counting those would credit the relationship with days in which the subject was absent. Both bounds are recoverable from the released timestamps, so the window is re-computable. Its length is the number of calendar days it touches, counting both endpoints. Windows span 36 to 120 days, of which 9 to 111 carry activity. Because the offset above is uniform within a subject, the length of a window is exact even though its position in the calendar is not.
paragraphs.zh: 观察窗口从主体的第一条消息开始，到其最后一条自己撰写的回合结束。 该窗口在主体撰写的一个回合时关闭，因为即使某人已停止回复，其同伴仍可能继续发送消息；若将这些消息也计算在内，就会将主体缺席的日子计入关系存续时间。 两个边界都可以通过已发布的 timestamps 恢复，因此该窗口可以重新计算。 窗口的长度是指其所覆盖的日历天数，且包含两个端点。 窗口的持续时间为 36 至 120 天，其中仅有 9 至 111 天存在活动。 由于上述偏移量在主体内部是统一的，因此尽管窗口在日历上的位置不精确，其长度仍然是精确的。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 is re-computable from the release, and this is what each column counts. Span is the length of the observation window defined in Appendix C.4 , and Active days is the number of calendar days on which any message was sent. Messages counts every message regardless of sender, 12,795 of them the participants’ own. Chat items counts scoreablerows in the proportional and enriched strata, and Question items counts question rows not withdrawn, of which 77 are.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 可以根据发布内容重新计算，各列的具体统计内容如下。 Span 是附录 C.4 中定义的观察窗口长度，而 Active days 是任何消息被发送的日历天数。 Messages 统计了所有消息，无论发送者是谁，其中 12,795 条来自参与者本人。 Chat items 统计了比例层和增强层中的可计分行，而 Question items 统计了未被撤回的问题行，其中 77 行为此类问题。

paragraphs.en: The ten subjects differ by two orders of magnitude. The smallest contributes 115 turns over 9 active days and the largest 12,627 over 95, and density varies independently of volume: one subject is active on 111 of 111 consecutive days, another on 9 days spread across 36. The derived layers scale with the transcript, from 22 profile claims to 1,363, but one of them conspicuously does not. Persona emptiness is almost flat across the corpus: the subject with 115 turns leaves 26 of 39 slots empty and the subject with 12,627 leaves 19. A hundredfold increase in what someone said fills seven further slots. The sparsity reported in Section 3 is therefore not an artifact of thin data, and Appendix C.6 gives the breakdown by slot type.
paragraphs.zh: 这十个主体的差异达到了两个数量级。 主体中最小的一个在 9 个活跃日内贡献了 115 次发言，最大的一个则在 95 天内贡献了 12,627 次；而密度与体积无关：其中一个主体在连续 111 天中的 111 天都保持活跃，另一个则在 36 天内分散于 9 天活跃。 推导出的各层会随着转录文本的规模而变化，从 22 个特征声明到 1,363 个，但其中有一层明显不符合这一规律。 在整个语料库中，人格的空缺度几乎保持恒定：拥有 115 次发言的主体留下了 39 个槽位中的 26 个为空，而拥有 12,627 次发言的主体则留下了 19 个空槽。 某人的发言量增加一百倍，也只会额外填满七个槽位。 因此，第 3 节中报告的稀疏性并非数据量不足造成的假象，附录 C.6 提供了按槽位类型划分的详细数据。

paragraphs.en: The concentration decides how results are aggregated. Two subjects supply 73% of the turns, so a figure pooled over items estimates how those two behave, which is why every rate in this paper is reported pooled over items with its macro beside it, as Appendix A.2 specifies. One consequence must be stated. Under the strict reading of Appendix D.4 five subjects contribute no memory-bearing probes at all, so quantities conditioned on memory demand are macro-averaged over the five that do and not over ten, and on the proportional stratum those five contribute between one and seven probes each. Table 14 gives the counts. Intervals on those quantities are correspondingly wide and are reported as they come out.

paragraphs.en: Extraction is adversarial toward its own output, and most of what it proposes it throws away. Of 7,176 candidate claims, 2,654 were dropped for cause: 1,508 cited no evidence at all, 693 were ungrounded in the evidence they did cite, and 453 were unreliable given it, a rejection rate of 37.0%. A further 1,212 were merged into existing claims as duplicates, and a later enrichment pass over the same conversations restored material the first pass had missed, leaving the 3,580 claims that ship, 3,579 of them carrying evidence. Every drop reason is released. The rejected material is informative, because attributes that were never stated and aspirations recorded as facts are exactly the errors that would otherwise become gold answers.
paragraphs.zh: 提取过程与其自身输出存在对抗性，其提出的大多数内容最终都被舍弃了。 在 7,176 个候选主张中，有 2,654 个因特定原因被剔除：其中 1,508 个完全没有引用证据，693 个与其引用的证据无关，另有 453 个基于现有证据并不可靠，剔除率为 37.0%。 另有 1,212 个因重复而被合并到现有主张中，随后对相同对话进行的补充处理恢复了第一轮遗漏的内容，最终保留的 3,580 个主张中，有 3,579 个附有证据。 所有剔除原因均会公开。 被拒绝的内容具有信息价值，因为那些从未被提及的属性以及被当作事实记录的目标，恰恰是原本可能成为“黄金答案”的错误类型。

paragraphs.en: A later audit re-examined the surviving claims against source , judged 3,378 of the 3,580, and recorded each verdict on the claim itself; Table 15 gives the distribution. Claims the audit could not support are retained, so that the audit is itself auditable: a reader who disagrees with a verdict has the claim, its evidence and the verdict in front of them. Eighteen further markers record what was done to individual claims, among them 538 rejudged after an error in source was corrected, 500 re-filed against a normalized entity name, 290 with a speaker attribution fixed, 135 with journal evidence pruned and 69 with a date re-anchored. Appendix C.2 reports that no chat item cites a claim the audit marked unsupported.
paragraphs.zh: 后续的一次审计重新审查了针对来源的现存主张，对 3,580 项中的 3,378 项作出了判断，并将每一项裁决记录在相应的主张中；表 15 展示了其分布情况。 审计无法支持的主张仍被保留，因此审计本身也具有可审计性：任何对某项裁决持不同意见的读者，都能直接看到该主张、其证据以及相应的裁决。 另有十八个标记记录了针对各项主张所采取的具体措施，其中包括在来源错误得到纠正后重新判断的 538 项、针对标准化后的实体名称重新提交的 500 项、发言人归属得到修正的 290 项、期刊证据经过裁剪的 135 项以及日期被重新锚定的 69 项。 附录 C.2 报告称，没有任何聊天项目引用了审计中被标记为无法支持的主张。

paragraphs.en: The persona is assembled by a different procedure and to a different standard, since its entries are interpretations of the participant. Its emptiness is not uniform, and the gradient is the finding. Of the 160 demographic slots across the ten participants, 147 are empty. The ten of them that Nemotron-Personas-USA also defines, and fills for each of its million personas, are empty on 96 of 100. Of the 110 domain portraits, which ask what the participant is like in one area of life, 45 are empty, and so are 3 of the 20 lists derived from them. Of the 100 remaining descriptive fields, 12 are empty. A slot that can be read from anything a person says, such as how they communicate or what their personality is, is almost always filled. A slot that needs them to have raised one particular topic is filled less often, and a slot that needs them to state a category outright is almost never filled. People tell a companion about their family, their health and what is worrying them, and almost never state their census category. Volume barely moves this, since the participant with 115 messages leaves 26 of 39 slots empty and the participant with 12,627 leaves 17.
paragraphs.zh: 人设的构建采用了不同的流程与标准，因为其条目是对参与者的解读。 其空值状态并不均匀，而这种梯度变化正是研究结果。 在十位参与者共 160 个人口统计信息栏中，有 147 个为空。 其中，Nemotron-Personas-USA 也为每个百万人设定义了 10 个栏位并进行了填充，但在这 10 个栏位中，有 96 个是空的（占 100 个中的 96 个）。 在 110 个领域画像栏中（用于询问参与者在某一生活领域的情况），有 45 个为空；由此派生出的 20 个列表中，也有 3 个为空。 在剩余的 100 个描述性字段中，有 12 个为空。 那些可以通过一个人的任何言论（例如沟通方式或性格特征）读取信息的栏位，几乎总是被填写的。 需要参与者主动提及某个特定话题的栏位则较少被填写；而需要他们直接声明某一类别的栏位，几乎从未被填写。 人们会向陪伴者讲述自己的家庭、健康状况以及担忧的问题，但几乎从不提及自己的人口普查类别。 信息量对此几乎没有影响：发送了 115 条消息的参与者仍有 39 个栏位中的 26 个为空，而发送了 12,627 条消息的参与者则有 17 个栏位为空。

paragraphs.en: Across the released files the derived layers place 18,983 references into source : 5,113 from chat , 4,964 from qa , 6,784 from profile and 2,122 from persona . Every one of them resolves to a message in the released source . Counting withdrawn chat rows as well brings the total to 19,042, and the phase D grounding lists add a further 1,740 identifiers over scoreable rows, all of which also resolve. No reference anywhere in the release points at a message that is not there.
paragraphs.zh: 在已发布的文件中，派生层共包含 18,983 个引用，其中来自聊天的有 5,113 个，来自问答的有 4,964 个，来自个人资料的有 6,784 个，来自人格设定的有 2,122 个。 这些引用中的每一个都对应到已发布源文件中的某条消息。 如果将已撤回的聊天行也计算在内，总数将达到 19,042；阶段 D 的基础依据列表还额外增加了 1,740 个标识符（超出可评分的行数），且这些标识符也都存在对应内容。 在发布内容中，没有任何引用指向一条并不存在的消息。

paragraphs.en: The claim that the annotation can be checked against the transcript is a claim about one file pair, and it holds exactly. Each of the 1,533 scoreable chat rows names its probe by identifier, and all 1,533 resolve to a message in source whose text is identical to the probe recorded in the ground truth, character for character. The same holds for all 434 rows of the abstention control. 13 identifiers in the chat file do not resolve, and all thirteen belong to withdrawn rows whose text was removed with them. No scoreable row depends on a message that is absent, and no scoreable row quotes a message inexactly.
paragraphs.zh: 关于标注内容可与转录文本对照验证的说法，是针对单个文件对的论断，且该论断完全成立。 在 1,533 行可评分的聊天记录中，每一行都通过标识符来命名其探针，并且所有 1,533 行都能对应到源文本中的某条消息，其文本与基准数据中记录的探针逐字符完全一致。 对于全部 434 行弃权对照组而言，情况同样成立。聊天文件中有 13 个标识符无法匹配，而这十三个均属于已被撤回的记录，其文本也一并被删除。 没有任何一行可评分的记录依赖于缺失的消息，也没有任何一行可评分的记录对消息进行不准确的引用。

paragraphs.en: Resolution is a weaker property than correctness and should not be read as more than it is. It establishes that every cited turn exists and that every probe is quoted exactly, which is what makes a disagreement with the annotation demonstrable. It does not establish that a cited turn supports the claim that cites it. That is what the audits assess: Appendix C.6 for the profile, Appendix D.6 for the chat track and Appendix D.8 for the question track.
paragraphs.zh: 可解析性是一个比正确性更弱的属性，不应将其解读为超出其实际意义的特性。 它确立了每个被引用的回合都存在，且每个探针都被精确引用，这正是使与标注的矛盾变得可验证的原因。 它并未确立某个被引用的回合能够支持引用该回合的主张。 审计评估的就是这一点：个人资料见附录 C.6，聊天轨道见附录 D.6，问题轨道见附录 D.8。

paragraphs.en: Section 4 describes what a chat item records and why its labels can be trusted. This appendix gives the full derivation and what it rejected. It covers the five stages ( D.1 ), probe selection ( D.2 ), the three labels and their recomputability ( D.3 ), the judgment of whether a referent was already on screen ( D.4 ), the rows withdrawn, demoted or repaired ( D.5 ), the independent audit ( D.6 ), the release gates ( D.7 ), and the question track ( D.8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 节描述了聊天项记录的内容以及其标签为何值得信赖。 本附录给出了完整的推导过程及其被拒绝的部分。 它涵盖了五个阶段（D.1）、探针选择（D.2）、三个标签及其可重新计算性（D.3）、判断指代对象是否已在屏幕上的方法（D.4）、被撤回、降级或修复的行（D.5）、独立审计（D.6）、发布闸门（D.7）以及问题追踪（D.8）。

sents.en: Section 4 describes what a chat item records and why its labels can be trusted.
sents.zh: 第 4 节描述了聊天项记录的内容以及其标签为何值得信赖。

sents.en: This appendix gives the full derivation and what it rejected.
sents.zh: 本附录给出了完整的推导过程及其被拒绝的部分。

sents.en: It covers the five stages ( D.1 ), probe selection ( D.2 ), the three labels and their recomputability ( D.3 ), the judgment of whether a referent was already on screen ( D.4 ), the rows withdrawn, demoted or repaired ( D.5 ), the independent audit ( D.6 ), the release gates ( D.7 ), and the question track ( D.8 ).
sents.zh: 它涵盖了五个阶段（D.1）、探针选择（D.2）、三个标签及其可重新计算性（D.3）、判断指代对象是否已在屏幕上的方法（D.4）、被撤回、降级或修复的行（D.5）、独立审计（D.6）、发布闸门（D.7）以及问题追踪（D.8）。

paragraphs.en: Derivation alternates between proposing and checking. Stages A and D put something forward, stages B and E check it against source , and stage C applies a fixed rule to what survives. The arrangement is what gives the error a direction, because no phase downstream of a check can restore what the check removed, so a failure of the pipeline makes an item look less demanding than it is. Table 16 states what each phase writes and what it is permitted to revise. Every phase records its own reasoning in the item, so a reader can locate a disagreement at the phase that caused it.

paragraphs.en: Phase A resolves what the probe is pointing at. It records the referring expression verbatim in referent_text and names the store the referent would live in, and it is permitted to be wrong, because nothing has been checked yet. Phase B is the check. For each reference A proposed it retrieves the candidate records and tests them against source , and where the evidence does not verify it removes the reference. A reference that survives B has been matched to turns that exist and precede the probe. A tier therefore falls only when stage B has removed evidence (Appendix D.5 ).

paragraphs.en: Phase C assigns the tier and the category by rule, from the context shape that survived B. Nineteen rules cover the corpus, and the item records which one fired in ruleC . paragraphs.en: Phase D writes the reference reply and records which turns it rests on. The test that matters is containment: the grounding must lie inside the recent window, the surviving references, and the probe itself, since a gold response is entitled to use the turn it is answering and the turns already on screen. Grounding is recorded on 1,342 of the 1,533 scoreable rows, and on none of them does it name a turn outside that set, which is the verification of the sufficiency condition of Appendix A.4 . On 297 rows the grounding is the probe alone, which is the ordinary case of a reply that answers what was just said.
paragraphs.zh: D 阶段撰写参考回复，并记录其依据的回合。 关键测试在于约束性：依据必须位于近期窗口、保留的参考以及探针本身之内，因为黄金回复有权使用其正在回答的回合以及屏幕上已有的回合。 在 1,533 个可评分行中，有 1,342 行的依据被记录，且没有任何一行提及该集合之外的回合，这验证了附录 A.4 中充分性条件的成立。 在 297 行中，依据仅为探针本身，这是回复刚刚所说内容的常规情况。

paragraphs.en: Phase E decides whether the item ships. It re-reads the probe, the gold, and the assigned category together and either passes the item or sends it back, and items that cannot be repaired are withdrawn. Every shipped row therefore carries ok and category_ok set true, on all 1,533, and this should not be read as evidence that the annotation is correct. It is a property of what ships: the field records that an item survived its own pipeline, not that an independent reader agrees with it. What speaks to correctness is the audit of Appendix D.6 , which was run afterwards and against different questions.
paragraphs.zh: E 阶段决定该物品是否发货。 它会重新同时阅读探测结果、黄金数据以及分配的分类，然后决定通过该物品或将其退回；无法修复的物品则会被撤回。 因此，所有已发货的行都带有 ok 和 category_ok 设为 true 的标记，共 1,533 行，但这不应被解读为标注正确的证据。 这是发货结果的一个属性：该字段记录的是某项物品通过了自身的流程，而非独立审阅者对其表示认同。 能够证明正确性的是附录 D.6 的审计，该审计是在之后针对不同的问题运行的。

paragraphs.en: Probes are user turns, and the sampling frame is every user turn in the corpus. Turns were drawn from buckets by a routing heuristic scored on the turn and its neighborhood, and the bucket each row came from is recorded in signals.hint . That field is deliberately never recomputed. It states which bucket the sampler drew from, before any phase had checked anything, so the released item preserves what the sampler believed alongside what the derivation found. A reader can therefore audit the sample as well as the labels.
paragraphs.zh: 探针即用户轮次，而抽样框架则是语料库中的每一个用户轮次。 轮次通过一种基于该轮次及其邻域得分的路由启发式方法从各个桶中抽取，而每一行所属的桶则记录在 signals.hint 中。 该字段被刻意设计为从不重新计算。 它在任何阶段尚未进行任何检查之前，就声明了采样器是从哪个桶中抽取的，因此释放的项目既保留了采样器的判断，也保留了推导过程的结果。 因此，读者既可以审计样本，也可以审计标签。

paragraphs.en: The chat file carries three strata, and they answer different questions. The proportional stratum is 1,227 rows, 1,169 of them scoreable, drawn between 32 and 326 per participant without conditioning on whether a message needs memory. It alone has a denominator, so every rate that describes the traffic is computed on it and nowhere else. The enriched stratum is 373 rows, 364 scoreable, found by running stage A over all 11,581 unused user messages and keeping what stage B verified. All 364 are memory-bearing by construction, so the stratum supplies power and no rate, since comparisons conditioned on memory demand would otherwise rest on the 40 such rows the proportional stratum contains. The abstention control is 434 session openers with empty context lists, scored apart and entering no rate. The census also corroborates the proportional estimate: stage B verified a distant referent on 3.7% of the 11,369 messages stage A classified, against 3.4% in the proportional stratum.
paragraphs.zh: 聊天文件包含三个层级，它们分别回答不同的问题。 比例层级包含 1,227 行，其中 1,169 行为可评分行，每参与者的数据范围在 32 到 326 之间，且未根据消息是否需要记忆进行条件限定。 仅该层级有分母，因此所有描述流量的比率均基于此计算，而非其他任何层级。 增强层级包含 373 行，其中 364 行为可评分行，其生成方式是对全部 11,581 条未使用的用户消息运行阶段 A，并保留阶段 B 验证过的内容。 根据设计，这 364 行均承载记忆功能，因此该层级提供能力但不产生任何比率；否则，基于记忆需求进行的比较将不得不依赖比例层级中存在的 40 条此类消息。 弃权控制组包含 434 个上下文列表为空会话开端消息，这些消息单独评分且不计入任何比率。 普查数据也证实了比例估计值：在阶段 A 分类的 11,369 条消息中，阶段 B 对其中 3.7% 的消息验证了远端参照物，而比例层级中的这一比例为 3.4%。

paragraphs.en: Because the bucket is preserved, the sample yields a measurement nobody designed it to yield. Table 17 crosses the bucket a row was drawn from against the tier phase C assigned after verification. They agree on 848 of the 1,532 rows carrying a comparable bucket, so the heuristic was wrong 44.6% of the time; one further row carries a non-tier bucket value and is excluded. The failures are not symmetric. Of the 97 turns the sampler was most confident carried a distant memory demand, 10 survived verification as hard , and 72 turned out to need nothing beyond the current thread. Of the 386 it routed as intermediate , 88 were. Of the 173 it routed as needing nothing, 63 turned out to need a specific earlier exchange. This is an independent estimate of the same quantity the retrieval analysis reports: whether a turn needs memory is not predictable from the turn and what surrounds it. It arrived as a byproduct of building the sample.
paragraphs.zh: 由于该桶被保留下来，样本产生了一个原本无人设计过的测量结果。 表 17 将抽取自某行的桶与验证后分配的 C 级阶段进行了交叉对照。 在 1,532 行中，有 848 行具有可比较的桶值，因此该启发式方法 44.6% 的时间是错误的；另外一行具有非层级桶值，因此被排除在外。 这些失败并非对称的。 在采样器最确信为远距离内存需求的 97 次转向中，有 10 次在验证中被确认为困难转向，另有 72 次实际上无需超出当前线程的任何额外资源。 在其被路由为中间转向的 386 次中，有 88 次确实如此。 在其被路由为无需任何资源的 173 次中，有 63 次实际上需要某个特定的早期交换。 这是与检索分析所报告同一数量的独立估计：转向是否需要内存无法仅从该转向及其上下文预测出来。 这一结果是在构建样本过程中意外产生的副产品。

paragraphs.en: The two strata are never pooled for a rate, and the reason is visible in the paragraph above. A pooled denominator mixes turns drawn without regard to memory demand with turns selected for it, so the resulting figure estimates neither the traffic nor the swept population. Every rate in this paper names its stratum, and a rate quoted without one is not defined. Comparisons conditioned on memory demand are reported on both strata separately, because the proportional estimate is the honest one and the enriched estimate is the one with enough rows to have an interval worth reading. Comparisons are reported on the proportional stratum and on the full scoreable set. The first has no selection, and the second has enough memory-bearing rows for an interval worth reading.

The tier and the category are functions of the context the item was left with, computed by rule in phase C and therefore re-computable by anyone holding the file. paragraphs.en: The tier is the shape of the context lists, and the correspondence is exact. Of the 1,533 scoreable rows, 1,073 carry a recent window and no references and are basic ; 223 carry at least one profile reference and are intermediate ; 181 carry at least one episode reference and are hard ; and 56 carry nothing at all and are edge . No row populates both reference lists, and no row of one tier has the shape of another. The consequence is that a reader never has to accept a tier: recomputing it from the three lists either reproduces the shipped label on every row, which it does, or identifies the rows where it does not.
paragraphs.zh: 层级即上下文列表的形状，且二者完全对应。 在 1,533 个可评分的行中，有 1,073 行包含近期窗口且无引用，属于基础层级；223 行至少包含一个个人资料引用，属于中级层级；181 行至少包含一个剧集引用，属于困难层级；另有 56 行完全没有任何内容，属于边缘层级。 没有任何一行同时填充了两个引用列表，也没有任何一行的层级形状与另一行相同。 因此，读者无需接受任何预定的层级：只需根据三个列表重新计算，即可在每行上重现已分配的标签（结果确实如此），或找出那些标签不匹配的行。

paragraphs.en: The category subdivides the tier and is assigned by the same stage C rule from the same inputs. Every chat category but one lies inside a single tier, and change_over_time spans two (97 intermediate, 8 hard), so Table 18 refines the tier partition with one exception. Categories are released at full granularity even where a category holds few items, because a downstream user can pool labels and cannot recover a distinction that was merged away. A category is reported in this paper only under the rule the manifest records and gate O enforces: macro-averaged where it holds at least five scoreable items in at least five participants, pooled otherwise, and released without a claim below twenty items.
paragraphs.zh: 该类别对层级进行细分，并由同一输入中的相同阶段 C 规则分配。 除一个聊天类别外，所有类别都位于单个层级内，而 change_over_time 跨越两个层级（97 个中间层级和 8 个困难层级），因此表 18 通过一个例外情况对层级划分进行了细化。 即使某个类别包含的项目很少，也会以完整粒度发布该类别，因为下游用户可能会合并标签，而无法恢复已被合并的区分。 本文仅根据 manifest 记录且 gate O 强制执行的规则报告某一类别：若该类别在至少五个参与者中拥有至少五个可评分的项目，则进行宏观平均；否则进行合并，并在项目数量低于二十时不附带任何声明发布。

paragraphs.en: The locus names which store holds the record a probe needs, and it takes five values. Phase A states it and phase B tests it, and both are recorded, so an item carries what was claimed alongside what survived verification. Table 19 gives the verified distribution by stratum. The locus and the tier cross in only six of their twenty possible cells. thread is the 1,009 basic items that need the current exchange, none splits into 64 basic items and the 56 edge items, profile is exactly the intermediate tier, and episode and companion are exactly the hard tier, separated by whether the record is something the participant said or something the companion did. Appendix D.5 gives the rows on which the claimed and verified values differ.
paragraphs.zh: 存储探针所需记录的位置名称需要五个值。 A阶段声明该信息，B阶段对其进行测试，两者均被记录，因此每个条目都包含所声明的内容以及通过验证的内容。 表19给出了按层级划分的已验证分布情况。 在二十个可能的单元格中，位置与层级仅在六个单元格中交叉。「线程」是需要当前交换的1,009个基本条目，其中没有条目会拆分为64个基本条目和56个边缘条目；「配置文件」恰好是中间层级，而「事件」和「同伴」恰好是困难层级，其区分标准在于记录内容是参与者所说的话还是同伴所做的事情。 附录D.5列出了声明值与已验证值存在差异的行。

paragraphs.en: Condition V2 of Appendix A.4 requires that a reference name something the system must go and find, not something already in front of it. The derivation cannot guarantee this. Phase A resolves what a probe points at and phase B verifies that the turns it points at exist, but neither asks whether those turns are still on screen when the probe arrives, and a referent established twenty turns ago and restated three turns ago is not a memory demand however far back its first mention lies. Every memory-bearing row carries a judgment of it, and every rate in this paper is reported under more than one way of using that judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 A.4 中的条件 V2 要求，系统必须主动查找一个参考名称，而不是该名称已经出现在其前面。 这种推导过程无法保证这一点。 A 阶段解决探针所指向的内容，B 阶段则验证其所指向的回合是否存在，但两者均未询问这些回合在探针到达时是否仍在屏幕上；此外，二十个回合前确立并在三个回合前重申的指代对象，无论其首次提及有多久远，都不构成记忆需求。 每一行承载记忆的内容都附带对其的判断，而本文中的每一项速率都是基于多种使用该判断的方式报告得出的。

paragraphs.en: All 404 memory-bearing rows were examined against one rule applied to the ten turns preceding the probe. A row is clear when those ten turns already state what the probe presupposes, so a system reading only its recent window would have what it needs. It is borderline when the referent appears there under a name, alias or description but not in a form that states the fact the probe rests on. It is no when the referent is absent from the window whatever else it contains. The rule is recorded per row in a criterion field, so a reader can see which of the six phrasings was applied, and a distance field records how far back the nearest on-screen mention lies on the 199 rows where one exists.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 404 个承载记忆的行都根据一条规则进行了检查，该规则适用于探测前十个回合。 如果这十个回合已经陈述了探测所预设的内容，则该行是清晰的，因此一个仅读取其近期窗口的系统就能获得所需信息。 当指代对象以名称、别名或描述形式出现在其中，但并未以陈述探测所依据事实的形式出现时，情况处于临界状态。 如果指代对象完全不在该窗口中，无论窗口包含其他什么内容，情况则不属于临界状态。 该规则按行记录在标准字段中，因此读取者可以查看六个表述中哪一个被应用了；距离字段则记录了最近一次出现在屏幕上的提及在存在提及的 199 行中向后延伸的距离。

paragraphs.en: Table 20 gives the verdicts by how each was reached. Source S1 is mechanical: a cited reference turn falls inside the ten-turn window, so the row is clear by arithmetic and no reading was required. The remaining three sources are readings of the text by one person, in three passes; S3B is the pass that closed the last 229 rows, which until then had carried no verdict and had been treated as no by default. That default is gone: every one of the 404 rows now carries a source. When the rule was unified for the final pass, it was reapplied to the first fifty rows of the earliest pass, and those verdicts held, so the two halves of the population were judged under the same rule and not merely under the same name.
paragraphs.zh: 表20列出了每一项裁决及其得出方式。 来源S1是机械性的：所引用的参考文献中，一次转换落在十次转换的窗口内，因此该行通过算术计算即可明确，无需阅读。 其余三个来源是同一人对文本的三次阅读结果；S3B是完成最后229行的那次阅读，这些行在此之前没有裁决，并默认被视为“否”。 这种默认状态已不复存在：现在404行中的每一行都对应一个来源。 当规则在最后一次阅读中被统一时，它也被重新应用于最早一次阅读的前五十行，且这些裁决得以保留，因此人口的两个部分是根据同一规则而非仅仅同一名称进行判断的。

paragraphs.en: The field supports three populations and the paper reports against all of them. The recorded reading takes every row with a non-empty reference set, which is what the derivation produced and what a reader reproduces from the context lists alone. The strict reading removes the rows judged clear , leaving the probes whose recent window does not already state what they presuppose. The third removes the borderline rows as well, which is the most conservative population the field supports. Table 21 gives the counts. The proportional stratum contains no borderline rows at all, so its second and third readings coincide, and the demand rate it supports falls from 3.4% to 1.3% [0.8, 2.1] once the clear rows are removed.
paragraphs.zh: 该领域支持三种群体，而论文则针对所有这三种群体进行了报告。 记录下来的解读方式会处理每一行中非空的参考集，这正是推导过程所产生的结果，也是读者仅根据上下文列表就能重现的内容。 严格解读会移除那些被判定为明确的行，只保留那些近期窗口尚未明确说明其预设条件的探测试例。 第三种解读还会移除那些处于边界情况的行，这是该领域所支持的最保守的群体。 表21给出了具体数量。 比例分层中完全不含任何边界行，因此其第二种和第三种解读结果一致；一旦移除明确行，其所支持的请求率会从3.4%降至1.3% [0.8, 2.1]。

sents.zh: 该领域支持三种群体，而论文则针对所有这三种群体进行了报告。

sents.en: The recorded reading takes every row with a non-empty reference set, which is what the derivation produced and what a reader reproduces from the context lists alone.
sents.zh: 记录下来的解读方式会处理每一行中非空的参考集，这正是推导过程所产生的结果，也是读者仅根据上下文列表就能重现的内容。

sents.en: The strict reading removes the rows judged clear , leaving the probes whose recent window does not already state what they presuppose.
sents.zh: 严格解读会移除那些被判定为明确的行，只保留那些近期窗口尚未明确说明其预设条件的探测试例。

sents.en: The third removes the borderline rows as well, which is the most conservative population the field supports.
sents.zh: 第三种解读还会移除那些处于边界情况的行，这是该领域所支持的最保守的群体。

sents.en: Table 21 gives the counts.
sents.zh: 表21给出了具体数量。

sents.en: The proportional stratum contains no borderline rows at all, so its second and third readings coincide, and the demand rate it supports falls from 3.4% to 1.3% [0.8, 2.1] once the clear rows are removed.
sents.zh: 比例分层中完全不含任何边界行，因此其第二种和第三种解读结果一致；一旦移除明确行，其所支持的请求率会从3.4%降至1.3% [0.8, 2.1]。

paragraphs.en: The strict proportional count arrives at the same place as a decision taken by a different route. Five demotions proposed during the audit and declined would have removed between fourteen and nineteen rows from the proportional memory-bearing population; removing the rows this field marks clear removes fifteen. Of the twenty-five proportional rows so marked, eight are cases where the companion had just demonstrated the behaviour the probe refers to, which is the pattern those demotions were about. Two procedures that did not consult each other, one editing labels and one reading windows, identify nearly the same rows, and the field reaches the result without changing a single label.
paragraphs.zh: 严格的比例计算得出了与通过不同路径所做出的决策相同的结果。 在审计期间提出的五个降级建议若被拒绝，本会从比例记忆承载群体中移除十四到十九行；而清除该字段标记为清晰的那些行，则移除了十五行。 在如此标记的二十五行比例数据中，有八种情况是同伴刚刚展示了探针所提及的行为，而这正是那些降级建议所针对的模式。 两个彼此未进行协调的程序——一个负责编辑标签，另一个负责读取窗口——识别出了几乎相同的行，而该字段在未更改任何标签的情况下得出了这一结果。

paragraphs.en: Three limits. The readings were made by one person, so the field records a judgment and not an agreement rate, and a second reader would be the obvious improvement. The rows were examined because they carry references, so the field says nothing about probes the derivation never marked as memory-bearing. And the error has a direction worth stating, which runs opposite to the derivation’s. Reading a row as no when it should be clear keeps it in the memory-bearing population, so mistakes of that kind make memory demand look commoner than it is. Verification errs the other way, since it can only remove a reference (Proposition 1 ). The two bound the rate from opposite sides and neither is quantified, so the strict reading is reported beside the recorded one.
paragraphs.zh: 三个限制。 读数由一人完成，因此该记录反映的是一种判断而非一致率，引入第二位读者显然是个改进。 这些行因包含引用而被检查，因此该记录并未涉及那些在推导过程中从未被标记为具有记忆属性的探针。 而且这种错误有一个值得说明的方向，它与推导的方向相反。 将本应明确的行误读为“否”，会使其仍被归入具有记忆属性的群体中，因此这类错误会使记忆需求显得比实际更为普遍。 验证则朝相反方向产生误差，因为它只能移除一个引用（命题1）。 这两个限制从相反方向界定了该比率，且均未量化，因此严格的解读结果与记录的结果并列报告。

paragraphs.en: An item can fail in three ways, and the release treats them differently. It can be unusable, in which case it is withdrawn but still shipped as a row with its reason. It can survive with a weaker label than it was proposed with, in which case the demotion is visible as a disagreement between two recorded phases. Or a defect can be found after the labels were fixed, in which case it is marked. Nothing is silently deleted, because a corpus that hides its failures cannot be audited on them.
paragraphs.zh: 一个项目可能以三种方式失败，而发布版本对它们采取不同的处理方式。 它可能变得无法使用，此时会被撤回，但仍会作为一行连同其原因一同发布。 它也可能在降级后继续使用，但标签会比最初提议的更弱，此时降级会表现为两个记录阶段之间的分歧。 或者，可能在标签已固定之后才发现缺陷，此时该缺陷会被标记出来。 没有任何内容会被悄无声息地删除，因为隐藏失败记录的语料库无法对这些失败进行审计。

paragraphs.en: Sixty-seven of the 1,600 chat rows are withdrawn and excluded from every count in this paper. Each carries a code naming what went wrong, and Table 22 groups them by what failed. Withdrawals for a probe that could not be released are a cost of full anonymization, and so are the 17 context_lost rows, every one of whose cited messages the full anonymization removal manifest deleted. Withdrawals for an invalid reference include nine rows whose references turned out to be on screen, which were removed before the field of Appendix D.4 existed; had that field come first these nine would have been marked clear and retained, and the two mechanisms now do the same work by different means.
paragraphs.zh: 在 1,600 个聊天行中，有 67 个被撤回，并排除在本论文的所有统计之外。 每一行都携带一个代码，用以标识出错之处，而表 22 则按故障类型对这些行进行了分类。 因无法发布而撤回的探测数据是全面匿名化的代价；同样地，还有 17 个 context_lost 行，其所有被引用的消息均已被全面匿名化移除清单删除。 因引用无效而被撤回的行包括九行，这些行的引用后来被发现显示在屏幕上，并在附录 D.4 的字段出现之前就被移除了；如果该字段先于它们出现，这九行本会被标记为有效并保留下来，而目前这两种机制通过不同方式实现了相同的功能。

paragraphs.en: Demotion is not an operation any stage performs. Stage B removes references whose evidence does not verify, stage C then reads a context shape with fewer references in it, and the tier that results is lower than the one the item would have received had the evidence held. No stage after verification can add a reference, so no stage after verification can raise a tier, and Proposition 1 states what this licenses.
paragraphs.zh: 降级并非任何阶段所执行的操作。 B 阶段会移除那些证据无法验证的引用，随后 C 阶段会读取一个包含更少引用的上下文结构，而由此产生的层级将低于如果证据有效时该条目本应获得的层级。 在验证之后，没有任何阶段可以添加引用，因此也没有任何阶段可以在验证后提升层级，而命题 1 说明了这一机制所允许的情况。

sents.zh: 降级并非任何阶段所执行的操作。

paragraphs.en: One consequence of that design was mishandled and has been repaired. Because phase B removes references without rewriting the store name phase A assigned, 51 rows reached the release with an empty reference set and a locus naming a distant store, their own rationaleB recording that no evidence had verified. On every one of them the recent window supplied the gold, so the correct value was the local one. The reset moved 48 rows to thread and 3 to none , drawn from profile (22), episode (21) and companion (8), taking the claimed distribution of 961 / 117 / 245 / 137 / 73 to the verified distribution of Table 19 . Both values remain in the file: phase A’s under trace.A and the verified one under trace.B . A gate now fails if any row carries an empty reference set together with a locus outside { thread , none }.
paragraphs.zh: 这种设计的一个后果是处理不当，现已修复。 由于阶段 B 在重写阶段 A 分配的商店名称之前移除了引用，因此有 51 行在发布时带有空的引用集和一个指向遥远商店的位置，它们自身的 rationaleB 记录显示没有证据得到验证。 在每一行中，最近的窗口都提供了黄金值，因此正确的值是本地值。 重置操作将 48 行移至 thread，3 行移至 none，这些行分别来自 profile（22）、episode（21）和 companion（8），从而将声称的分布 961 / 117 / 245 / 137 / 73 转换为表 19 中已验证的分布。 两个值都保留在文件中：阶段 A 的值位于 trace.A 下，而经验证的值位于 trace.B 下。 现在，如果任何一行同时包含空的引用集和一个位于 { thread , none } 之外的位置，则门会失败。

paragraphs.en: A later audit found references that resolve correctly but do not bear on the gold response, and golds addressed to the wrong party. Seventeen rows are affected. They are marked: fifteen carry l5_reference_disputed naming the identifiers and the reason, and two carry l5_gold_addressee_disputed . No tier, category, gold or reference was changed. Withdrawing them would have altered three result tables to remove seventeen rows, and correcting them would have replaced a recorded judgment with an unrecorded one. Marking them leaves every number in this paper computed on the corpus as released while telling a reader exactly which rows a second opinion would start from, which is the same choice made for the on-screen judgment and for the unsupported profile claims of Appendix C.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 后续的一项审计发现，某些引用虽然能正确解析，但与标准答案无关，还有一些标准答案则指向了错误的接收方。 共有十七行受到影响。 这些行已被标记：十五行标注为 l5_reference_disputed，并说明了标识符和原因；另外两行标注为 l5_gold_addressee_disputed。 没有任何层级、类别、标准答案或引用被修改。 如果将这些行删除，将会改变三个结果表，移除十七行数据；而如果进行修正，则会将已记录的判断替换为未记录的判断。 通过标记这些行，本文所有基于已发布语料库计算出的数值均得以保留，同时向读者明确说明了第二份意见将从哪些行开始分析——这与屏幕上的判断以及附录 C.6 中那些缺乏依据的配置文件声明所采用的选择完全一致。

paragraphs.en: A retriever scored against bad ground truth produces numbers that are corrupted without being obviously wrong, and every figure the derivation reports about itself is a self-report from the process under question. The corpus is therefore graded a second time by a model that built and verified none of it, under an instruction written before any item was read, over all 1,533 live rows. Its findings are then read against source by hand, because a flag is a question raised and not a defect established.
paragraphs.zh: 检索器在劣质真实数据上的得分会产生被污染但并非明显错误的数值，而该推导过程报告的每一项关于自身的指标，都是问题本身流程的自我报告。 因此，语料库会由一个未参与构建或验证任何内容的模型进行第二次评估，评估依据是在读取任何条目之前编写的指令，涵盖全部 1,533 条实际数据行。 随后，其结果会与原始来源进行人工比对，因为“标记”仅表示一个问题被提出，而非一项缺陷已被确认。

sents.en: Its findings are then read against source by hand, because a flag is a question raised and not a defect established.
sents.zh: 随后，其结果会与原始来源进行人工比对，因为“标记”仅表示一个问题被提出，而非一项缺陷已被确认。

paragraphs.en: The first instruction was itself defective in two ways: it described the cold_open gold incorrectly and gave no guidance on companion-authored clusters. Both passes are reported in Table 23 . Correcting them removed 305 of the rationale-only majors, 297 of the thread-only ones and 30 on the cold opens, and the two passes agree on the material flag for 1,434 of 1,530 rows. The auditor is sensitive: it raises a material question on 443 rows and on 290 of the memory-bearing ones, and hand reading confirms a defect on between half and three quarters of a flagged group depending on the tier.

paragraphs.en: Two measurements decide whether the instrument is worth trusting. The first is whether it misses anything: 119 rows it did not flag were read against source by hand, and none carried a gold or reference defect, which bounds the miss rate at roughly 2.5%. The second is the corpus-level outcome. Every live row was re-verified by a judge shown the recent thread and the full text of the turns the item cites. It disagrees with the stored reference reply on 7 of 1,533 rows, or 0.46%; two were regenerated and the remaining five were read against source and kept.
paragraphs.zh: 两项测量结果决定了该工具是否值得信赖。 第一项是它是否存在遗漏：其中 119 行未被标记的数据通过人工对照原始资料进行了核查，且无一发现黄金级或参考级缺陷，这将遗漏率的上限控制在约 2.5%。 第二项是语料库层面的结果。 所有有效数据行都由一位评审员重新核实，该评审员已看到最近的讨论线程以及该项目所引用的对话全文。 在 1,533 行数据中，有 7 行的结果与存储的参考回复不一致，占比 0.46%；其中两行被重新生成，其余五行则通过对照原始资料后予以保留。

paragraphs.en: The audit grades the reasoning as well as the labels, and the two fail at very different rates. Read against the ten turns preceding each probe, stage A’s rationale fails to justify the recorded locus on 395 of 1,533 rows, or 25.8%, most often by asserting an absence the window contradicts. Hand reading confirms 34 of 40 flagged rows and finds no defect in 50 unflagged ones, so close to a fifth of stage A’s written reasons are wrong, against 7 of 1,533 for the reference replies those reasons accompany. The rationale is a record of what the builder said and not the warrant for the reference, which stage B establishes against the conversation, so no label was changed on this basis. Eighty of the 395 concern the locus itself, and those enter the field of Appendix D.4 . A corpus that ships its reasoning has to ship the rate at which that reasoning is bad.
paragraphs.zh: 该审计不仅对推理过程进行评级，也对其标签进行评级，而这两者的失败率截然不同。 对照每次查询前十个回合的内容来看，阶段 A 的推理未能对 1,533 行数据中的 395 行（即 25.8%）所记录的位置提供合理解释，最常见的情况是断言窗口中不存在与之矛盾的内容。 人工核对确认了 40 行被标记数据中的 34 行，并在 50 行未标记数据中未发现任何缺陷；因此，阶段 A 书面理由中近五分之一存在错误，而参考回复中伴随这些理由的数据仅有 7/1,533 存在错误。 该推理记录的是构建者所说的内容，而非参考依据的正当性；阶段 B 已根据对话内容确立了这一正当性，因此未基于此更改任何标签。 在 395 行问题中，有 80 行涉及位置本身，这些内容属于附录 D.4 的范畴。 一个附带推理过程的语料库，也必须同时说明该推理过程存在问题的比例。

paragraphs.en: The audit changed the corpus. 19 golds were regenerated, an unsupported part was removed from a further 129, 108 were re-verified and left unchanged, 30 rows were rebuilt outright, and 67 were withdrawn. Every count in this paper is computed after these repairs, and the gates of Appendix D.7 pass on the released files.
paragraphs.zh: 此次审计改变了语料库。19条黄金数据被重新生成，另有129条中的一部分因不受支持而被移除，108条经过重新验证后保持不变，30行数据被彻底重建，还有67条被撤回。 本文中的所有计数均在这些修复之后计算得出，并且附录D.7中的检验通过已发布的文件。

paragraphs.en: The audit of Appendix D.6 asks a model whether a label is right. The checks in this subsection ask whether the corpus is internally consistent, and they use no model at all. Each is a predicate over the released files that either holds on every row or names the rows on which it fails, so a check cannot be partly satisfied and cannot be argued with. 26 run as release gates, listed in Table 24 ; a further five families of check run alongside them and are reported in Table 25 . The gates are what the release is blocked on, and all 26 pass on the corpus as shipped.
paragraphs.zh: 对附录 D.6 的审核要求模型判断某个标签是否正确。 本小节中的检查旨在判断语料库是否内部一致，且完全不需要使用任何模型。 每一项都是针对已发布文件的一个谓词：该谓词要么在所有行上都成立，要么明确指出其不成立的行，因此一项检查不可能部分满足，也不容质疑。这 26 项检查作为发布闸门运行，列于表 24；另有五类检查与之并行运行，结果见表 25。 这些闸门决定了发布能否通过，而所有 26 项检查在已发布的语料库上均通过。

sents.en: The gates are what the release is blocked on, and all 26 pass on the corpus as shipped.
sents.zh: 这些闸门决定了发布能否通过，而所有 26 项检查在已发布的语料库上均通过。

paragraphs.en: Two gates exist because a failure shipped and was repaired. Gate T was added after the per-file counters were found to have been written once and never updated, so that one file reported three hundred rows against four hundred and eighty-two. Gate U was added after 51 rows were found carrying an empty reference set beside a locus naming a distant store, the repair of Appendix D.5 . Gate V was added with the abstention stratum and fails on any row outside a declared stratum, on any pooling of the sampled strata that does not reconcile, and on any abstention row that is not an empty session opener. Gates B and Z pass vacuously, since the identifiers B checks were removed before release and no label has been retired, and both exist so that a reappearance would be caught.
paragraphs.zh: 存在两个门，是因为一次故障被提交并得到了修复。 在发现每个文件的计数器只被写入过一次且从未更新后，添加了门 T，因此一个文件报告了三百行，而另一个则报告了四百八十二行。 在发现 51 行数据中，除了指向一个遥远存储库的位置外，还附带了一个空的引用集（即附录 D.5 的修复）后，添加了门 U。 门 V 是连同弃权层一起添加的，它会对任何位于声明层之外的行、任何无法协调的抽样层的组合，以及任何非空会话开启器的弃权行进行判定失败。 门 B 和 Z 会空值通过，因为门 B 所检查的标识符在发布前已被移除，且没有任何标签被停用；这两个门的存在是为了捕捉到任何可能的重新出现。

paragraphs.en: The five families in Table 25 run over all 2,034 chat rows, the 1,600 sampled and the 434 abstention rows together. Their arithmetic closes: the category family accounts for every row as agreeing, relabelled by record, or lacking a session index, and the signals family accounts for every row as matched or as one of thirty-five whose probe text was withheld or is too short to match. All five families pass. The structural family passes on the question track after the repairs of Appendix D.8 , which rebuilt multi_hop and knowledge_update and gave long_range a span threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 表25中的五个智能体覆盖了全部2,034行对话数据，包括1,600行采样数据和434行弃权数据。 它们的计算结果完全吻合：类别智能体将每一行都计为“同意”，这些行根据记录被重新标记，或缺少会话索引；信号智能体则将每一行都计为“匹配”，或是35个因探询文本被隐藏或过短而无法匹配的行之一。五个智能体全部通过。 经过附录D.8中的修复后，结构智能体在问题轨道上通过了测试；这些修复重建了multi_hop和knowledge_update，并为long_range设置了一个跨度阈值。

paragraphs.en: Passing every gate is a weak property and should be read as one. It establishes that the corpus says nothing self-contradictory: no citation dangles, no label disagrees with the rule that produced it, no counter disagrees with the rows it counts. It establishes nothing about whether a label is correct, which is why the audit exists and why the audit’s findings are worse than the gates’. The useful thing about a gate is not that it passes but that it would have failed: gates T and U each caught a defect that had already shipped, and each now runs on every build.
paragraphs.zh: 通过每个关卡只是一个弱属性，应将其视为一个整体。 它表明语料库中没有任何自相矛盾之处：没有悬而未决的引用，没有标签与生成它的规则相冲突，也没有反例与其计数的行相矛盾。 它并未说明某个标签是否正确，这正是审计存在的原因，也是审计结果比关卡结果更糟糕的原因。 关卡的有用之处不在于它通过了，而在于它本应失败：关卡 T 和 U 各自捕获了一个已经发布的缺陷，并且现在每个构建都会运行它们。

sents.zh: 通过每个关卡只是一个弱属性，应将其视为一个整体。

sents.en: It establishes that the corpus says nothing self-contradictory: no citation dangles, no label disagrees with the rule that produced it, no counter disagrees with the rows it counts.

paragraphs.en: The question track poses 3,312 items, 3,235 of them scoreable, over the same ten records. Its probes are authored, so it supports none of the rate claims in this paper; what it supports is the comparison of Section 6 , where an authored query and a spoken one are put to the same retriever over the same conversations. It was built by a different procedure from the chat track and it is audited separately, by a model that built none of it, under an instruction written before any item was read.
paragraphs.zh: 该问题轨道包含 3,312 个项目，其中 3,235 个可评分，均基于相同的十条记录。 其探针为人工编写，因此不支持本文中的任何速率主张；它支持的是第 6 节中的比较，即在同一对话中，将人工编写的查询和口语化查询提交给同一个检索器。 该轨道通过不同于聊天轨道的流程构建，并由一个未参与其任何部分构建的模型进行独立审计，且审计指令是在读取任何项目之前撰写的。

sents.zh: 该问题轨道包含 3,312 个项目，其中 3,235 个可评分，均基于相同的十条记录。

sents.en: Its probes are authored, so it supports none of the rate claims in this paper; what it supports is the comparison of Section 6 , where an authored query and a spoken one are put to the same retriever over the same conversations.

sents.en: It was built by a different procedure from the chat track and it is audited separately, by a model that built none of it, under an instruction written before any item was read.
sents.zh: 该轨道通过不同于聊天轨道的流程构建，并由一个未参与其任何部分构建的模型进行独立审计，且审计指令是在读取任何项目之前撰写的。

paragraphs.en: The audit found a defect rate materially worse than the chat track’s. On the delivered items, 51.3% [49.6, 53.0] carried a content defect: an unsupported answer, an ill formed question, a wrong answerable flag, or citations none of which is evidence. We report that figure rather than the softer one because it is the one a user of the corpus would meet. The cause was identified and is mechanical. A re-narration of source late in construction changed facts, and items authored before it kept the earlier ones, so a question would ask about a Tuesday that the turn it cites calls a Wednesday.

paragraphs.en: Repairs were applied in three stages and each was measured separately, so the cost of the defect and the value of each remedy are both visible. Table 26 gives them. Reclassifying the categories bought nothing on content, by construction, and is reported for completeness. Repairing the wording against the cited turns bought twelve points. Replacing the items that survived both bought ten more.
paragraphs.zh: 修复分三个阶段进行，且每个阶段都单独测量，因此缺陷的成本和每项修复的价值都清晰可见。表 26 列出了这些数据。 重新分类的类别在内容上并未带来任何收获，这是由其构造所决定的，此处仅为完整起见而报告。 根据引文修正措辞带来了十二分。 替换掉同时通过两项检验的项目又带来了十分。

paragraphs.en: The residual is informative. The rate is therefore dominated by items that were never treated.

paragraphs.en: An early reading of the audit counted a proposed change of category as a defect, which put 44.1% of items in fault. That was a mistake of interpretation. Category assignment is a judgment on which two competent annotators may differ, and the right measurement is agreement, not error. Between the classifier and the independent auditor over the final partition, raw agreement is 0.880, and Cohen’s κ \kappa is 0.866 , which is substantial by any convention. Table 27 gives it per category and names the pairs the two readers actually confuse. Category disagreement is excluded from the content rate above and reported only here.
paragraphs.zh: 审计的初步阅读将一项提议的分类变更计为缺陷，这导致 44.1% 的项目被判定为有故障。 这是一种误解。 分类分配是一种判断，两名具备资质的标注员可能会对此产生分歧，而正确的衡量标准是一致性，而非错误率。 在分类器与独立审计员对最终划分的一致性上，原始一致率为 0.880，科恩 κ \kappa 值为 0.866，按照任何标准来看都相当高。 表 27 按类别列出了该数据，并指出了两名标注员实际混淆的类别对。 类别不一致性未包含在上述内容率中，仅在此处报告。

paragraphs.en: Three delivered categories were repaired against their own definitions. long_range was authored from early turns and encoded no distance property: 38 of its 39 delivered items cite a single turn, and in distance to the asking point its median is shorter than that of the other categories. Every question in this track is asked at the end of the history, so distance from evidence to query is a property of the track, and the delivered label named a recipe. The category now carries a span threshold, which all 22 of its released items meet. multi_hop and knowledge_update were rebuilt from the profile’s own structure, so that no multi_hop item stays within one session and no knowledge_update item cites a single message (Table 25 ).
paragraphs.zh: 三个已交付的类别根据其自身定义进行了修正。long_range 是根据早期回合生成的，且未编码任何距离属性：其 39 个已交付项中有 38 项仅引用单个回合，并且在与提问点的距离方面，其中位数比其他类别更短。 本赛道中的每个问题都出现在对话历史末尾，因此证据与查询之间的距离是该赛道的一项属性，而交付的标签则命名为“配方”。 该类别现在包含一个跨度阈值，其所有 22 个已发布项均满足此阈值。multi_hop 和 knowledge_update 是根据配置文件自身的结构重建的，因此没有 multi_hop 项会停留在单个会话内，也没有 knowledge_update 项会引用单条消息（表 25）。

paragraphs.en: One reported figure moves materially with the repair and it should be read as a correction. Question-track bm25 recall@5 rises from 0.356 to 0.480 [0.421, 0.536], because the repaired wording restored the cited turns’ vocabulary to the questions; the delivered figure was measuring a defect of the delivery, and recency , random and oracle move by at most 0.005 on the same items. The track ships 3,312 items of which 3,235 are scoreable, with every repair recorded per item, and the per-item audit verdicts are released as an artifact so that the rate in this appendix can be recomputed.
paragraphs.zh: 一个报告的数据因修复而发生了实质性变化，应将其视为一次修正。 问题追踪 bm25 recall@5 从 0.356 上升至 0.480 [0.421, 0.536]，因为修复后的措辞将所引用回合的词汇恢复到了问题中；原始数据衡量的是交付过程中的缺陷，而近期性、随机性和 oracle 方法在同一项目上的变化最多不超过 0.005。 该追踪包含 3,312 个项目，其中 3,235 个可评分，每个项目的修复过程均有记录，并且每个项目的审核结果作为成果文件发布，以便可以重新计算本附录中的比率。

paragraphs.en: All five conditions use one generator at temperature zero and one prompt shape: a context block, then the line THE USER JUST SAID: followed by the probe. Messages inside the block are rendered as [sender] text and truncated at 220 characters. The generator is never shown the profile, the persona, the gold response, any label, or which participant it is answering for, so nothing beyond the block distinguishes one condition from another. Table 28 gives what each block contains.
paragraphs.zh: 所有五个条件都使用一个温度为零的生成器和一种提示格式：一个上下文块，然后是一行“用户刚刚说：”，接着是探针内容。 块内的消息以 [发送者] 文本的形式呈现，并在达到 220 个字符时截断。 生成器从未被展示个人资料、角色设定、标准回答、任何标签或需要回答的参与者身份，因此除了该上下文块之外，没有任何内容能区分不同条件。 表 28 列出了每个块包含的内容。

paragraphs.en: The pairs are chosen so that each isolates one thing. C2, the oracle condition, against C1 varies what is supplied while holding the generator fixed, and Section 6 shows why that difference is not by itself a memory effect. C2 and C1 also differ in heading, relevant memories against recent conversation , and the matched pair shows that a heading alone moves memory use by 10 to 14 points, so the C2 against C1 difference carries a heading component this design does not separate. A matched pair, C3m and C4m, repeats both under the single heading earlier messages from this chat in chronological order, and Section 6 reports the matched difference. C0 is the floor and C4 the ceiling reachable without retrieving anything. None of these comparisons exists without a per-item record of which messages the reply required, which is the sense in which the ablation is a consequence of the annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些配对的选择方式使得每一对都能单独隔离一个要素。 C2（神谕条件）与 C1 的不同之处在于，在保持生成器不变的情况下，C2 改变了所提供的内容；第 6 节将说明这种差异本身为何并非记忆效应。 C2 和 C1 在标题、与近期对话相关的记忆方面也存在差异；匹配配对表明，仅凭标题一项就能使记忆使用量变化 10 到 14 个点，因此 C2 与 C1 的差异包含了一个标题成分，而本设计并未将其分离出来。 一对匹配配对 C3m 和 C4m 重复了上述两种情况，但均使用“本次对话中的早期消息按时间顺序排列”这一单一标题；第 6 节报告了这对匹配配对的差异。 C0 是不需检索任何内容即可达到的最低水平，而 C4 则是最高水平。 这些比较中没有任何一种可以在没有逐项记录回复所需具体消息的情况下成立；正是从这个意义上说，这种削减是标注的结果。

paragraphs.en: A method’s pool is every turn strictly preceding the probe. A control substitutes a different gold set for the item’s own and re-scores every method against it, so that what changes is the target. Each control destroys one property of the gold set while holding the others, which is what makes the drop attributable. Table 29 states each. The third is an assertion: it hands every method messages guaranteed to lie outside the gold set, and a method that scores anything above zero on it has a bug.
paragraphs.zh: 每个方法池中的元素在每次轮次中都严格位于探针之前。 一种控制机制会用不同的黄金集合替换该项目的原始黄金集合，并据此重新评估每个方法，这样发生改变的就是目标。 每种控制机制都会破坏黄金集合的一个属性，同时保留其他属性，这使得下降具有可归因性。表 29 列出了每种情况。 第三种是一种断言：它向每个方法传递保证位于黄金集合之外的消息，如果某个方法对此类消息的得分高于零，则说明该方法存在错误。

sents.zh: 每个方法池中的元素在每次轮次中都严格位于探针之前。
