paragraphs.en: The offset permutation is constructed per item. A second probe is drawn at random from the same participant; its gold messages are expressed as offsets from its own probe, and the messages at those offsets from the present probe become the substituted gold; offsets reaching past the start of the pool are dropped. The substituted set therefore sits at the same distances as a real gold set drawn from the same participant, and differs only in having no relation to what was said. A method that reads distance alone scores the same as before; a method that reads content does not.
paragraphs.zh: 偏移排列是逐项构建的。 从同一参与者中随机抽取第二个探针；其黄金消息表示为相对于自身探针的偏移量，而当前探针在这些偏移位置上的消息则成为被替换的黄金消息；超出池子起点的偏移量将被舍弃。 因此，被替换的集合与从同一参与者中抽取的真实黄金集合具有相同的距离关系，唯一的区别在于它与之前所说的内容没有任何关联。 仅读取距离的方法得分与之前相同；而读取内容的方法则不然。

sents.en: The offset permutation is constructed per item.
sents.zh: 偏移排列是逐项构建的。

sents.en: A second probe is drawn at random from the same participant; its gold messages are expressed as offsets from its own probe, and the messages at those offsets from the present probe become the substituted gold; offsets reaching past the start of the pool are dropped.
sents.zh: 从同一参与者中随机抽取第二个探针；其黄金消息表示为相对于自身探针的偏移量，而当前探针在这些偏移位置上的消息则成为被替换的黄金消息；超出池子起点的偏移量将被舍弃。

paragraphs.en: Each method returns 20 messages from the pool and is scored at ranks 1, 5, and 20 and by reciprocal rank. Random draws 20 messages from the pool under a fixed seed. Recency returns the 20 messages immediately preceding the probe, either sender. Recency-user returns the 20 preceding user messages, which separates adjacency from who was speaking. Oracle returns the item’s own gold set, ordered by weight, with recent context and primary references above supporting ones, truncated at 20; it falls short of perfect recall on items whose gold set exceeds the cut. BM25 is the only method that reads the probe’s content. On the question track, the pool is the participant’s whole history, since a question is posed over the record, and evidence messages carry the primary weight.
paragraphs.zh: 每种方法都从池中返回 20 条消息，并根据排名 1、5 和 20 以及倒数排名进行评分。 在固定种子下，随机抽取池中的 20 条消息。 “近期性”方法返回探针对象之前最近的 20 条消息，无论发送者是谁。 “近期性-用户”方法返回之前的 20 条用户消息，从而将相邻性与人说话的对象区分开来。 “神谕”方法返回该条目自身的黄金集合，按权重排序，其中近期上下文和主要参考项位于次要参考项之上，并截断至 20 条；对于黄金集合超过截断限制的条目，该方法无法实现完全召回。 BM25 是唯一会读取探针对象内容的方法。 在问题轨道上，池是参与者的完整历史记录，因为问题是基于记录提出的，而证据消息具有主要权重。

paragraphs.en: BM25 uses k 1 = 1.5 k_{1}=1.5 , b = 0.75 b=0.75 and idf = log ⁡ ( 1 + ( N − df + 0.5 ) / ( df + 0.5 ) ) \mathrm{idf}=\log\bigl(1+(N-\mathrm{df}+0.5)/(\mathrm{df}+0.5)\bigr) . The index unit is one turn, both senders, and each participant’s history is indexed once. Text is lower-cased and tokenized on [a-z0-9’]+ with tokens shorter than three characters and a fixed 62-word stop list discarded. The query is the probe text unmodified. The top 40 are retrieved, filtered to positions preceding the probe, and the first 20 kept. All values are macro-averaged over participants.

paragraphs.en: One judge at temperature zero scores all five candidate replies for a probe in a single call, so the conditions are ranked against one another, and no drift in the judge’s use of the scale can order them. It is shown the probe, the full gold response, the text of the messages the item records as required at 200 characters each with an explicit placeholder where there are none, and the five candidates at 400 characters each, labeled by condition. It is not shown the recent thread, the profile, the persona, the reasoning trace, the participant, or what the condition labels mean. It returns three fields: content_match on a three-point scale against the gold, used_memory recording whether the reply asserts a specific detail about the past that the probe did not supply, correct or not, and restraint recording whether the reply volunteers no such detail at all.
paragraphs.zh: 在零温度下，一位评判者会单次调用即为某个探询的五个候选回复全部打分，因此各条件之间相互排序，而评判者对评分尺度的使用不会出现任何偏移，从而无法改变它们的顺序。 展示的内容包括：探询、完整的黄金回复、该条目记录的消息文本（每条限制 200 字符，若无明确占位符则需标注），以及五个候选回复（每条 400 字符），并按条件进行标记。 未展示的内容包括：最近的对话线程、个人资料、角色设定、推理轨迹、参与者，或这些条件标签的具体含义。 返回三个字段：content_match，在三分制评分尺度上基于黄金回复进行评分；used_memory，记录回复是否断言了探询未提供的关于过去的某个具体细节（无论该细节是否正确）；以及 restraint，记录回复是否完全没有主动提及此类细节。

paragraphs.en: The judge’s agreement with human adjudication was measured on 100 probes, each carrying five replies, read blind. On used_memory and restraint it agrees on 90.6% of replies, κ = 0.804 \kappa=0.804 . On the three-point content_match it agrees exactly on 77.4% and is never wrong by two points, κ = 0.545 \kappa=0.545 and 0.606 under linear weighting; where it differs it is harsher than the reader, lower on 81 replies and higher on 32. The contrasts this paper relies on reproduce. On the same sample the reader and the judge put C2 above C1 by 0.13 and 0.14, C3 below C1 by 0.15 and 0.19, C4 below C1 by 0.05 and 0.09, and C1 above C0 by 0.22 and 0.24. A systematic severity that applies to all five conditions cannot reorder them.
paragraphs.zh: 法官对人类裁决的认同度通过 100 项测试进行评估，每项测试包含五个回复，且均以盲读方式呈现。 在 used_memory 和 restraint 方面，该智能体对 90.6% 的回复表示认同，κ = 0.804 \kappa=0.804 。 在三分 content_match 方面，该智能体的判断完全一致的比例为 77.4%，且从未出现两分的偏差；κ = 0.545 \kappa=0.545，在线性加权下为 0.606；在存在差异时，其评判比读者更为严苛：对 81 个回复的评分更低，对 32 个回复的评分更高。 本文所依赖的对比结果得以重现。 在同一样本中，读者和法官分别将 C2 的评分高于 C1 0.13 和 0.14，C3 低于 C1 0.15 和 0.19，C4 低于 C1 0.05 和 0.09，以及 C1 高于 C0 0.22 和 0.24。 一种适用于全部五种条件的系统性严苛程度无法改变它们的排序。

paragraphs.en: Appendix A.2 defines what is scored; this subsection says which field computes it. Table 30 gives the mapping. Two of the correspondences are approximations and are stated as such. A system in the ablation never emits a retrieval decision, so its restraint decision is read off its reply: a reply that volunteers a detail about the past is treated as having chosen to retrieve. Likewise the appropriate application rate is read from whether the reply asserts a past detail the probe did not supply, correct or not, because the ablation supplies context and no system returns a retrieved set; whether the detail is right is left to content match.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 A.2 定义了评分依据；本小节说明了哪个字段负责计算该评分。 表 30 给出了对应关系。 其中两种对应关系是近似值，并明确标注了这一点。 在消融实验中，系统绝不会发出检索决策，因此其约束决策可从其回复中直接得出：若回复主动提及过去的某个细节，则视为选择了检索。 同样地，适当的应用率也可从回复中判断：无论该回复所断言的过去细节是否正确，只要它提及了查询未提供的细节，就适用该率；这是因为消融实验提供了上下文，且没有任何系统会返回已检索的集合；至于该细节是否准确，则交由内容匹配来判断。

paragraphs.en: Evidence coverage exists because every other response-side number depends on the judge of Appendix E.4 , whose agreement on the graded scale is the weaker of its two measurements. It uses no model, shares none of the judge’s failure modes, and moves in the same direction on the same comparisons, which is the closest thing to a validation the response side currently has. It is a weak measure taken alone, since a reply can repeat the words of an evidence turn without using it, and is reported only alongside content match.
paragraphs.zh: 证据覆盖之所以存在，是因为其他所有响应方的数值都依赖于附录 E.4 中的评分员，而该评分员在分级量表上的一致性是其两项测量中较弱的一项。 它不使用任何模型，与评分员的失败模式毫无关联，并且在相同比较中朝着同一方向移动，这是响应方目前所拥有的最接近验证的东西。 单独来看，这是一个较弱的衡量指标，因为回复可以重复证据回合中的词语而无需使用该证据，并且它仅在与内容匹配一同报告。

paragraphs.en: Every call in the chat and question tracks is made at temperature zero, so a run is reproducible up to the provider’s own nondeterminism; the reconstruction agents run under their own settings (Appendix G ). The generator, the judge and the auditor are three different models, and the auditor built none of the ground truth it grades.

paragraphs.en: Section 6 reports one figure per claim. This appendix reports the rest: every method on every subset, every condition under every reading, and the per-subject values behind each macro-average. It covers how the demand rate was estimated ( F.1 ), retrieval in full ( F.2 ), context-window coverage ( F.3 ), the ablation in full ( F.4 ), selectivity and detection ( F.5 ), the per-subject tables ( F.6 ), and the deployed systems ( F.7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第 6 节报告了每个主张的一项指标。 本附录报告了其余内容：每个子集上的所有方法、每种解读下的所有条件，以及每个宏观平均值背后的个体值。 它涵盖了需求率的估算方式（F.1）、完整的检索过程（F.2）、上下文窗口覆盖范围（F.3）、完整的消融研究（F.4）、选择性与检测能力（F.5）、个体表格（F.6）以及部署的系统（F.7）。

paragraphs.en: The demand rate π \pi of ( 2 ) is the quantity every other rate in this paper is conditioned on, and Proposition 1 makes a single measurement of it a lower bound. Three procedures were therefore run, with different denominators and different failure modes, and this subsection gives each.
paragraphs.zh: (2) 中的需求率 π \pi 是本文所有其他比率所依赖的条件，而命题 1 则通过单次测量将其确定为一个下界。 因此，我们运行了三种程序，分别采用不同的分母和不同的故障模式，本小节将逐一介绍这些程序。

sents.en: Three procedures were therefore run, with different denominators and different failure modes, and this subsection gives each.
sents.zh: 因此，我们运行了三种程序，分别采用不同的分母和不同的故障模式，本小节将逐一介绍这些程序。

paragraphs.en: The first is a census. Phase A was run over every user turn in the corpus, not over a sample, so a memory-bearing turn can be missed only if the resolver fails on it, never because it was not looked at. That is what makes the enriched stratum a population, and it is the only one of the three that bounds the recall term r r directly.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个是人口普查。 A 阶段是在语料库中每个用户的回合上运行的，而不是在样本上运行，因此只有当解析器在该回合上失败时，才会遗漏带有记忆的回合，绝不会因为该回合未被检查而遗漏。 正是这一点使增强层成为一个总体，并且它是三者中唯一直接限定召回率项 r r 的。

paragraphs.en: The second is a residual sweep. Every turn the census did not mark was re-examined under a widened criterion: 921 further candidates were proposed and two survived verification. A procedure that had been missing a substantial share of memory-bearing turns would not return two.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种是残差扫描。 普查中未标记的每个回合都按照放宽的标准重新审查：又提出了 921 个候选项，其中两个通过了验证。 一个原本遗漏了大量承载记忆的回合的流程，不可能再返回两个结果。

paragraphs.en: The third is an independent referent adjudication over all 404 memory-bearing probes, which asks whether the thing the probe points at was already visible on screen. It removes 154, giving the strict reading of 250. This procedure cannot add a probe to the memory-bearing set, only remove one, so it tightens the estimate in the conservative direction.
paragraphs.zh: 第三种方法是对所有 404 个携带记忆的探针进行独立的参照裁定，该裁定旨在判断探针所指向的事物是否已在屏幕上可见。 它移除了 154 个，从而得出严格的 250 这一读数。 此程序无法将探针添加到携带记忆的集合中，只能移除一个，因此它以保守的方向收紧了估计值。

paragraphs.en: Table 32 gives the three. The stratum is the paper’s demand rate, because it alone is a sample drawn without regard to memory demand; the other two are checks on it over the turns the sample did not take, and together the two denominators partition 12,538 of the 12,795 user turns. Every estimate falls between one and four percent, and the reading moves the figure further than the procedure does.
paragraphs.zh: 表 32 列出了这三个值。 该层级是这篇论文的需求率，因为它是唯一在不考虑内存需求的情况下抽取的样本；另外两个则是针对样本未经历的轮次对其进行的检验，这两个分母共同将 12,795 个用户轮次中的 12,538 个进行了划分。 每个估计值都落在 1% 到 4% 之间，而读数使这一数值的变化幅度大于该程序本身带来的变化。

paragraphs.en: The third row’s numerator is 196 live rows [165, 234], obtained by re-reading the sweep’s output under the builder’s own batched instruction, which calls 44.5% of the sweep’s distant turns distant and 0.8% of its thread turns. It says what the original procedure would have found on the unsampled turns, which is why it sits below the sweep’s own figure, and it is reported because the difference between a liberal and a conservative resolver is itself information about the width of the estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 第三行的分子是 196 个有效行 [165, 234]，这是通过按照构建者自身的批量指令重新读取扫描结果得到的，该指令将扫描中 44.5% 的远程转向标记为远程，并将其中 0.8% 的线程转向纳入计算。 它说明了原始程序在未采样的转向中本应发现的内容，这也是其数值低于扫描本身数据的原因；之所以报告这一结果，是因为自由派与保守派解决器之间的差异本身即反映了估计范围的宽度信息。

paragraphs.en: Two quantities in the released tables are not demand rates and should not be quoted as such. The detector pools, 7 of 536, are a different instrument measured on a different population. The phase A distant rates before verification, 7.8% and 7.1%, are claim rates: they say how often the resolver proposed a distant referent, not how often one survived.
paragraphs.zh: 已发布的表格中有两个数值并非需求率，不应被表述为需求率。 探测器池（536个中的7个）是另一种测量于不同群体的仪器。 验证前的A阶段远程率（7.8%和7.1%）是主张率：它们表示解决器提出远程指称的频率，而非其中成功保留的频率。

paragraphs.en: Each method is rescored against three substituted gold sets, which isolate what it reads. Position randomized places the gold turns at random positions, destroying both the distance relation and the content relation. Offset permuted preserves each item’s distances from probe to gold and permutes which item they belong to, destroying the content relation alone. Broken oracle supplies turns known to lie outside the gold set and must score zero. Table 29 gives all four readings over the 1,477 rows that carry a gold set, macro-averaged over subjects. The body reports the same contrasts pooled over items, which is the form in which the identity of Proposition 2 holds; the two differ by a few points, and each is labeled where it appears.
paragraphs.zh: 每种方法都针对三个替换后的黄金集合重新评分，这些集合隔离了该方法所读取的内容。 位置随机化将黄金项置于随机位置，破坏了距离关系和内容关系。 偏移置换保留了每个项目与探针和黄金项之间的距离，但置换了它们所属的项目，仅破坏了内容关系。 破碎的预言机提供已知位于黄金集合之外的项，其评分必须为零。 表29给出了包含黄金集合的1,477行数据中所有四种读数的结果，并对受试者进行了宏观平均。 正文报告了跨项目汇总后的相同对比，这是命题2的恒等性成立的形式；两者相差几个点，且各自在出现时都标注了标签。

paragraphs.en: The two scorers come apart exactly as the controls are designed to show. Randomizing positions takes recency from 0.979 to 0.104, which is chance, while permuting the offsets leaves it at 0.982: recency reads position and nothing else. Lexical matching falls under both, from 0.282 to 0.056 and to 0.216, because it reads content and the content relation is destroyed either way. The broken oracle returns zero for every method under every reading, so nothing in the measure rewards a turn outside the gold set. The proportional stratum gives the same pattern on 1,113 rows, with recency at 0.998 actual against 0.111 randomized and lexical matching at 0.265 against 0.044.
paragraphs.zh: 两名得分者的分布完全如控制机制所设计的那样分离开来。 随机化位置使近期性从 0.979 降至 0.104，即达到偶然水平，而置换偏移量则使其保持在 0.982：近期性仅读取位置信息，别无其他。 词汇匹配在两种情况下均有所下降，分别从 0.282 降至 0.056 和 0.216，因为它读取内容，而内容关系在这两种情况下都会被破坏。 失效的预言机在所有读取方式下对每种方法都返回零值，因此该度量中没有任何内容会奖励偏离黄金集合的操作。 比例分层在 1,113 行数据上呈现出相同的模式：实际近期性为 0.998，而随机化后的近期性为 0.111；词汇匹配的实际值为 0.265，随机化后则为 0.044。

paragraphs.en: For each memory-bearing probe and each window size, we ask whether every turn the reply requires lies within the window preceding the probe. The computation uses no model and no retriever: it is the position of the required turns in the transcript, so a reader can reproduce it from the release alone. Table 34 gives it on a turn axis and on a token axis, under the recorded reading and both strict ones.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个携带记忆的探针和每个窗口大小，我们都会询问：回复所需的每一轮对话是否都位于该探针之前的窗口内。 该计算不使用任何模型或检索器：所需对话轮次在转录文本中的位置是固定的，因此读者仅凭发布内容即可重现这一过程。 表 34 分别按对话轮次轴和词元轴给出了这一结果，涵盖已记录读取方式以及两种严格读取方式。

sents.zh: 表 34 分别按对话轮次轴和词元轴给出了这一结果，涵盖已记录读取方式以及两种严格读取方式。

paragraphs.en: The token axis, plotted in Figure 4 , is the one that answers the question a reader brings. A frontier context window of 128k tokens holds everything 45.3% of these probes require, and 200k holds 56.7%. Full coverage arrives only near a million tokens, which is also the scale of the largest single history in the corpus at 841,994 tokens. On the turn axis, a system holding the last thousand turns is complete on 30.9% of memory-bearing probes and needs ten thousand to reach 95%, which is longer than nine of the ten histories here. Long context and retrieval are not alternatives at these lengths; a window large enough to make retrieval unnecessary is a window larger than most of these relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 图4中绘制的标记轴，正是用来回答读者所提出问题的轴。 128k标记的前缀上下文窗口足以容纳这些探针所需内容的45.3%，而200k标记的窗口则可容纳56.7%。 直到接近一百万标记时才能实现完全覆盖，这一规模也恰好是语料库中单个最长历史记录的规模（841,994个标记）。 在轮次轴上，保留最近一千轮次的系统能够完整处理30.9%的记忆依赖型探针，而需要保留一万轮次才能达到95%，这一长度超过了此处十个历史记录中的九个。 在这些长度下，长上下文和检索并非互斥的替代方案；一个足以使检索变得多余的窗口，其规模会超过这些关系中的大多数。

paragraphs.en: Table 35 gives the response score reached by each condition, macro-averaged over subjects, on each population. Two things are visible there that the body’s single table cannot show. On the memory-bearing rows the ordering of the conditions is not the ordering on the corpus as a whole: a ten-turn window, which ties a three-turn window overall, falls below it where memory is required, because the additional seven turns are the wrong seven. And exact context is the only condition whose advantage survives on every population.
paragraphs.zh: 表35给出了每个条件在每种人群上、经受试者宏观平均后达到的响应得分。 从中可以看出两点，而这些是表格本身无法单独呈现的。 在承载记忆的行中，条件的排序与整个语料库中的排序并不一致：一个十轮窗口虽然总体上与三轮窗口相当，但在需要记忆时却低于后者，因为额外增加的七轮是错误的七轮。 而精确上下文是唯一一种其优势在所有人群中都能保持的条件。

sents.zh: 表35给出了每个条件在每种人群上、经受试者宏观平均后达到的响应得分。

sents.en: On the memory-bearing rows the ordering of the conditions is not the ordering on the corpus as a whole: a ten-turn window, which ties a three-turn window overall, falls below it where memory is required, because the additional seven turns are the wrong seven.
sents.zh: 在承载记忆的行中，条件的排序与整个语料库中的排序并不一致：一个十轮窗口虽然总体上与三轮窗口相当，但在需要记忆时却低于后者，因为额外增加的七轮是错误的七轮。

sents.en: And exact context is the only condition whose advantage survives on every population.
sents.zh: 而精确上下文是唯一一种其优势在所有人群中都能保持的条件。

paragraphs.en: Table 36 gives the paired contrasts. The pattern across readings is the subsection’s finding: removing the probes whose referent was already on screen raises almost every conditional effect. On the hard tier the gain from exact context goes from 0.437 to 0.541, on the hard and dependent rows from 0.549 to 0.650, and on the intermediate tier from an interval containing zero to one that does not. The rows removed by the strict reading were diluting the effects, not carrying them, which is the argument for having recorded the judgment at all.
paragraphs.zh: 表36给出了成对对比结果。 不同阅读条件下的模式与该小节的研究发现一致：移除其指代对象已在屏幕上出现的探针，几乎会提升所有条件效应。 在“困难”层级中，精确语境带来的增益从0.437增至0.541；在“困难且依赖”行中，该增益从0.549增至0.650；而在“中等”层级中，则从一个包含零的区间变为不包含零的区间。 严格阅读条件下被移除的那些行削弱了效应，而非传递了效应，这正是记录这些判断本身的意义所在。

paragraphs.en: The five conditions of Appendix F.4 support three measures in the form of Yoon et al. (2026) . Misapplication is the rate at which a reply uses supplied context on a probe whose verified locus is none . Appropriate application is the rate at which a reply uses it on a memory-bearing probe. Restraint is the rate at which a reply declines to use it at all. Table 37 reports all three pooled over items with Wilson intervals; the per-subject means are in the released tables.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 F.4 中的五个条件支持了 Yoon 等人（2026）提出的三种衡量方法。 误用率是指回复在验证后无定位信息的查询中，使用所提供上下文的比例。 恰当应用率是指回复在携带记忆信息的查询中使用该上下文的比例。 克制率是指回复完全不使用该上下文的比例。 表 37 报告了所有三项指标在各项上的合并结果及威尔逊置信区间；每位受试者的均值则列于已发布的表格中。

sents.en: The five conditions of Appendix F.4 support three measures in the form of Yoon et al. (2026) .
sents.zh: 附录 F.4 中的五个条件支持了 Yoon 等人（2026）提出的三种衡量方法。

sents.en: Misapplication is the rate at which a reply uses supplied context on a probe whose verified locus is none .
sents.zh: 误用率是指回复在验证后无定位信息的查询中，使用所提供上下文的比例。

sents.en: Appropriate application is the rate at which a reply uses it on a memory-bearing probe.
sents.zh: 恰当应用率是指回复在携带记忆信息的查询中使用该上下文的比例。

sents.zh: 克制率是指回复完全不使用该上下文的比例。

sents.en: Table 37 reports all three pooled over items with Wilson intervals; the per-subject means are in the released tables.
sents.zh: 表 37 报告了所有三项指标在各项上的合并结果及威尔逊置信区间；每位受试者的均值则列于已发布的表格中。

paragraphs.en: Misapplication is exactly zero without context and non-zero under every condition that supplies any. The shipped conditions appear to show retrieval misapplying most, 60.8% against 54.2% for a recency window, but that ordering is the prompt label: under a matched pair holding label and ordering equal, retrieval misapplies less (50.8% [42.0, 59.6]) than the recency window (59.2% [50.2, 67.5]). The label effect is one-sided and consistent. Announcing the turns as retrieved memories raises memory use from 50.8 to 60.8% on probes requiring none, from 48.5 to 62.6% on memory-bearing probes and from 48.6 to 59.9% on cold opens, while the same relabeling of a recency window moves nothing beyond its intervals. On the memory-bearing probes, the two conditions sit fourteen points apart under the shipped labels and cross under the neutral one, so how context is announced moves the decision to consult memory further than what the context contains.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有上下文的情况下，误用率恰好为零；而在任何提供上下文的条件下，误用率均非零。 已发布的实验条件显示，检索的误用率最高，为 60.8%，而近期窗口则为 54.2%；但这种排序实际上由提示标签决定：在标签和排序完全匹配的配对条件下，检索的误用率（50.8% [42.0, 59.6]）低于近期窗口（59.2% [50.2, 67.5]）。 标签效应是单向且一致的。 将轮次宣布为已检索的记忆，会使记忆使用率在没有记忆需求的探测任务中从 50.8% 升至 60.8%，在携带记忆信息的探测任务中从 48.5% 升至 62.6%，在冷启动任务中从 48.6% 升至 59.9%；而对近期窗口进行同样的重新标签，则不会使其使用率超出原有区间。 在携带记忆信息的探测任务中，两种条件在已发布的标签下相差 14 个百分点，而在中性标签下则相互交叉；因此，上下文的宣布方式会促使系统更倾向于调用记忆，这种倾向甚至超过了上下文本身所包含的信息。

paragraphs.en: Two detectors were run on the same populations. The first is the lexical scorer’s own confidence, the top-one BM25 score of the probe against the turns before it, used as a signal that retrieval should occur. It reaches 0.546 [0.490, 0.605] on probes drawn from real conversation and 0.504 [0.423, 0.579] on cold opens, both containing chance, and 0.696 [0.629, 0.758] on authored questions over the same histories, which does not. A written question sits closer to its evidence in word overlap than a spoken turn does. The second is a model shown the probe and its three preceding turns and asked whether memory is needed. On the proportional stratum it is at chance on both of the first two splits, 0.530 [0.488, 0.572] and 0.548 [0.488, 0.609], and above chance against its own target at 0.601 [0.527, 0.676], rising to 0.715 [0.619, 0.815] under the strict reading. Its operating point is what matters: it flags 6 of the 40 probes that need memory and raises 40 false alarms doing so. On the question track it reaches 0.802 [0.742, 0.857] when shown three retrieved turns, and that threshold calls 40% of answerable questions unanswerable. Every instrument ranks the cases somewhat and decides them badly.
paragraphs.zh: 对同一批语料运行了两种检测器。 第一种是词汇评分器自身的置信度，即探针与之前对话回合的 BM25 最高单项得分，用作触发检索的信号。 在来自真实对话的探针中，该指标达到 0.546 [0.490, 0.605]；在冷启动场景中为 0.504 [0.423, 0.579]，两者均包含随机因素；而在基于相同历史记录的作者提问中，该指标达到 0.696 [0.629, 0.758]，此时不存在随机因素。 书面问题在词语重叠度上比口语回合更接近其证据。 第二种是一个模型：向其展示探针及之前的三个对话回合，并询问是否需要调用记忆。 在比例分层中，前两个分组的结果均为随机水平，分别为 0.530 [0.488, 0.572] 和 0.548 [0.488, 0.609]；而在针对自身目标时，该指标高于随机水平，为 0.601 [0.527, 0.676]，在严格解读下进一步升至 0.715 [0.619, 0.815]。 其运行点才是关键：它在 40 个需要调用记忆的探针中仅标记出 6 个，但因此也产生了 40 次误报。 在问题轨道上，当向其展示三个检索到的对话回合时，该指标达到 0.802 [0.742, 0.857]，而这一阈值会将 40% 的可回答问题判定为无法回答。 每种检测手段都会对案例进行一定程度的排序，但最终的判断却并不准确。

paragraphs.en: The macro-average over subjects is the aggregation this paper defends, and this subsection is where its cost is visible. Under the recorded reading only four subjects hold five or more memory-bearing rows: U07 with 20, U08 with 39, U09 with 123 and U10 with 213. U02 holds one, U05 and U06 hold four each, and all three enter the seven-subject macro at full weight. Table 38 shows what that does. Lexical matching reaches a macro of 0.424 while its pooled value is 0.248 and no populated subject exceeds 0.400 except the one holding a single row. A macro over subjects of wildly unequal size produces a number no subject exhibits, which is why the body reports pooled figures and prints the macro beside them.
paragraphs.zh: 跨受试者的宏观平均值是本文所主张的聚合方式，而本小节则揭示了其代价。 在已记录的阅读数据中，仅有四名受试者拥有五行或更多承载记忆的行：U07 有 20 行，U08 有 39 行，U09 有 123 行，U10 有 213 行。 U02 拥有一行，U05 和 U06 各有四行，且这三者都以完整权重进入七受试者的宏观计算。 表 38 展示了这一结果的影响。 词汇匹配达到 0.424 的宏观值，而其合并值为 0.248，除了仅拥有一行的那名受试者外，没有任何受试者的数值超过 0.400。 对规模差异极大的受试者进行宏观计算，会得出一个任何受试者均未达到的数值，这正是正文报告合并值并在其旁标注宏观值的原因。

paragraphs.en: The strict reading removes U02 and U05 entirely and leaves five subjects. Lexical matching then reads 0.397 macro against 0.300 pooled, and recency is exactly zero on every subject. The dependent subset behaves the same way: BM25 reaches 0.658 macro against 0.347 pooled on the 167 recorded dependent rows, because U02, U05 and U06 contribute one or two rows each and score 1.000 on them.
paragraphs.zh: 严格读取完全移除了 U02 和 U05，留下了五个主题。 随后，词汇匹配读取了 0.397 的宏观值与 0.300 的汇总值进行比较，并且在每个主题上，近期性都恰好为零。 依赖子集的表现也完全相同：在记录下来的 167 个依赖行中，BM25 达到了 0.658 的宏观值与 0.347 的汇总值，这是因为 U02、U05 和 U06 各自贡献了一到两行，并在这些行上获得了 1.000 的得分。

C0 is exactly zero in every cell of every subject, which is the zero-fabrication result at the level it was measured.

paragraphs.en: Table 40 gives content match per condition on all judged rows. The contrast the paper turns on, C2 minus C1, is positive for every one of the ten subjects, ranging from + 0.071 +0.071 to + 0.286 +0.286 , so the effect is not carried by one relationship. Its macro is 0.148 [0.109, 0.194] and its pooled value 0.140 [0.126, 0.167]. On the memory-bearing rows alone the same contrast is 0.328 macro and 0.233 pooled, and the second of those is the γ 1 \gamma_{1} of record, since the identity in Proposition 2 holds on pooled means. The proportional stratum, the strict readings and the dependent track are in the released tables.

paragraphs.en: On the current release the port answers 44.5% of answerable questions correctly, macro over ten subjects, and 58.1% of chat probes. Its judge recall at five is 0.331 on questions and 0.137 on chat, and recall at fifteen equals recall at five almost everywhere, because the port returns a handful of notes per query and recall does not grow with k k . On the memory-bearing chat rows it answers 55.4% correctly with recall 0.250, and under the strict reading 66.6% with recall 0.149 over five subjects. Every question row of the port is judged against the gold that ships, including the one item whose gold was repaired after the first scoring and which was re-run against the repaired version.
paragraphs.zh: 在当前版本中，该端口对可回答问题的正确回答率为 44.5%（十个科目的宏观平均值），对聊天查询的正确回答率为 58.1%。 在五个查询下，其判断召回率为 0.331（问题）和 0.137（聊天）；而在十五个查询下，召回率几乎处处等于五个查询时的值，因为该端口每次查询仅返回少量笔记，且召回率不会随 k 的增加而增长。 在涉及记忆保留的聊天数据行中，其正确回答率为 55.4%，召回率为 0.250；而在严格阅读条件下，五个科目中的正确回答率为 66.6%，召回率为 0.149。 该端口的每一行问题都会与随附的标准答案进行比对，包括那项在首次评分后标准答案被修正、并重新与修正版本运行过的项目。

paragraphs.en: The carried rows are stronger on both tracks, which is what a deployed product with a tuned ingestion should be, and they cannot be compared with the current rows: a different release, two subjects out of ten, and a chat track that has since been repaired. They are printed because withholding them would leave the appendix silent about the only deployed products in it, and marked so that nobody averages across the marker. Abstention on the unanswerable questions is 0.804 for the Codex port macro-averaged over ten subjects, and 1.000 and 0.632 for Supermemory on its two. It is not computable for mem0: none of that subject’s unanswerable items was reached before the quota stopped the run, so its 0.044 abstention rate is on answerable questions alone.
paragraphs.zh: 在两条轨道上，已部署行的表现都更强，这正是一个经过调优的摄入机制所应达到的效果；它们无法与当前行进行比较：后者属于不同的发布版本，仅涉及十个受试者中的两个，且聊天轨道此后也已被修复。 这些行被打印出来，因为如果省略它们，附录中关于其中唯一已部署产品的信息将完全缺失；同时它们也被特别标记，以确保没有人会将该标记纳入平均计算。 对于无法回答的问题，Codex 端口在十个受试者上的宏观平均弃权率为 0.804；而 Supermemory 在其两个受试者上的弃权率分别为 1.000 和 0.632。 对于 mem0，这一数据无法计算：在该受试者中，所有无法回答的问题在配额限制运行结束前都未被触及，因此其 0.044 的弃权率仅基于可回答的问题得出。

paragraphs.en: The reconstruction track asks a system to read a subject’s full history in source and build the persona and profile layers from it (schemas in Appendix C.2 ). The persona holds Big Five levels, demographics, behavioral quirks, fifteen prose sections and personality dimensions; the profile holds identity fields, speaking style, Big Five levels, personality dimensions, categorized facts and named entities. The release pipeline builds both from the history in pieces: the persona chain distills it one day at a time into a store of claims, and the profile generators read it in windows. The agentic method instead reads the whole history in one pass, with no day slicing and no claim store, and every extracted item must cite the subject’s own turns. Three systems each ran three times on each of the ten subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 重建流程要求系统读取主体的完整源历史，并据此构建人格与个人资料层（相关模式见附录 C.2）。 人格层包含大五人格水平、人口统计信息、行为特征、十五段散文式描述以及性格维度；个人资料层则包含身份字段、说话风格、大五人格水平、性格维度、分类事实及命名实体。 发布流程分阶段从历史数据中构建两者：人格链每天处理一天数据，将其提炼为一系列主张并存储起来；个人资料生成器则以窗口方式读取历史数据。 智能体方法则一次性读取全部历史数据，不进行每日分割也不建立主张存储库，且所有提取项都必须引用主体自身的发言内容。 三种系统各自对十名主体中的每一位运行了三次。

paragraphs.en: Ten subjects, U01–U10, with 115 to 12,627 turns each (Table 2 ). Each turn has an id of the form dayN-M and a sender: user (the subject), companion or app. A profile claim may rest on something the companion said if the subject ratified it, by affirming it, repeating it or building on it as settled; silence does not count, and the evidence cited is the subject’s ratifying turn. Token counts here are the builder’s estimate, characters ÷ \div 4 over message text, about 20% above the cl100k_base counts of Section 3 ; they run from 2,743 to 1,023,911 per subject (Table 43 ), and the transcript rendered for the prompts is 6–26% larger. GT fills 239 persona and 476 profile fields across the ten subjects. The two longest subjects hold 83% of all transcript tokens but only 18% of the scored persona fields and 39% of the scored profile fields, so pooled scores weight subjects by fields, and § G.6 reports each subject.
paragraphs.zh: 共有十名受试者（U01–U10），每人轮次数在 115 到 12,627 之间（表 2）。 每个轮次的 ID 格式为 dayN-M，并包含发送方：用户（即受试者）、同伴或应用程序。 如果受试者通过肯定、重复或作为既定内容加以延伸来认可同伴所说的某句话，则该句可成为个人档案主张的依据；沉默不作数，所引用的证据是受试者表示认可的轮次。 此处的标记数量是构建者的估算值，即消息文本中的字符数 ÷ \div 4，比第 3 节的 cl100k_base 数量高出约 20%；每名受试者的标记数从 2,743 到 1,023,911 不等（表 43），而用于提示的转录文本则大 6–26%。 GT 在十名受试者中填写了 239 个角色设定字段和 476 个个人档案字段。 两名轮次最长的受试者占据了全部转录标记的 83%，但仅占评分角色设定字段的 18% 和评分个人档案字段的 39%；因此，综合评分按字段对受试者进行加权，且 § G.6 报告了每位受试者的情况。

The persona chain’s late stages read fixed-size inputs, which shrinks the persona GT on long histories (§ G.6 ). The profile GT for U02–U10 was built on the pre-anonymization history and repaired against the release, and unlike the runs it also cites companion turns (1,034 of its 7,315 citations).
paragraphs.zh: GT 是已发布的人格和资料层，由发布流程生成，随后由作者进行人工审核。 人格链的后期阶段读取固定大小的输入，这会在长历史中缩小人格 GT（§ G.6）。 U02–U10 的资料 GT 是基于匿名化前的历史记录构建的，并与发布版本进行了修正；与运行结果不同，它还引用了伴随回合（在其 7,315 次引用中，有 1,034 次为伴随引用）。

paragraphs.en: Each system ran three independent runs per subject and layer, sharing no state. Claude Opus 5.5 ran as agent workflows with file tools and a 1M-token context, with the history inline (U01–U07) or in files each agent reads in full (U08–U10); contexts near the window were auto-compacted, and on U09, 23 of the 27 persona readers and 4 of the 6 profile agents answered from a 17–38k-token summary, as did one U10 agent. Codex GPT-5.6-sol ran through the Responses API, one request per call with the history inline, sent by a separate runner, not audited here, that applies the same prompts and edits; a single request cannot be compacted, and the largest was about 597k tokens (U09). Antigravity ran Gemini 3.8 Flash at the high thinking level in an agentic IDE, each run’s agents working from the same run scripts as Claude’s; every call had a 256k-token budget and none exceeded about 186k, so U09 and U10 were read in pieces. Only Codex held the whole history, or on U10 the whole half, in every call.

paragraphs.en: The persona builder uses the chain’s own prompts, lifted from its source and checked byte for byte, with fifteen exact-match edits that point them at the transcript instead of a claim store. One edit changes the method: the chain’s prose prompt wrote a sentence for each dimension it was given, and the edited prompt may write any of the 21 dimensions the history evidences. The profile builder uses the profile generator’s prompts verbatim, with a citation schema of bare turn ids. Every prompt ends with one line asking for the return value, each run’s manifest lists all edits, and the full prompt texts ship with the code.
paragraphs.zh: 角色构建器使用链本身的提示，这些提示从其源代码中提取并逐字节核对，并通过十五处精确匹配编辑将其指向转录文本，而非声明存储库。 其中一处编辑改变了方法：链的文本提示原本会为每个给定的维度生成一句描述，而经过编辑后的提示则可能生成历史数据所证明的 21 个维度中的任意一个。 个人资料构建器逐字使用个人资料生成器的提示，并采用仅包含回合 ID 的引用方案。 每个提示都以一行要求返回值的语句结尾，每次运行的清单会列出所有编辑内容，完整的提示文本也会随代码一同提供。

paragraphs.en: A persona run makes five Big Five calls, one per trait with its definition, each returning a level, a confidence, a rationale and citations, with medium when the evidence is thin. One call each extracts the quirks, the demographics, and the prose sections with one sentence per evidenced dimension. Each extracted demographic field is then checked by a call that reads only its cited turns and is dropped unless confirmed, and a psychotherapy-style note, written last from the transcript and the run’s own Big Five levels and quirks, supplies one scored prose section. A profile run makes two calls: atomic claims, each with one of 16 fact categories, an optional named entity and bare turn-id citations, and then a summary holding the narrative, Big Five, identity, speaking style, personality dimensions, psychology and background.
paragraphs.zh: 一次人格模拟运行会发起五次“大五”调用，每个特质对应一次调用并附带其定义；每次调用都会返回一个水平值、一个置信度、一个理由和若干引用，若证据不足则标记为“中等”。 每次调用分别提取特征细节、人口统计学信息和文本段落，每个有证据支持的维度用一句话表示。 随后，每个提取出来的人口统计学字段会通过一次调用进行验证：该调用仅读取其引用的对话回合，除非得到确认否则会被舍弃；此外，一个心理治疗风格的说明（最后根据转录记录以及本次运行自身的“大五”水平和特征细节编写）会提供一个评分后的文本段落。 一次个人资料运行会发起两次调用：第一次针对原子化主张，每个主张包含16个事实类别之一、一个可选的命名实体以及原始的对话回合ID引用；第二次生成摘要，其中包含叙事内容、“大五”结果、身份特征、说话风格、人格维度、心理状态和背景信息。

paragraphs.en: Citations of companion or app turns, and ids that do not exist, are removed, and an item left with no citation to the subject’s turns is dropped: quirks, demographic fields and personality dimensions in the persona, and facts, identity, style, dimension, psychology and background entries in the profile. Big Five levels are kept without a citation. No personality dimension was ever dropped as uncited.
paragraphs.zh: 与同伴或应用相关的引用、不存在的 ID 均被移除；若某项内容没有对主体行为的引用，则会被删除：包括角色设定中的怪癖、人口统计字段和性格维度，以及个人资料中的事实、身份、风格、维度、心理和背景条目。 大五人格的等级会保留，但不会附带引用。 从未有任何性格维度因缺乏引用而被删除。

sents.en: Big Five levels are kept without a citation.
sents.zh: 大五人格的等级会保留，但不会附带引用。

sents.zh: 从未有任何性格维度因缺乏引用而被删除。

paragraphs.en: U10 is split at the day boundary nearest its token midpoint with at least three hours of silence across it, and each half is read single-pass by the same agents. The halves are merged by rule. In the persona, Big Five follows the chain’s rule (the half with higher confidence wins; ties go to the half with more evidence, then to medium), quirks are pooled and de-duplicated with evidence unioned, and demographics go by confidence. In the profile, facts are concatenated, a summary field is present if either half has it, with evidence unioned, and Big Five takes the shared level, or Moderate when the halves disagree. In both, one text-only LLM call merges the halves’ wording without seeing the history or the citation lists. A run with a failed half is excluded.
paragraphs.zh: U10 会在其标记中点附近的一天边界处进行分割，且该边界处至少有三个小时的静默期；然后由相同的智能体对每一半进行一次通读。 这两半会根据规则进行合并。 在人格设定中，大五人格遵循链式规则（置信度更高的一半获胜；若出现平局，则选择证据更多的一半，其次选择中等置信度的一半）；奇特性格则通过合并证据后进行汇总和去重，人口统计学信息则依据置信度决定。 在个人档案中，事实信息会被拼接在一起；如果任意一半包含摘要字段，则该字段也会存在，且其证据会被合并；大五人格则采用共享的等级，若两半意见不一致，则取“中等”等级。 在这两种情况下，都会使用一次仅基于文本的大型语言模型调用，来合并两半的措辞，而无需查看历史或引用列表。 包含失败一半的运行将被排除。

sents.en: A run with a failed half is excluded.
sents.zh: 包含失败一半的运行将被排除。

paragraphs.en: Each scored field in each run is classed against GT: TP when the run matches a non-empty GT value or both mark an item present; FP when the run has something GT lacks; FN when GT has something the run lacks; and a wrong value when both have a value and they differ, counted once as FP and once as FN. Fields both leave empty are excluded everywhere, since counting them as agreement rewards writing nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行中每个评分字段都与 GT 进行比较：当运行匹配非空 GT 值或两者都标记某项存在时，则归类为 TP；当运行包含 GT 所没有的内容时，则归类为 FP；当 GT 包含运行所没有的内容时，则归类为 FN；而当两者都有值且该值不同时，则视为错误值，分别计为一次 FP 和一次 FN。 双方都留空的字段在所有情况下都会被排除，因为将它们视为一致会奖励不填写任何内容的行为。

sents.zh: 每次运行中每个评分字段都与 GT 进行比较：当运行匹配非空 GT 值或两者都标记某项存在时，则归类为 TP；当运行包含 GT 所没有的内容时，则归类为 FP；当 GT 包含运行所没有的内容时，则归类为 FN；而当两者都有值且该值不同时，则视为错误值，分别计为一次 FP 和一次 FN。

paragraphs.en: The persona is scored on its five Big Five levels (low / medium / high), 13 demographic fields compared by exact value with no normalisation (GT stores age as a number), the personality dimensions GT or a run writes out of 21 names, 15 prose sections by presence, and GT’s distinct quirks by recall: a run quirk matches when it shares at least two cited turns and at least half of the smaller citation set (near-duplicates merged, 25 listed and 15 scored). The profile is scored on its five Big Five levels (Low / Moderate / High), and by presence on 7 identity fields, 6 speaking-style fields, 21 personality dimensions and 16 fact categories, a category counting as present with at least one fact; GT’s entities are scored by recall, on the exact name after lower-casing and trimming. A different Big Five level is a wrong value. Big Five is a fixed set, and quirks and entities are scored for recall only, so a run can add false positives in every other category.
paragraphs.zh: 该角色设定基于其五个大五人格维度（低/中/高）进行评分，13个人口统计学字段通过精确值比较且无归一化处理（GT将年龄存储为数字），21个由GT或运行程序输出的性格维度名称，15个通过存在性判断的散文段落，以及通过召回率评估的GT独特特征：当运行程序的特征至少共享两个被引用的回合，且引用集合中较小的那部分至少有一半匹配时，即视为匹配（近重复项已合并，共列出25项，评分涉及15项）。 该个人资料基于其五个大五人格维度（低/中等/高）进行评分，并依据7个身份字段、6个说话风格字段、21个性格维度和16个事实类别的存在性进行评分；某一类别只要有至少一个事实即计为存在；GT的实体通过召回率进行评分，依据的是小写化和修剪后的精确名称。 不同的大五人格等级即为错误值。 大五人格是一个固定集合，而独特特征和实体仅通过召回率进行评分，因此运行程序可以在其他所有类别中引入假阳性结果。

sents.zh: 该角色设定基于其五个大五人格维度（低/中/高）进行评分，13个人口统计学字段通过精确值比较且无归一化处理（GT将年龄存储为数字），21个由GT或运行程序输出的性格维度名称，15个通过存在性判断的散文段落，以及通过召回率评估的GT独特特征：当运行程序的特征至少共享两个被引用的回合，且引用集合中较小的那部分至少有一半匹配时，即视为匹配（近重复项已合并，共列出25项，评分涉及15项）。

sents.zh: 该个人资料基于其五个大五人格维度（低/中等/高）进行评分，并依据7个身份字段、6个说话风格字段、21个性格维度和16个事实类别的存在性进行评分；某一类别只要有至少一个事实即计为存在；GT的实体通过召回率进行评分，依据的是小写化和修剪后的精确名称。

sents.en: A different Big Five level is a wrong value.
sents.zh: 不同的大五人格等级即为错误值。

sents.en: Big Five is a fixed set, and quirks and entities are scored for recall only, so a run can add false positives in every other category.
sents.zh: 大五人格是一个固定集合，而独特特征和实体仅通过召回率进行评分，因此运行程序可以在其他所有类别中引入假阳性结果。

paragraphs.en: F1 = 2 ​ TP / ( 2 ​ TP + FP + FN ) =2\,\mathrm{TP}/(2\,\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{FN}) , with precision and recall, computed per run over the pooled cells of all ten subjects and reported as the mean (min–max) over the three runs. F1 is the Dice overlap between a run and GT over non-empty cells; runs agree is the same Dice overlap between two runs, averaged over the three pairs, so the two can be compared directly.
paragraphs.zh: F1 = 2 ​ TP / ( 2 ​ TP + FP + FN ) =2\,\mathrm{TP}/(2\,\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{FN})，其中精确率和召回率按每次运行计算，基于所有十名受试者的合并细胞进行计算，并以三次运行的平均值（最小值–最大值）报告。 F1 是某次运行与 GT 在非空细胞上的 Dice 重叠度；“运行一致”则是两次运行之间的相同 Dice 重叠度，对三对运行取平均，因此两者可以直接比较。

sents.en: F1 = 2 ​ TP / ( 2 ​ TP + FP + FN ) =2\,\mathrm{TP}/(2\,\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{FN}) , with precision and recall, computed per run over the pooled cells of all ten subjects and reported as the mean (min–max) over the three runs.
sents.zh: F1 = 2 ​ TP / ( 2 ​ TP + FP + FN ) =2\,\mathrm{TP}/(2\,\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{FN})，其中精确率和召回率按每次运行计算，基于所有十名受试者的合并细胞进行计算，并以三次运行的平均值（最小值–最大值）报告。

sents.en: F1 is the Dice overlap between a run and GT over non-empty cells; runs agree is the same Dice overlap between two runs, averaged over the three pairs, so the two can be compared directly.
sents.zh: F1 是某次运行与 GT 在非空细胞上的 Dice 重叠度；“运行一致”则是两次运行之间的相同 Dice 重叠度，对三对运行取平均，因此两者可以直接比较。

paragraphs.en: For each field GT fills, we count how many of the three runs match it: 3/3, a split (2/3 or 1/3), or 0/3. A 0/3 field is a systematic difference from GT; a split is run-to-run noise.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 GT 填充的每个字段，我们统计三次运行中有多少次与之匹配：3/3、部分匹配（2/3 或 1/3），或 0/3。 0/3 的字段表示与 GT 存在系统性差异；部分匹配则属于不同运行之间的噪声。

sents.en: For each field GT fills, we count how many of the three runs match it: 3/3, a split (2/3 or 1/3), or 0/3.
sents.zh: 对于 GT 填充的每个字段，我们统计三次运行中有多少次与之匹配：3/3、部分匹配（2/3 或 1/3），或 0/3。

sents.en: A 0/3 field is a systematic difference from GT; a split is run-to-run noise.
sents.zh: 0/3 的字段表示与 GT 存在系统性差异；部分匹配则属于不同运行之间的噪声。

paragraphs.en: Length is tested across subjects, by Spearman ρ \rho between history size and per-subject F1 (mean of runs) with an exact two-sided permutation p over all 10! orderings. Sensitivity variants drop the categories whose GT depends on history length, or score dimensions against the chain’s pre-cut set (a diagnostic, not an alternative GT).
paragraphs.zh: 通过 Spearman ρ \rho 检验不同受试者之间的长度差异，比较历史长度与每位受试者的 F1 值（运行次数的平均值），并对所有 10! 种排列顺序进行精确的双侧置换 p 检验。 敏感性变体排除那些其 GT 依赖于历史长度的类别，或者根据链的预切割集合对维度进行评分（这是一种诊断方法，而非替代的 GT）。

sents.en: Length is tested across subjects, by Spearman ρ \rho between history size and per-subject F1 (mean of runs) with an exact two-sided permutation p over all 10! orderings.
sents.zh: 通过 Spearman ρ \rho 检验不同受试者之间的长度差异，比较历史长度与每位受试者的 F1 值（运行次数的平均值），并对所有 10! 种排列顺序进行精确的双侧置换 p 检验。

sents.en: Sensitivity variants drop the categories whose GT depends on history length, or score dimensions against the chain’s pre-cut set (a diagnostic, not an alternative GT).
sents.zh: 敏感性变体排除那些其 GT 依赖于历史长度的类别，或者根据链的预切割集合对维度进行评分（这是一种诊断方法，而非替代的 GT）。

paragraphs.en: Persona. All three systems reach F1 0.69–0.70. Recall is 0.86–0.89 and precision 0.56–0.59: the runs rarely miss what GT holds, and most disagreement is a run writing something GT leaves empty.
paragraphs.zh: 角色设定。 所有三个系统的 F1 值均达到 0.69–0.70。 召回率为 0.86–0.89，精确率为 0.56–0.59：各次运行很少遗漏 GT 包含的内容，而大多数差异在于运行写入了 GT 留空的部分。

sents.en: Persona.
sents.zh: 角色设定。

sents.en: All three systems reach F1 0.69–0.70.
sents.zh: 所有三个系统的 F1 值均达到 0.69–0.70。

sents.en: Recall is 0.86–0.89 and precision 0.56–0.59: the runs rarely miss what GT holds, and most disagreement is a run writing something GT leaves empty.
sents.zh: 召回率为 0.86–0.89，精确率为 0.56–0.59：各次运行很少遗漏 GT 包含的内容，而大多数差异在于运行写入了 GT 留空的部分。

paragraphs.en: Runs agree with each other more than with GT: 0.93–0.95 between runs against 0.69–0.70 with GT, so the difference from GT is systematic, not run-to-run noise.
paragraphs.zh: 各次运行之间的相互一致性高于与 GT 的一致性：各次运行之间的一致性为 0.93–0.95，而与 GT 的一致性仅为 0.69–0.70，因此与 GT 的差异是系统性的，而非运行间的噪声。

paragraphs.en: The systems agree with each other more than with GT: the same Dice overlap between two systems’ runs, averaged over the nine pairs, is 0.86–0.88 on the persona and 0.85–0.89 on the profile, although the systems span a frontier and a flash-tier model. They converge on one reading of the history, and it departs from GT in the same way.
paragraphs.zh: 这些系统之间的相互一致性高于与 GT 的一致性：在九对运行结果中，两个系统运行结果之间的 Dice 重叠度平均为 persona 的 0.86–0.88 和 profile 的 0.85–0.89，尽管这些系统涵盖了 frontier 模型和 flash-tier 模型。 它们对历史事件形成了统一的解读，而这一解读与 GT 的偏离方式也完全相同。

sents.en: The systems agree with each other more than with GT: the same Dice overlap between two systems’ runs, averaged over the nine pairs, is 0.86–0.88 on the persona and 0.85–0.89 on the profile, although the systems span a frontier and a flash-tier model.
sents.zh: 这些系统之间的相互一致性高于与 GT 的一致性：在九对运行结果中，两个系统运行结果之间的 Dice 重叠度平均为 persona 的 0.86–0.88 和 profile 的 0.85–0.89，尽管这些系统涵盖了 frontier 模型和 flash-tier 模型。

sents.en: They converge on one reading of the history, and it departs from GT in the same way.
sents.zh: 它们对历史事件形成了统一的解读，而这一解读与 GT 的偏离方式也完全相同。

paragraphs.en: Profile F1 is higher (Claude 0.80, Codex 0.77, Antigravity 0.78) because the profile GT fills more of the fixed lists both scorers check for presence, which leaves fewer extras to count as false positives (§ G.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: Profile F1 更高（Claude 0.80、Codex 0.77、Antigravity 0.78），这是因为 profile GT 在两名评分员都检查存在性的固定列表中占据了更多位置，从而减少了被计为假阳性的额外项（§ G.6）。

paragraphs.en: Shared across systems (Figure 5 ): every system writes nearly every personality dimension and prose section GT has, then about ten to eleven more dimensions per subject and run in the persona (4–8 in the profile) and about two more prose sections, and every run matches every speaking-style field. 62% of GT’s filled demographic fields are missed by every run of each system, mostly wording that exact matching cannot credit (a correct paraphrase of an occupation scores zero).
paragraphs.zh: 跨系统共享（图5）：每个系统都会生成GT所拥有的几乎每一个性格维度和散文部分，此外，每个主题和每次运行还会在角色设定中增加大约十到十一个维度（个人资料中为4–8个），以及大约两个额外的散文部分，并且每次运行都会匹配所有说话风格字段。GT中62%的已填写人口统计字段被每个系统的每次运行所遗漏，主要是措辞问题，即无法通过精确匹配获得分数（例如，对职业的正确改写得分为零）。

paragraphs.en: Big Five: all three runs match 62–70% of persona traits and 64–74% of profile traits, and every miss, on all systems and both layers, is exactly one level off.
paragraphs.zh: 大五人格：所有三次运行均匹配了 62–70% 的人设特征和 64–74% 的档案特征，且在所有系统和两个层级中，每一次未匹配都恰好相差一个等级。

paragraphs.en: Where the systems differ: each is strongest somewhere else. Claude recovers the most entities (44% named by all three runs, against 23–31%) and quirks (8 of GT’s 15, against 6–7); Codex the most identity fields (66%) and profile dimensions (97%); Antigravity the most fact categories (97%, against 86–89%). Antigravity’s profile runs are the weakest on identity fields (37%, against 61–66%) and on entities, 50% of which every run misses (40–45% for the others).
paragraphs.zh: 这些系统的差异在于：每个系统在某个特定领域表现最强。 Claude 恢复的实体最多（在所有三次运行中，有 44% 的实体被命名，而其他系统为 23–31%），以及特征最多（GT 的 15 个特征中恢复了 8 个，而其他系统为 6–7 个）；Codex 恢复的身份字段最多（66%）和资料维度最多（97%）；Antigravity 恢复的事实类别最多（97%，而其他系统为 86–89%）。 Antigravity 的资料运行在身份字段方面表现最弱（37%，而其他系统为 61–66%），在实体方面的表现也较弱，其中 50% 的实体所有运行都未能识别（其他系统的这一比例为 40–45%）。

sents.en: Where the systems differ: each is strongest somewhere else.
sents.zh: 这些系统的差异在于：每个系统在某个特定领域表现最强。

sents.en: Claude recovers the most entities (44% named by all three runs, against 23–31%) and quirks (8 of GT’s 15, against 6–7); Codex the most identity fields (66%) and profile dimensions (97%); Antigravity the most fact categories (97%, against 86–89%).

sents.en: Antigravity’s profile runs are the weakest on identity fields (37%, against 61–66%) and on entities, 50% of which every run misses (40–45% for the others).
sents.zh: Antigravity 的资料运行在身份字段方面表现最弱（37%，而其他系统为 61–66%），在实体方面的表现也较弱，其中 50% 的实体所有运行都未能识别（其他系统的这一比例为 40–45%）。

paragraphs.en: Entities: all three runs name 23–44% of GT’s entities, and 26–48% without U09, whose 23 entities include four composite role labels (e.g. “user’s sister”) that cannot match a plain name.
paragraphs.zh: 实体：所有三次运行均命名了 GT 实体的 23–44%，而未使用 U09 的情况下则命名了 26–48%；其中，U09 的 23 个实体包含四个复合角色标签（例如“用户的姐姐”），这些标签无法与单纯的名字匹配。

paragraphs.en: U09 and U10 are the weakest persona subjects for every system (F1 0.47–0.55, against 0.65–0.86 on U01–U08), and U10 has the largest share of fields every run misses (22–26%). On the profile, U09 is among the best subjects for Claude and Codex, and U10 is mid-range.
paragraphs.zh: U09 和 U10 是所有系统中表现最弱的人格主体（F1 为 0.47–0.55，而 U01–U08 的 F1 为 0.65–0.86），且 U10 在所有运行中漏掉的字段比例最高（22–26%）。 在个人资料方面，U09 是 Claude 和 Codex 的最佳主体之一，而 U10 的表现则处于中等水平。

sents.en: U09 and U10 are the weakest persona subjects for every system (F1 0.47–0.55, against 0.65–0.86 on U01–U08), and U10 has the largest share of fields every run misses (22–26%).
sents.zh: U09 和 U10 是所有系统中表现最弱的人格主体（F1 为 0.47–0.55，而 U01–U08 的 F1 为 0.65–0.86），且 U10 在所有运行中漏掉的字段比例最高（22–26%）。

sents.en: On the profile, U09 is among the best subjects for Claude and Codex, and U10 is mid-range.
sents.zh: 在个人资料方面，U09 是 Claude 和 Codex 的最佳主体之一，而 U10 的表现则处于中等水平。

paragraphs.en: As scored (Table 43 ), persona F1 falls with history length ( ρ \rho − - 0.44 to − - 0.55, not significant) and profile F1 rises ( ρ \rho +0.83 for Claude, p = 0.005; +0.65 for Codex, p = 0.049; +0.18 for Antigravity, p = 0.632). Both trends come mainly from how GT was built, not from how the runs read:
paragraphs.zh: 根据得分（表 43），人格 F1 随历史长度下降（ρ ρ − -0.44 至 − -0.55，不显著），而个人资料 F1 则上升（Claude 为 ρ ρ +0.83，p = 0.005；Codex 为 +0.65，p = 0.049；Antigravity 为 +0.18，p = 0.632）。 这两种趋势主要源于 GT 的构建方式，而非运行结果的解读方式：

sents.zh: 根据得分（表 43），人格 F1 随历史长度下降（ρ ρ − -0.44 至 − -0.55，不显著），而个人资料 F1 则上升（Claude 为 ρ ρ +0.83，p = 0.005；Codex 为 +0.65，p = 0.049；Antigravity 为 +0.18，p = 0.632）。

sents.zh: 这两种趋势主要源于 GT 的构建方式，而非运行结果的解读方式：

paragraphs.en: The runs behave the same way in both layers. On U09 and U10 every system writes 20–21 of the 21 personality dimensions in the persona, and Claude and Codex do in the profile (Antigravity 18).
paragraphs.zh: 这两层中的运行表现完全相同。 在 U09 和 U10 上，每个系统都会在角色设定中写入 21 个人格维度中的 20–21 个，而 Claude 和 Codex 也会在个人资料中写入（Antigravity 18）。

sents.en: The runs behave the same way in both layers.
sents.zh: 这两层中的运行表现完全相同。

sents.en: On U09 and U10 every system writes 20–21 of the 21 personality dimensions in the persona, and Claude and Codex do in the profile (Antigravity 18).
sents.zh: 在 U09 和 U10 上，每个系统都会在角色设定中写入 21 个人格维度中的 20–21 个，而 Claude 和 Codex 也会在个人资料中写入（Antigravity 18）。

paragraphs.en: The persona GT shrinks relative to the history. The chain’s prose stage sees only the first 14,000 characters of its grounded content, so on U07–U10 the persona GT keeps 4, 6, 3 and 2 of the 20, 18, 18 and 19 dimensions the chain had grounded, and its Big Five, quirk and demographic stages see only the first 11,000 characters of the claim store and 6,000 of the day summaries. The runs’ other dimensions count as false positives, although 83–94% of them on U07–U10 are dimensions the chain itself had grounded. Removing extra dimensions and demographics removes the persona trend ( ρ \rho − - 0.01 to +0.02); scoring dimensions against the pre-cut set reverses it ( ρ \rho +0.53 to +0.66), partly by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 人格 GT 相对于历史而言有所缩减。 链路的文本阶段仅能看到其基础内容中的前 14,000 个字符，因此在 U07–U10 中，人格 GT 保留了链路已确立的 20、18、18 和 19 个维度中的 4、6、3 和 2 个；其“大五人格”“怪癖”和“人口统计”阶段则仅能看到声明存储库中的前 11,000 个字符以及每日摘要中的前 6,000 个字符。 这些运行中的其他维度被视为假阳性，尽管在 U07–U10 中，其中 83%–94% 是链路本身已确立的维度。 移除额外维度和人口统计信息会消除人格趋势（ρ ρ − -0.01 至 +0.02）；而将维度与切割前的集合进行评分则会逆转这一趋势（ρ ρ +0.53 至 +0.66），这在一定程度上是设计所致。

paragraphs.en: The profile GT grows with the history. Its generators read the history in windows and merge the results, so it grows from 5–26 facts on U01–U05 to 227–797 on U07–U10 and fills its fixed lists on long histories (all 21 dimensions on U08 and U09, 15–16 of 16 fact categories on U07–U10). Runs that fill the same lists score true positives with no room for false positives, so profile precision rises with length: the presence categories alone give ρ \rho +0.85 to +0.88, while the content categories (Big Five and entities) lean negative ( ρ \rho − - 0.66 to − - 0.06), significantly only for Antigravity (p = 0.044).
paragraphs.zh: 配置文件 GT 会随着历史记录的增长而扩展。 其生成器以窗口方式读取历史记录并合并结果，因此从 U01–U05 上的 5–26 个事实扩展到 U07–U10 上的 227–797 个事实，并在长历史记录中填满其固定列表（U08 和 U09 上全部 21 个维度，U07–U10 上 16 个事实类别中的 15–16 个）。 填充相同列表的运行会获得真阳性得分，且没有假阳性的空间，因此配置文件的精确度随长度增加而上升：仅存在类别就使 ρ \rho 增加了 +0.85 至 +0.88，而内容类别（大五人格和实体）则呈负向趋势（ρ \rho − - 0.66 至 − - 0.06），其中仅“反重力”具有显著性（p = 0.044）。

paragraphs.en: Big Five , the one item both layers score as content, shows no significant trend in either ( ρ \rho − - 0.39 to +0.37, every p ≥ \geq 0.26).
paragraphs.zh: “大五人格”（Big Five）这一两个层面均作为内容得分的项目，在两个层面中均未表现出显著趋势（ρ ρ − -0.39 至 +0.37，每个 p ≥ \geq 0.26）。

paragraphs.en: With the confounded categories removed, U09 and U10 still score 0.78–0.84 against a U01–U08 mean of 0.88–0.90, and U10’s persona Big Five (0.47–0.60) is at or near each system’s lowest; with two subjects, and U10 read in halves, this residual is suggestive only.
paragraphs.zh: 在移除了混淆类别之后，U09 和 U10 的得分仍为 0.78–0.84，而 U01–U08 的平均分为 0.88–0.90；此外，U10 的人格“大五”特质（0.47–0.60）处于或接近各系统的最低水平；由于仅涉及两名受试者，且 U10 的测试分两次进行，这一残余差异仅具有提示意义。

paragraphs.en: Tokens come from each system’s own logs, over all attempts including retries, divided by three for a per-run figure; processed counts all input tokens, cached ones included, and output includes reasoning tokens. At the same persona F1, Codex processes about 31 × \times fewer tokens per run than Claude, and Antigravity about 15 × \times fewer. Call counts are not comparable across systems, since an agent step re-sends its context while a Codex call is one request. Three counts are low: Claude’s compaction calls are not logged (about +4.5% on U09 persona), 15 failed Codex profile calls carry no usage, and the sessions that launched the runs are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 令牌数量来自每个系统自身的日志，涵盖所有尝试（包括重试），再除以三得出每次运行的数值；处理数量包含所有输入令牌（含缓存的），而输出则包含推理令牌。 在相同的人设 F1 条件下，Codex 每次运行的令牌处理量比 Claude 少约 31 × \times，Antigravity 则少约 15 × \times。 各系统的调用次数不可直接比较，因为智能体步骤会重新发送其上下文，而 Codex 的调用仅算作一次请求。 有三项计数较低：Claude 的压缩调用未被记录（U09 人设下约增加 4.5%），15 次失败的 Codex 配置文件调用未产生任何使用量，且启动这些运行的会话也被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: This datasheet follows the structure of Gebru et al. (2021) .
paragraphs.zh: 本数据表遵循 Gebru 等人（2021）的结构。

paragraphs.en: The corpus was assembled to measure whether a system knows when to remember and what to remember, on conversations nobody wrote for that purpose. No existing corpus pairs real longitudinal conversation with a per-item record of whether memory was required, and Appendix B.1 sets out why: the records are private, so the field substituted written users, authored questions and model judgment for them. The benchmark is the narrowest use of the result; Appendix I describes the others. Assembly, annotation and release were carried out by the authors.
paragraphs.zh: 该语料库的构建旨在衡量一个系统是否知道何时需要记忆以及应记住什么，而这些对话并非为此目的而专门编写的。 目前尚无任何现成的语料库能将真实的纵向对话与针对每个项目是否需要记忆的记录相结合，附录 B.1 详细说明了原因：这些记录属于隐私信息，因此该领域用书面用户内容、作者提出的问题以及模型判断取而代之。 这一基准是对结果最狭义的应用；其他应用则在附录 I 中进行了描述。 语料库的构建、标注和发布工作均由作者完成。

paragraphs.en: What an instance is. The release has two kinds. A turn is one message in a conversation, with its sender, timestamp, text and a marker where media accompanied it. An item is one evaluation instance: a probe turn, the context a correct reply may draw on, a reference reply, and the record of how those were decided.
paragraphs.zh: 实例是什么。 该发布版本有两种类型。 一轮对话中的单条消息即为一个回合，包含其发送者、时间戳、文本以及媒体内容附带的标记。 一个条目是一个评估实例：一个探测回合、正确回复可能参考的上下文、一个参考回复，以及这些内容如何被决定的记录。

sents.en: What an instance is.
sents.zh: 实例是什么。

sents.en: The release has two kinds.
sents.zh: 该发布版本有两种类型。

sents.en: A turn is one message in a conversation, with its sender, timestamp, text and a marker where media accompanied it.
sents.zh: 一轮对话中的单条消息即为一个回合，包含其发送者、时间戳、文本以及媒体内容附带的标记。

sents.en: An item is one evaluation instance: a probe turn, the context a correct reply may draw on, a reference reply, and the record of how those were decided.
sents.zh: 一个条目是一个评估实例：一个探测回合、正确回复可能参考的上下文、一个参考回复，以及这些内容如何被决定的记录。

paragraphs.en: How many. Ten subjects contribute 27,218 turns across 430 subject-days, of which 12,795 are the subject’s, 14,329 the companion’s and 94 the application’s, totaling 1.64 million tokens. The chat track ships 2,034 rows, 1,600 sampled and 434 abstention, of which 1,967 are scoreable. The question track ships 3,312 items, of which 3,235 are scoreable. The profile layer holds 3,580 claims and the persona layer 390 content slots per the schemas of Appendix C.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 有多少。 十位参与者共贡献了 27,218 轮对话，覆盖 430 个参与者-日，其中 12,795 轮来自参与者本人，14,329 轮来自其同伴，94 轮来自应用程序，总计 164 万个词元。 聊天轨道包含 2,034 行数据，其中 1,600 行为采样数据，434 行为弃权记录，共有 1,967 行可评分。 问题轨道包含 3,312 个项目，其中 3,235 个可评分。 根据附录 C.2 中的模式定义，个人资料层包含 3,580 条主张，人格层包含 390 个内容槽位。

sents.zh: 有多少。

sents.zh: 问题轨道包含 3,312 个项目，其中 3,235 个可评分。

sents.zh: 根据附录 C.2 中的模式定义，个人资料层包含 3,580 条主张，人格层包含 390 个内容槽位。

paragraphs.en: Sample or population. For each of the ten subjects the corpus contains every turn from the first message to the last, so it is complete for those subjects and is not a sample of any population. The probe strata are described in Appendix D.2 ; only the proportional stratum supports a rate.
paragraphs.zh: 样本或总体。 对于十名受试者中的每一位，语料库都包含了从第一条消息到最后一条消息的每一次互动，因此对于这些受试者而言，该语料库是完整的，并非任何总体的样本。 探测分层在附录 D.2 中有描述；只有比例分层支持速率。

sents.zh: 样本或总体。

paragraphs.en: Labels. Each item carries whether retrieval beyond the recent window is required, which store holds the needed record, a tier and category recomputable from the context lists, a reference reply, and a five-phase derivation recording how each was reached.
paragraphs.zh: 标签。 每个条目都记录了是否需要检索最近窗口之外的信息、哪个存储单元持有所需记录、一个可根据上下文列表重新计算的层级和类别、一个参考回复，以及一个五阶段推导记录，说明每一项是如何得出的。

sents.en: Labels.
sents.zh: 标签。

sents.en: Each item carries whether retrieval beyond the recent window is required, which store holds the needed record, a tier and category recomputable from the context lists, a reference reply, and a five-phase derivation recording how each was reached.
sents.zh: 每个条目都记录了是否需要检索最近窗口之外的信息、哪个存储单元持有所需记录、一个可根据上下文列表重新计算的层级和类别、一个参考回复，以及一个五阶段推导记录，说明每一项是如何得出的。

paragraphs.en: What is missing, and why. Media content is not released, only a marker that media were present. Model replies generated for comparison and never shown to a subject, and messages emitted inside in-application games, were removed before delivery, leaving 3,273 vacant slots in the identifier space. Sixty-seven chat rows are withdrawn and ship without probe text, each with its reason. Timestamps carry a per-subject offset, so intervals are exact and calendar position is not.
paragraphs.zh: 缺失了什么，以及原因是什么。 媒体内容并未发布，仅有一个表明媒体曾存在的标记。 为比较而生成的模型回复从未向受试者展示，而应用程序内游戏发出的消息在发送前已被移除，导致标识符空间中留下了 3,273 个空余槽位。 六十七行聊天内容被撤回并未经探测文本直接发送，每行均有其对应原因。 时间戳带有每个受试者的偏移量，因此时间间隔是精确的，但具体日期位置则不然。

paragraphs.en: Relationships between instances. Every claim in every derived layer cites turn identifiers in the underived layer: 18,983 citations, none of which fails to resolve. Appendix C.7 reports the check.
paragraphs.zh: 实例之间的关系。 每个衍生层中的每一个主张都引用了未衍生层中的轮次标识符：共有 18,983 条引用，且无一无法解析。 附录 C.7 报告了此次检查的结果。

sents.en: Appendix C.7 reports the check.
sents.zh: 附录 C.7 报告了此次检查的结果。

paragraphs.en: Splits. There is no canonical train and test split, and none should be inferred from the strata, which partition by how probes were selected.
paragraphs.zh: 划分。 不存在标准的训练集和测试集划分方式，也不应从分层结构中推断出这种划分，因为分层结构是根据探针的选择方式进行的分区。

paragraphs.en: Errors and noise. The chat track’s independent audit is in Appendix D.6 ; the question track carries a content defect rate of 3.8% [3.2, 4.6] after four repair passes, given in Appendix D.8 . The profile ships 455 claims whose audit verdict is unsupported, retained so that the audit is itself auditable; no chat item cites one.
paragraphs.zh: 错误与噪声。 聊天轨道的独立审计见附录 D.6；问题轨道在四次修复后，内容缺陷率为 3.8% [3.2, 4.6]，具体见附录 D.8。 该配置文件包含 455 项未经审计支持的声明，这些声明被保留以确保审计本身具备可审计性；没有任何聊天项目引用了这些声明。

sents.zh: 错误与噪声。

sents.en: The chat track’s independent audit is in Appendix D.6 ; the question track carries a content defect rate of 3.8% [3.2, 4.6] after four repair passes, given in Appendix D.8 .
sents.zh: 聊天轨道的独立审计见附录 D.6；问题轨道在四次修复后，内容缺陷率为 3.8% [3.2, 4.6]，具体见附录 D.8。

paragraphs.en: Self-containment. The release is self-contained. Nothing is linked and nothing requires an external resource to interpret.
paragraphs.zh: 自包含性。 该发布版本是自包含的。 没有任何内容被链接，也无需任何外部资源进行解释。

sents.en: The release is self-contained.
sents.zh: 该发布版本是自包含的。

sents.en: Nothing is linked and nothing requires an external resource to interpret.
sents.zh: 没有任何内容被链接，也无需任何外部资源进行解释。

paragraphs.en: Sensitive and distressing content. The corpus contains disclosures about health, family, work and emotional distress, including material falling within the special categories of Article 9 of the GDPR. It contains that material necessarily: a reply ignoring what someone has said about their health is not the correct reply. Readers and downstream users should expect content that is personal and at times distressing.
paragraphs.zh: 敏感且令人不安的内容。 该语料库包含关于健康、家庭、工作和情绪困扰的披露信息，其中包括属于《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）第 9 条特殊类别的数据。 它必然包含此类内容：对他人所述的健康状况置之不理的回应并非正确的回应。 读者及下游用户应预期内容具有个人性质，且有时可能令人不安。

sents.zh: 敏感且令人不安的内容。

sents.zh: 该语料库包含关于健康、家庭、工作和情绪困扰的披露信息，其中包括属于《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）第 9 条特殊类别的数据。

sents.zh: 它必然包含此类内容：对他人所述的健康状况置之不理的回应并非正确的回应。

paragraphs.en: Subpopulations. None can be identified. The persona layer’s demographic slots are empty on 147 of 160, so the corpus supports no analysis by demographic group and should not be used to attempt one.
paragraphs.zh: 子群体。无法识别出任何子群体。 在 160 个样本中，有 147 个样本的 persona 层人口统计槽为空，因此该语料库不支持按人口统计群体进行分析，也不应尝试进行此类分析。

paragraphs.en: Source. The conversations come from the operational store of a single mobile companion application, described in Appendix C.1 . They were produced by people using a deployed product for their own purposes, not by participants recruited to a protocol, and every released turn is one the subject actually saw.
paragraphs.zh: 来源。 这些对话来自单个移动伴侣应用程序的操作存储，该应用程序在附录 C.1 中有描述。 它们是由人们使用已部署的产品出于自身目的而产生的，而不是由为某项方案招募的参与者产生的，并且每个已发布的回合都是主体实际看到的内容。

sents.zh: 来源。

paragraphs.en: Mechanism and timeframe. Records were exported from the production database. Observation windows run from each subject’s first message to their last authored turn and span 36 to 120 days.
paragraphs.zh: 机制与时间范围。 记录已从生产数据库中导出。 观察窗口从每个受试者的第一条消息开始，到其最后一次主动发言结束，时间跨度为 36 至 120 天。

sents.en: Records were exported from the production database.
sents.zh: 记录已从生产数据库中导出。

sents.en: Observation windows run from each subject’s first message to their last authored turn and span 36 to 120 days.
sents.zh: 观察窗口从每个受试者的第一条消息开始，到其最后一次主动发言结束，时间跨度为 36 至 120 天。

paragraphs.en: Three passes were applied. Structural identifiers were removed and every turn was rewritten so that what was said survives and the words used to say it do not; dates were shifted by a per-subject offset described in Appendix C.4 . The rewriting cost 30 chat rows, withdrawn because the probe could not be released or its cited context was removed (Appendix D.5 ); its effect on retrieval and reply scores is not measured, since that would need the original wording, which is not released. Shadow replies and in-application game turns were removed. Labels were then derived by the five phases of Appendix D.1 , and the result was graded by an independent audit and by the twenty-six mechanical gates released with the corpus. The original text is not released and is not recoverable from the release. The labeling and scoring software is distributed with the corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 应用了三次处理。 结构标识符被移除，所有回合都被重写，以确保所表达的内容得以保留，而用于表达的具体词语则被替换；日期根据附录 C.4 中描述的每个主题偏移量进行了调整。 重写过程消耗了 30 行对话数据，但随后被撤回，因为该探针无法发布，或其所引用的上下文已被移除（附录 D.5）；其对检索和回复评分的影响并未被测量，因为测量需要原始措辞，而这些原始措辞并未发布。 影子回复和应用程序内的游戏回合被移除。 随后，标签通过附录 D.1 中的五个阶段生成，结果由独立审计以及随语料库发布的二十六项机械门控进行评级。 原始文本并未发布，也无法从已发布的内容中恢复。 标签和评分软件随语料库一同分发。

paragraphs.en: What the persona layer is not. The persona layer contains trait estimates and a clinical-style summary, produced by a language model from the conversation. Neither is a validated psychological instrument. Neither was administered to the subject or reviewed by them, and the release terms permit no use of either as an assessment of any person. They are released because they are part of what the derivation produced, and because withholding a derived layer while releasing the layer it came from would make the derivation uncheckable.
paragraphs.zh: 人格层并非如此。 人格层包含特质评估以及语言模型根据对话生成的临床风格摘要。 它同样不是一种经过验证的心理测量工具。 它既未对受试者实施，也未由他们审阅，且其发布条款禁止将其用作对任何人的评估。 它们之所以被发布，是因为它们是推导过程所产生内容的一部分，而且如果仅发布其来源层而保留衍生层，将使整个推导过程无法验证。

paragraphs.en: The corpus is maintained by the authors and reached at the contact address distributed with the release; both are withheld for anonymous review. Each release carries a manifest naming every shipped file with its hash, so a version is identified by content, and every repair applied since the first audit is recorded in a statement distributed with it. Corrections will be issued as new versions under the same scheme, with prior manifests retained so that a published result can be tied to the exact files it was computed on. The scoring package accepts submissions from others, and the procedure is documented with it.
paragraphs.zh: 语料库由作者维护，可通过随发布版本一同分发的联系方式获取；为便于匿名评审，这两项信息均未公开。 每个发布版本都附带一份清单，其中列出了所有已发布的文件及其哈希值，因此版本可通过内容识别，且自首次审计以来应用的每次修改都会记录在随版本一同分发的声明中。 修正将以新版本的形式按照同一方案发布，同时保留先前的清单，以便能够将已发布的结果与用于计算该结果的精确文件关联起来。 评分包接受他人提交的成果，相关流程也随包一同提供说明。

paragraphs.en: This paper uses the corpus for one thing: measuring whether a system knows when to remember and what to remember. That is the narrowest use it has. What the release contains is ten people talking to the same companion for months, with what they said, what could be established about them, which turn established each claim, and how every label was reached. Several lines of work have wanted records of that kind and have not had them. This appendix sets out what each substituted instead, what recent work in each says the substitute costs, and which of their questions the record could answer: evaluation and conversational modeling ( I.1 ), affect and mental state ( I.2 ), the psychology of these relationships ( I.3 ), and consumer research ( I.4 ). Appendix I.5 states what the corpus cannot do. The pattern repeats in each case, and it is the pattern of Appendix B.1 : a field needed real people observed over time, could not obtain them, substituted something, and is now measuring what the substitution cost.
paragraphs.zh: 本文仅将语料库用于一个目的：衡量系统是否知道何时需要记忆以及应当记忆什么。 这是其最狭隘的用途。 该发布内容包含十个人与同一位陪伴者持续数月对话的记录，其中记载了他们的对话内容、由此能够确定的关于他们自身的信息、这些信息如何支撑每一项主张，以及每个标签是如何得出的。 多个研究分支一直需要这类记录，但此前并未拥有它们。 本附录说明了每种情况中各自用何物替代、近期相关研究指出这种替代方案的成本，以及这些记录能够回答哪些问题：评估与对话建模（I.1）、情感与心理状态（I.2）、此类关系的心理学分析（I.3）以及消费者研究（I.4）。 附录 I.5 说明了该语料库无法完成的任务。 每种情况都重复了相同的模式，即附录 B.1 所描述的模式：某个领域需要长期观察真实人物，但未能获得他们，于是用其他东西替代，并正在衡量这种替代所带来的成本。

paragraphs.en: For this community, the corpus carries a result about how people behave in conversation as well as a dataset. Benchmarks decide in advance what a person will need from a reply. An authored question stands in for the moment a person reaches back, and a model’s judgment stands in for what the person meant (Appendix B.1 ). Proposition 2 prices the first substitution. A benchmark that supplies context and measures the improvement reports the sum of two effects, one on messages that need the context and one on messages that do not, and it may credit the sum to the first only where the second is absent. On an authored corpus that holds by construction, because every question was written to need something. Real people rarely talk that way. Here the probes that need nothing earlier contribute twenty-four times as much of the measured gain as those that do. The result applies to any benchmark whose probes were written, and it rests on a fact about people: most of what they say to a companion concerns the present.
paragraphs.zh: 对于该社区而言，语料库既包含关于人们对话行为的研究结果，也构成一个数据集。 基准测试预先决定了人们从回复中需要获得什么。 人工编写的问题暂时替代了人们的反馈，而模型的评价则替代了人们原本想表达的意思（附录 B.1）。 命题 2 对第一次替代进行了定价。 一个提供上下文并衡量改进效果的基准测试会报告两种效应的总和：一种是对需要上下文的对话信息的影响，另一种是对不需要上下文的对话信息的影响；如果不存在第二种效应，该测试可能将全部功劳归于第一种效应。 在一个按设计原则构建的人工语料库中，这一点成立，因为每个问题都经过编写以需要某种特定内容。 真实的人很少以这种方式交谈。 在此，无需任何先前信息的探测对测量到的增益贡献了二十四倍于那些需要先前信息的探测。 该结果适用于所有其探测问题均为人工编写的基准测试，并且它基于一个关于人类的事实：人们与同伴交谈时所说的内容大多与当下相关。

paragraphs.en: The release also supports work a scored benchmark does not. The restraint decision has per-probe supervision, 1,129 negatives against 404 positives, which is what training a retrieval gate requires and what no other corpus supplies; the architectures surveyed in Appendix B.3 retrieve on every turn in part because nothing has ever told them when not to. The derivations are supervision of a second kind, since each item records the referent a resolver proposed, what verification kept of it, the rule that fixed the label and the turns the reply rested on, so a model can be trained or evaluated on the intermediate decisions and not only on the outcome. And the coverage curve of Section 6 answers by measurement a question the field answers by assertion: a system holding the last thousand turns has everything it needs on 31% of memory-bearing probes, and reaching 95% takes ten thousand turns, which is longer than 9 of the 10 histories in this corpus. At these lengths, long context and retrieval are not alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 该发布版本还支持有评分基准所不支持的工作。 约束决策具有逐探针监督机制，包含 1,129 个负例和 404 个正例，这正是训练检索门所需而其他语料库无法提供的；附录 B.3 中调查的架构之所以每次都会执行检索，部分原因是从未有任何机制告诉它们何时不应检索。 这些推导属于第二种监督形式，因为每个条目都记录了解析器提出的指代对象、验证过程中保留的内容、确定标签的规则以及回复所依据的步骤，因此模型不仅可以在最终结果上训练或评估，还可以基于中间决策进行训练或评估。 第 6 节的覆盖曲线通过测量回答了该领域仅凭断言回答的问题：一个保留最后千个步骤的系统，在 31% 的记忆相关探针上拥有所需的一切，而要达到 95% 的覆盖则需要一万步，这一长度超过了本语料库中 10 条历史记录中的 9 条。 在这些长度下，长上下文和检索并非相互替代的选择。

sents.en: The derivations are supervision of a second kind, since each item records the referent a resolver proposed, what verification kept of it, the rule that fixed the label and the turns the reply rested on, so a model can be trained or evaluated on the intermediate decisions and not only on the outcome.

sents.en: And the coverage curve of Section 6 answers by measurement a question the field answers by assertion: a system holding the last thousand turns has everything it needs on 31% of memory-bearing probes, and reaching 95% takes ten thousand turns, which is longer than 9 of the 10 histories in this corpus.
sents.zh: 第 6 节的覆盖曲线通过测量回答了该领域仅凭断言回答的问题：一个保留最后千个步骤的系统，在 31% 的记忆相关探针上拥有所需的一切，而要达到 95% 的覆盖则需要一万步，这一长度超过了本语料库中 10 条历史记录中的 9 条。

sents.en: At these lengths, long context and retrieval are not alternatives.
sents.zh: 在这些长度下，长上下文和检索并非相互替代的选择。

paragraphs.en: A third line models the interaction itself, and it has moved in one direction over the past two years: from classifying a turn to maintaining a state that persists across turns. Zou et al. (2026) model the trajectory of affect through a conversation, and Zhao et al. (2026b) argue for replacing a stateless responder with one that carries a psychological model of the person it is speaking to. Benchmarks have followed, with Iyer et al. (2026) scoring people and models on the same support dialogues. A parallel effort attributes beliefs and intentions: Li et al. (2026a) ask whether a conversational recommender infers what a user wants, Wang et al. (2026) train a responder on simulated user mental states directly, and Ni et al. (2026) survey the simulators on which most of this rests.
paragraphs.zh: 第三部分对互动本身进行建模，在过去两年中，这一领域朝着一个方向发展：从对单个回合进行分类，转向维持跨回合持续存在的状态。Zou 等人 (2026) 通过对话模拟情感发展的轨迹，而 Zhao 等人 (2026b) 主张用具备心理模型的回应者取代无状态回应者，这种心理模型能够反映其对话对象的特征。 随后也出现了基准测试，Iyer 等人 (2026) 对人和模型在相同的辅助对话中进行了评分。 一项并行研究则关注信念与意图的归因：Li 等人 (2026a) 探讨了对话式推荐系统是否能够推断出用户的需求，Wang 等人 (2026) 直接在模拟的用户心理状态上训练回应者，而 Ni 等人 (2026) 则对这一领域所依赖的大部分模拟器进行了综述。

paragraphs.en: A closer line makes the internal state the object of evaluation. Yadav et al. (2026) ask a model to infer beliefs, desires, intentions, emotions, knowledge and trust from a dialogue, then to forecast how that dialogue continues from those inferences alone, and report that models identify the states and cannot use them to predict what follows. Bawatneh et al. (2026) score belief structures directly, over 895 narratives and some 22,000 labeled belief propositions, and find actor-specific belief tracking is where models fail. Zhao et al. (2026a) learn a predictive representation of how affect unfolds and inject it into a language model, evaluated across nine clip-level corpora. Cheng et al. (2026) run the argument the other way, fitting a cognitive model of human decision-making to improve a language model’s simulation of people in persuasion games, and Lin () sets out what that practice can and cannot support. The dissociation Yadav et al. (2026) report is the one this paper finds on a different axis: there a model names a mental state and cannot act on it, here a model ranks probes needing memory above chance and cannot decide which to retrieve for.
paragraphs.zh: 更紧密的关联使内部状态成为评估的对象。Yadav 等人 （2026）要求模型从对话中推断信念、欲望、意图、情绪、知识和信任，然后仅基于这些推断预测对话的后续发展，并报告称模型能够识别这些状态，但无法利用它们来预测后续内容。Bawatneh 等人 （2026）直接对信念结构进行评分，涵盖 895 个叙事和约 22,000 个带标签的信念命题，并发现模型在特定行动者的信念追踪方面存在失败。Zhao 等人 （2026a）学习情感发展过程的预测性表示，并将其注入语言模型中，该模型在九个片段级语料库上进行了评估。Cheng 等人 （2026）从相反方向提出论点：通过拟合人类决策的认知模型来改进语言模型在说服游戏中的对人的模拟，而 Lin（）则阐述了这种做法能够和无法支持的内容。 Yadav 等人报告的这种分离现象 （2026）是本文在另一个维度上发现的现象：在那项研究中，模型能够命名某种心理状态却无法据此行动；而在此处，模型能够以高于随机水平的准确率对需要记忆的问题进行排序，但却无法决定应检索哪一个。

paragraphs.en: Each of these needs something it cannot observe. A persistent psychological state is worth maintaining only if the person persists, and what these lines evaluate on does not persist: authored narratives, clip-length recordings, games that end, and support corpora that are largely single sessions between strangers, assembled for the purpose. A mental-state attribution is worth scoring only against what someone actually wanted, and a simulated user wants what it was told to want. The recurring move is to construct the state because it cannot be watched: the situated responder builds a psychological world, the mental-state trainer simulates one. This corpus watches one instead. It records the same person across months, what they disclosed and when, what the companion said back, and whether they came back; its profile layer carries stressors, coping patterns and behaviors with the turns that established each and the window over which each held, so a claim about someone’s state on day forty can be checked against what they said on day nine. It records that a relationship continued.
paragraphs.zh: 这些中的每一个都需要某种它无法观察到的东西。 一种持续的心理状态只有在个体本身持续存在时才值得维持，而这些评估对象并不具备持续性：作者撰写的叙事、片段长度的录音、有终点的游戏，以及那些主要为特定目的而汇编的、陌生人之间单次会话构成的支持语料库。 对心理状态的归因只有在与个体实际愿望对照时才有评分价值，而模拟用户所想要的，只是被告诉它想要的内容。 反复出现的做法是构建这种状态，因为它无法被直接观察：情境化的回应者会构建一个心理世界，而心理状态训练者则会模拟一个。 这个语料库则选择观察一个人本身。 它会记录同一个人跨越数月的情况：他们透露了什么、何时透露的，陪伴者如何回应，以及他们是否再次出现；其个人资料层还会记录压力源、应对模式与行为，包括形成这些模式的各个阶段及每个阶段持续的时间窗口，因此关于某人在第四天心理状态的断言，可以对照他们在第九天的发言进行验证。 它记录了一段关系的持续存在。

paragraphs.en: Outside machine learning, these relationships are studied directly, and Appendix B.5 describes what has been built: interview studies of how the bond develops over months, thematic analyses of the support people report receiving, and grounded-theory work on dependence and on distress when a system’s behavior changes. Pi and Hunter (2026) survey what longitudinal work exists, and Zhang et al. (2025b) report on well-being at scale. Every one of these studies is built from what people say about the interaction, through interviews, surveys, app reviews and forum posts. The interactions themselves are private, and this is the constraint that produced the three substitutions of Appendix B.1 , met by a different field and answered a different way.
paragraphs.zh: 在机器学习领域之外，这些关系是直接研究的，附录 B.5 描述了已有的研究成果：关于这种关系如何在数月间发展的访谈研究、对人们报告所获支持的主题分析，以及关于依赖性和系统行为变化时产生的困扰的基础理论工作。 Pi 和 Hunter（2026）综述了现有的纵向研究，而 Zhang 等人 （2025b）则报告了大规模的幸福状况。 所有这些研究都基于人们通过访谈、调查、应用评论和论坛帖子所描述的互动情况。 这些互动本身是私密的，正是这一限制促成了附录 B.1 中的三种替代方案——这些方案由不同领域提出，并以不同方式予以回应。

paragraphs.en: What a transcript adds is a check. A field whose evidence is self-report about an interaction has no way to compare the report against the interaction, and for ten people this corpus closes that gap. Some of what it shows is not what a survey would return. The companion opens the exchange on 217 of the 430 participant-days, so the AI initiates these relationships about half the time. More than half of the companion’s messages offer tappable replies, and 33 of the 12,795 messages participants sent reproduce one, so the affordance the product invests in is almost entirely unused. Self-description fills where it asks for an interpretation and empties where it asks for a category, 91.9% empty across demographic slots against 26.1% elsewhere, and it does so regardless of how much a person said. And most of what people bring to a companion concerns the present. Only 3.4% of their messages depend on anything said earlier, a fact about companionship that work organized around memory would not predict. None of these is obtainable from an account of an interaction. All are obtainable from the interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 转录记录所增加的内容是一种验证。 一个仅依赖自我报告作为互动证据的领域，无法将报告与实际的互动进行比对，而这套语料库为十个人填补了这一空白。 其中展示的一些内容并非调查所能得出的结果。 该陪伴型智能体在 430 个参与者-日中开启了 217 次互动，因此人工智能大约一半的时间会主动发起这些关系。 超过一半的陪伴型智能体消息提供了可点击的回复选项，而参与者在 12,795 条消息中仅有 33 条重复使用了这些选项，因此产品投入设计的这一功能几乎完全未被使用。 自我描述在需要解释时提供了内容，但在需要分类时却留空；人口统计学字段中有 91.9% 为空，而其他部分仅为 26.1%，且无论个人发言多少，情况均如此。 而且，人们与陪伴型智能体互动时，大多数内容都涉及当下。 他们发送的消息中仅有 3.4% 依赖于之前所说的任何内容，这一关于陪伴关系的特征是无法通过以记忆为中心的设计预测到的。 这些内容都无法仅从对互动的描述中获得。 而所有这些内容都可以直接从互动本身中获得。

paragraphs.en: Consumer research has replaced its respondents. Synthetic panels, in which a model is prompted into a persona and asked what it would prefer or buy, are now routine in commercial practice, and the field has begun to audit them. Lukauskas and Šarkauskaitė (2026) find such respondents plausible and not valid against psychometric criteria. Tigre and Souto (2026) propose diagnostics and corrections for consumer panels, which is itself a statement that uncorrected panels are unreliable. Chen et al. (2026c) benchmark simulated survey responses across domains and report where they break. Maier et al. (2025) recover purchase intent under a particular elicitation, which sharpens the question, since it shows the answer depends on how the model is asked. Beneath all of it sits the result of Venkit et al. (2026a) : demographic attributes explain roughly 1.5% of the variance in how similarly two people respond, so a persona assembled from them describes very nearly an unrelated person. Real self-description points the same way. In this corpus the demographic fields a synthetic panel starts from are empty 156 times in 160, while the remaining persona fields are filled three times in four.
paragraphs.zh: 消费者研究已经用智能体取代了其受访者。 合成小组现已成为商业实践中的常规手段，其中模型会被引导进入特定角色，并被询问其偏好或购买选择；该领域也开始对这些小组进行审查。 Lukauskas 和 Šarkauskaitė（2026）认为这类受访者看似合理，但根据心理测量标准并不有效。 Tigre 和 Souto（2026）为消费者小组提出了诊断方法和修正方案，这本身也表明未经修正的小组并不可靠。Chen 等人 （2026c）对跨领域的模拟调查响应进行了基准测试，并报告了它们失效的情况。Maier 等人 （2025）在特定诱导方式下恢复了购买意向，这使问题更加明确，因为它表明答案取决于模型被提问的方式。 所有这一切的基础是 Venkit 等人的研究结果。 （2026a）：人口统计学属性仅能解释两个人响应相似性差异的大约 1.5%，因此由这些属性构成的角色几乎描述了一个毫无关联的人。 真实的自我描述也指向同样的结论。 在该语料库中，合成小组所依据的人口统计学字段在 160 次中有 156 次为空，而其余的角色字段则有四分之三得到了填写。

sents.en: Consumer research has replaced its respondents.
sents.zh: 消费者研究已经用智能体取代了其受访者。

sents.en: Synthetic panels, in which a model is prompted into a persona and asked what it would prefer or buy, are now routine in commercial practice, and the field has begun to audit them.
sents.zh: 合成小组现已成为商业实践中的常规手段，其中模型会被引导进入特定角色，并被询问其偏好或购买选择；该领域也开始对这些小组进行审查。

sents.en: Lukauskas and Šarkauskaitė (2026) find such respondents plausible and not valid against psychometric criteria.
sents.zh: Lukauskas 和 Šarkauskaitė（2026）认为这类受访者看似合理，但根据心理测量标准并不有效。

sents.en: Tigre and Souto (2026) propose diagnostics and corrections for consumer panels, which is itself a statement that uncorrected panels are unreliable. Chen et al.
sents.zh: Tigre 和 Souto（2026）为消费者小组提出了诊断方法和修正方案，这本身也表明未经修正的小组并不可靠。Chen 等人

sents.zh: （2026c）对跨领域的模拟调查响应进行了基准测试，并报告了它们失效的情况。Maier 等人

sents.en: (2025) recover purchase intent under a particular elicitation, which sharpens the question, since it shows the answer depends on how the model is asked.
sents.zh: （2025）在特定诱导方式下恢复了购买意向，这使问题更加明确，因为它表明答案取决于模型被提问的方式。

sents.en: Beneath all of it sits the result of Venkit et al.
sents.zh: 所有这一切的基础是 Venkit 等人的研究结果。

sents.en: (2026a) : demographic attributes explain roughly 1.5% of the variance in how similarly two people respond, so a persona assembled from them describes very nearly an unrelated person.
sents.zh: （2026a）：人口统计学属性仅能解释两个人响应相似性差异的大约 1.5%，因此由这些属性构成的角色几乎描述了一个毫无关联的人。

sents.en: Real self-description points the same way.
sents.zh: 真实的自我描述也指向同样的结论。

sents.en: In this corpus the demographic fields a synthetic panel starts from are empty 156 times in 160, while the remaining persona fields are filled three times in four.
sents.zh: 在该语料库中，合成小组所依据的人口统计学字段在 160 次中有 156 次为空，而其余的角色字段则有四分之三得到了填写。

paragraphs.en: Every one of these audits ends the same way, by asking for real responses to validate against, and preferably responses that were not produced for a study. This corpus offers the field a source of validation. A synthetic persona can be held against a real one whose every claim carries the turns that established it, a confidence and the window over which it held. A claim to reproduce individual difference can be held against people whose differences were recorded. The corpus is released for research and its terms permit nothing else. It may not be used to profile or target anyone, since the participants consented to research and to no other use, and the argument of this subsection is only that the question the field is publicly asking is the one the record answers.
paragraphs.zh: 所有这些审计的最终结果都相同：要求提供真实的回应以供验证，而且最好这些回应并非为某项研究而生成。 该语料库为该领域提供了验证的依据。 一个合成人格可以与一个真实人格相对照：后者的每一项主张都承载着形成其身份的经历、自信以及其存在的时间范围。 任何声称能够再现个体差异的说法，都可以与那些差异已被记录的人进行对照。 该语料库已公开用于研究，其使用条款不允许任何其他用途。 它不得被用于对任何人进行画像或针对性操作，因为参与者仅同意用于研究，而非其他任何用途；而本小节的核心论点仅仅是：该领域公开提出的疑问，正是这份记录所回答的问题。

paragraphs.en: Ten people used one application over four months. They chose that product, so they are not a sample of companion users and still less of people, and the application frames the relationship in a particular way; how much of what is reported here survives a different product is unknown. Every turn was rewritten during anonymization, so the corpus preserves what was said and not the words used to say it; the rewriting cost 30 chat rows (Appendix D.5 ), and its effect on retrieval and reply scores is not measured. Timestamps were shifted by a per-subject offset, so intervals are exact while calendar position and day of the week carry no information.
paragraphs.zh: 十个人在四个月内使用了一款应用程序。 他们选择了该产品，因此他们既不是伴随用户的样本，更不是普通用户的样本，而且该应用程序以特定方式构建了这种关系；这里所报告的内容在换用不同产品后能保留多少尚不清楚。 在匿名化处理过程中，每个转折都被重新表述，因此语料库保留了所说的内容，而非用于表达这些内容的词语；这一改写过程消耗了 30 行对话（附录 D.5），其对检索和回复评分的影响尚未被衡量。 时间戳根据每个受试者的偏移量进行了调整，因此时间区间是精确的，但具体日期和时间在星期几上不再包含任何信息。

paragraphs.en: Three judgments rest on a single reader. The on-screen verdicts of Appendix D.4 were made by one person over four passes, with the final rule reapplied to the earliest, and one reader means a judgment without an agreement rate. The judge of Appendix A.2 agrees with that reader at κ = 0.804 \kappa=0.804 on the binary use decision and 0.545 0.545 on the graded scale, so every graded score carries the weaker of the two. The question track carries a content defect rate of 3.8% [3.2, 4.6] after repair, higher than the chat track’s, reported in Appendix D.8 .
paragraphs.zh: 三项判断均基于单一智能体。 附录 D.4 中屏幕上的判决由一人经过四轮判定得出，其中最终规则被重新应用于最早一轮的判定；而单一智能体意味着该判决没有达成率。 附录 A.2 中的判定者在与该智能体的二元使用决策判断上的一致性为 κ = 0.804 \kappa=0.804，在分级量表上的一致性为 0.545 0.545，因此每个分级评分都取两者中较低的一致性。 修复后，问题轨道的内容缺陷率为 3.8% [3.2, 4.6]，高于附录 D.8 中报告聊天轨道的缺陷率。

paragraphs.en: Two results need their scope stated. Proposition 2 is about a method and holds wherever the demand rate is below one; the 96% that instantiates it is about this corpus and this pair of conditions, and a different pair would give a different split. Under the strict reading, five subjects contribute no memory-bearing probes at all, so every quantity conditioned on memory demand is a macro-average over five subjects with intervals to match, and none of them should be read as though it rested on ten.
paragraphs.zh: 两个结果都需要明确其适用范围。 命题 2 涉及一种方法，只要需求率低于 1，该命题就成立；其中用于具体化该命题的 96% 是针对当前语料和当前这对条件的，而另一对条件则会得出不同的划分结果。 按照严格解读，有五名受试者完全没有提供任何承载记忆信息的探针，因此所有以记忆需求为条件的数值都是基于五名受试者的宏观平均值，并需匹配相应的区间；这些数值都不应被解读为基于十名受试者的结果。
